Finally, apply a protective sealant or furniture wax to provide extra protection, keep the furniture shiny for a long time, and improve its resistance to moisture and wear. The entire restoration process is enjoyable, and the final result will be the best reward for your patience and effort.
text_tgt_raw: 修复一件古董家具，首要步骤是细致的准备与清洁。首先，全面评估家具的木质结构和五金件状况，以明确需要修补的范围，例如修复结构损伤或更换磨损部件。接下来，用中细砂纸轻柔打磨家具表面，去除旧漆或旧涂层，直至木质纹理平整光滑。然后，涂刷合适的底漆，这不仅能增强新涂层的附着力与持久性，还能有效保护木材，延长家具的使用寿命。之后，选择心仪的油漆或清漆，耐心分层薄涂数遍，以达到专业且耐用的效果。最后，涂上保护性封层或家具蜡，为家具提供额外的保护，使其长久保持光泽，并提升抗湿防磨的性能。整个修复过程充满乐趣，最终的成果也将是对您耐心和努力的最好回报。
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, it's essential to start with good preparation and cleaning. Evaluate the condition of the piece—wood and hardware—to determine the necessary steps, such as repairing structural damage and replacing parts. Gently sand the surface to remove old varnish or paint, using medium and fine-grit sandpaper to achieve a smooth and uniform texture. Apply an appropriate primer to ensure the adhesion and durability of the new finish, protecting the wood and giving it a longer useful life. Then, choose the paint or varnish you want, applying several thin coats for a professional and durable result. Finally, protect the furniture with a sealer or wax to maintain its beauty and resistance to moisture and wear. You'll enjoy the process and the result of your patience and effort.

text_es: Hosting a birthday party is an activity that requires careful planning and is full of fun. First, determine the date, time, budget, and invited guests for the party, and consider the venue and overall style. Next, choose an interesting theme and set up decorations, while ensuring ample food and drinks for all guests, which usually includes preparing or ordering appetizers and main courses. To liven up the party atmosphere, music and entertainment, such as small games or interactive activities, are also essential. Of course, a birthday cake and candles are indispensable elements of the party. Finally, send out invitations in a timely manner and confirm the number of attendees to better arrange the venue and various resources, ensuring the party's complete success.
text_tgt_raw: 举办生日派对是一项既需要精心策划又充满乐趣的活动。首先要确定派对的日期、时间、预算以及邀请的嘉宾，并考虑好场地和整体风格。接着，选择一个有趣的主题并布置好装饰，同时确保为所有宾客准备充足的食物和饮料，这通常包括准备或预订开胃菜和主菜。为了让派对气氛活跃，音乐和娱乐项目，如小游戏或互动活动，也是必不可少的。当然，生日蛋糕和蜡烛更是派对上不可或缺的元素。最后，及时发出邀请并确认出席人数，以便更好地安排场地和各项资源，确保派对圆满成功。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires planning and attention to detail and can be a rewarding and fun experience. 1st, it's essential to decide the date and time, as well as the budget and guests, thinking about the venue and style of celebration. Then, a theme and decoration must be chosen, making sure there's enough food and drink for everyone, which often involves preparing or ordering appetizers and main courses. It's also important to think about music and entertainment, such as games or activities, to keep attendees happy and lively. Don't forget the cake and candles, which are essential and expected elements. Finally, it's key to send out invitations and confirm attendance, to have a clear idea of the number of people and successfully organize the space and resources.

text_es: Planning my birthday party this year was
text_tgt_raw: 今年策划我的生日派对真是一次不小的冒险和个人挑战。我首先从宾客名单开始，想着那些希望能与我分享欢声笑语的亲朋好友。接着是决定时间和地点，这向来令我颇感压力，但在一番电话和信息沟通后，我总算在3月15日（周六）预定到了一个温馨的小房间。装饰是关键一环；我买了气球和彩带，甚至亲手制作了一些花环，力求营造出节日般热烈又温馨的氛围。食物和饮料的筹划是最有趣的部分；我设想了一个简单的自助餐，包括三明治和各式小吃，当然还有适合所有口味和年龄段的蛋糕和软饮料。幸好，姐姐和姐夫在准备过程中帮了我大忙，大大减轻了我的工作量和压力。最终，派对非常成功，音乐和舞蹈一直持续到深夜，每个人都尽情享受了相聚的时光和这份喜悦。
base_en: This year, organizing my birthday party was quite an adventure and a personal challenge. I started with the guest list, thinking of friends and family I wanted to be present to share laughs and good times. Then, I had to decide on the place and date—something that always causes me stress—and, after a few calls and messages, I managed to reserve a cozy little room for Saturday, March 15th. The decoration was a key point; I bought balloons and streamers, and I even made some garlands by hand, looking for a festive and warm atmosphere. The food and drinks were the most fun part to plan; I thought of a simple buffet with sandwiches and various appetizers, plus a cake and soft drinks for all tastes and ages. Fortunately, my sister and brother-in-law helped me a lot with the preparations, easing the workload and stress. In the end, the party turned out great, with music and dancing that lasted until night, and everyone enjoyed the company and the celebration.

text_es: To successfully host a birthday party, meticulous planning and advance preparation are crucial. First, determine the date, time, and budget, and then draft a guest list. Next, consider the party theme and decorations, such as balloons and streamers, as these elements can create a joyful and memorable atmosphere. Food and drinks should not be overlooked; choose items that are widely liked and easy to serve, such as appetizers and various soft drinks. Music and games are also indispensable; they can ensure everyone, from children to adults, enjoys themselves thoroughly and stays in high spirits. Confirm guest attendance one to two weeks in advance to estimate the number of attendees and allow ample time to purchase necessary items, avoiding last-minute rush. By following these suggestions, along with a positive attitude, your birthday party is sure to be a complete success, bringing endless joy to the birthday person and their loved ones.
text_tgt_raw: 要成功举办一场生日派对，周密的计划和提前的准备至关重要。首先，确定日期、时间和预算，并拟定宾客名单。接着，考虑派对主题和装饰，比如气球和彩带，这些元素能营造出欢乐难忘的氛围。食物和饮品也不容忽视，选择大众喜爱的、方便取用的，如开胃小吃和各式软饮。音乐和游戏同样不可或缺，它们能让从孩子到大人所有人都尽情享受，保持高昂的兴致。提前一到两周确认宾客是否出席，以便估算人数，并预留充足时间购买所需物品，避免手忙脚乱。遵循这些建议，再加上积极的心态，您的生日派对定会圆满成功，为寿星和亲友们带来无尽的欢乐。
base_en: To organize a successful birthday party, planning, and anticipation are key. Start by defining the date and time, as well as the budget and guest list. Think about the theme and decoration—balloons and streamers, for example—elements that will create a festive and memorable atmosphere. Don't forget the food and drinks: opt for options that most people will like and that are easy to serve, such as appetizers and various soft drinks. Music and games are also important to keep everyone's spirits up and entertained, from the youngest to the adults. Confirm guests' attendance 1 or 2 weeks in advance to get an approximate number, and make any necessary last-minute purchases with time and peace of mind. With these tips and a good attitude, your celebration will be a success and a joy for the birthday person and their loved ones.

text_es: To properly care for indoor plants, meticulous attention and specialized knowledge are required to ensure their healthy and vigorous growth. First, providing appropriate light and temperature for each plant is crucial, as insufficient or excessive light can harm their growth. Watering is also a key step; a balance must be found between humidity and drainage to avoid waterlogged or overly dry soil. High-quality potting mix and timely fertilization can provide plants with essential nutrients and minerals. Additionally, regular pruning and cleaning of leaves help prevent pests and diseases, maintaining the plants' health and vitality. By paying attention to these details and fully understanding the unique needs of each plant and pot, you can create a vibrant green home environment.
text_tgt_raw: 要养好室内植物，需要细致的照料和专业的知识，才能确保它们健康茁壮成长。首先，为每种植物提供适宜的光照和温度至关重要，光照不足或过强都会对其生长造成损害。浇水也是关键一环，必须在湿度和排水之间找到平衡点，避免土壤积水或过度干燥。优质的基质和适时施肥能为植物提供必需的营养和矿物质。此外，定期修剪和清洁叶片有助于预防病虫害，保持植物的健康和活力。关注这些细节，并充分了解每种植物和花盆的独特需求，就能拥有一个生机盎然的绿色家居环境。
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires specific attention and knowledge to ensure their growth and well-being. It's essential to consider the appropriate light and temperature for each species, as insufficient or excessive exposure can be detrimental. Watering is another crucial factor; it's important to find a balance between humidity and drainage, avoiding both waterlogging and extreme dryness of the soil. A quality substrate and occasional fertilization are essential to provide the necessary nutrients and minerals for their development. In addition, pruning, and regular cleaning of the leaves help prevent pests and diseases, maintaining the plant's health and vitality. Paying attention to these details and to the specific needs of each plant and pot will guarantee a green and lively home.

text_es: To be honest, there was a time when caring for indoor plants was a source of stress and frustration for me. I initially bought potted plants and seeds full of expectation, only to find that most of them, as expected, withered within weeks or even days. I gradually understood that while light and water are important, the key lies in the vast differences in the amounts and frequencies required by different species and varieties. My fig tree and prayer plant, especially, taught me immense patience and meticulous observation. Now, I enjoy the tranquility and beauty they bring to my home, and this activity truly allows my mind and body to relax. This is not just a hobby, but a deeper connection between me and nature and life itself.
text_tgt_raw: Required items: 1. 坦白说 2. 曾几何时 3. 充满期待 4. 最终 5. 不出所料 6. 关键在于 7. 尤其是 8. 不仅仅是 9. 身心放松 坦白说，曾几何时，养护室内植物对我而言一度是压力和挫折的来源。当初我充满期待地购买了盆栽和种子，最终却发现大部分植物不出所料地在几周甚至几天内就枯萎了。我逐渐明白，光照和水分固然重要，但关键在于不同物种和品种所需量和频率差异巨大。尤其是我的榕树和孔雀竹芋，更是教会了我极大的耐心和细致的观察。现在，我享受它们为我家带来的宁静和美感，而且这项活动确实能让我的身心放松。这不仅仅是一种爱好，更是我与自然和生命的一种深层连接。
base_en: I recognize that caring for houseplants was, at 1st, a source of stress and frustration for me. I bought pots and seeds with great excitement, only to see most of my acquisitions end up wilting in a matter of weeks and days. I learned, for example, that light and water are essential, but the amount and frequency can vary greatly among species and varieties. My ficuses and calatheas, in particular, have taught me a lot of patience and observation. Now I enjoy the calm and beauty they bring to my home and, honestly, it's an activity that relaxes my mind and body. It's not just a hobby; it's a connection with nature and life.

text_es: To successfully care for indoor plants, thorough preparation and careful planning are essential. Before purchasing any plant, be sure to research its specific growth requirements, such as its preferences for light and humidity. At the same time, ensure you have enough suitable pots and growing media, as good drainage and soil fertility are key to healthy plant development. Watering is fundamental to care, but avoid overwatering or underwatering; always check the soil's moisture level and weigh the pot before each watering. Observe the plant's leaves and stems daily, as they will directly reflect the plant's health and indicate potential pest and disease problems. Appropriate light, temperature, and sufficient ventilation and humidity are crucial for the plant's overall growth. Furthermore, regular pruning and cleaning of leaves should not be overlooked, as this not only promotes vigorous plant growth but also adds vitality and beauty to your home environment.
text_tgt_raw: 想要成功养护室内植物，充分的准备和周密的规划是必不可少的。在购买任何植物之前，务必先研究其特定的生长需求，比如对光照和湿度的偏好。同时，要确保备有足够且合适的盆器和基质，因为良好的排水性和土壤肥力是植物健康发育的关键。浇水是养护的基础，但切忌过量或不足，每次浇水前都应检查土壤的干湿程度并掂量花盆的重量。日常观察植物的叶片和茎干，它们会直观地反映植物的健康状况，并预示潜在的病虫害问题。适宜的光照、温度以及充足的通风和湿度，对于植物的整体生长状态至关重要。此外，定期修剪和清洁叶片同样不可忽视，这不仅能促进植物旺盛生长，还能为您的家居环境增添一份生机与美感。
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, a good start and planning are essential. Research the specific needs of each plant, such as light and humidity, before buying it. Make sure you've adequate pots and substrate, as good drainage and soil nutrition are key for their development. Watering is fundamental, but avoid overwatering and underwatering, always checking the soil and the weight of the pot. Pay attention to the leaves and stems, as they'll give you clues about their health and possible problems or pests. The correct light and temperature, along with optimal ventilation and humidity, are vital for their well-being. Don't forget regular pruning and cleaning of leaves, which will promote healthy and vigorous growth, and provide a pleasant environment and atmosphere in your home.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for our health and well-being, so it's essential to consider multiple factors and personal preferences when selecting one. The firmness and support of a mattress are core elements; one that is too soft or too firm can lead to body aches and discomfort. Various materials are available on the market, such as memory foam, latex, and innerspring, each with its own advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It's vital to lie down for at least 10 to 15 minutes to personally experience the mattress's comfort and how your body responds. At the same time, you should also consider your sleeping position and body weight, as these directly affect pressure distribution and the alignment of your spine and neck. A high-quality mattress can significantly improve sleep quality and promote overall muscle and body recovery. Furthermore, don't forget to pay attention to the mattress's durability and warranty period, as these are important indicators of the manufacturer's product quality and commitment to consumers.
text_tgt_raw: 选择一张合适的床垫对我们的健康和幸福至关重要，因此在挑选时务必考虑多方面因素和个人偏好。床垫的软硬度和支撑性是核心要素，过软或过硬都可能导致身体酸痛和不适。市面上有多种材质可供选择，例如记忆棉、乳胶和弹簧，它们在适应性和透气性方面各有优劣。试躺至少10到15分钟，亲身感受床垫的舒适度及身体反馈至关重要。同时，也要结合自己的睡姿和体重，因为这些直接影响压力分布以及脊柱和颈部的对齐。一张优质的床垫能显著改善睡眠质量，促进肌肉和身体的整体恢复。此外，别忘了关注床垫的耐用性和保修期，这些都是衡量制造商产品质量和对消费者承诺的重要指标。
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is fundamental for health and well-being, so it's important to consider various factors and personal preferences. Firmness and support are key aspects; a mattress that's too soft or too hard can cause aches and discomfort. There are diverse types of materials, such as memory foam, latex, and springs, each with its own advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It's crucial to try out the mattress for at least 10 to 15 minutes to evaluate its comfort and body response. Also consider your sleeping posture and your weight, as they directly influence pressure distribution and the alignment of your spine and neck. A good mattress can improve sleep quality and overall muscular and physical recovery. Don't forget durability and warranty, which are indicators of the manufacturer's quality and commitment to the product and the customer.

text_es: Three years ago, my old mattress could no longer provide comfort and support, and I woke up every morning with a sore back. My partner and I realized it was time to invest in a good mattress. It was truly a long shopping journey! We visited many stores, tried out spring mattresses and memory foam mattresses, and faced with a dazzling array of choices and prices, we felt very confused. Salespeople enthusiastically introduced us to the characteristics and adaptability of different firmness levels, as well as various materials and technologies. We lay on different mattresses for several hours, trying to distinguish the subtle differences between firm and medium-firm mattresses. After careful consideration and repeatedly weighing the pros and cons, we finally chose a medium-firm mattress with a memory foam layer, which promised to provide high-quality sleep and good durability. This decision brought us a sense of relief, and now I can finally enjoy peaceful nights and restorative sleep.
text_tgt_raw: 三年前，我的旧床垫再也无法提供舒适和支撑，每天早上醒来都腰酸背痛，我和伴侣意识到是时候投资一张好床垫了。这真是一段漫长的选购之旅！我们走访了多家商店，试躺了弹簧床垫和记忆棉床垫，面对琳琅满目的选择和眼花缭乱的价格，我们感到非常困惑。销售人员热情地向我们介绍了不同软硬度的特点和适应性，以及各种材质和技术。我们在不同的床垫上躺了几个小时，试图分辨偏硬和中等硬度床垫之间的细微差别。经过深思熟虑和反复权衡利弊，我们最终选择了一款中等偏硬且带记忆棉层的床垫，它承诺能带来高质量的睡眠和良好的耐用性。这个决定让我们松了一口气，现在我终于能享受宁静的夜晚和恢复精力的睡眠了。
base_en: Choosing a mattress—what an odyssey! I remember about 3 years ago, when my old mattress no longer offered comfort or support. My mornings started with back and neck pain, so my partner and I decided it was time to invest in good rest. We visited several stores, trying spring and memory foam models, and the truth is that the variety of options and prices was overwhelming. The salespeople explained the differences between firmness and adaptability to us, and they spoke to us about materials and technologies with great enthusiasm. We spent hours lying on different models, trying to discern the subtle variations between a firm mattress and a medium one, and in the end, after much deliberation and discussing pros and cons, we opted for a medium-firmness one with a layer of memory foam, which promised good rest and durability. The choice was a relief, and now I enjoy restorative sleep and peaceful nights.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, our primary consideration is the quality of our sleep and our physical health, because good rest is directly related to being energetic and to overall well-being. Among the many materials, whether it's springs, memory foam, latex, or ordinary sponge, the key is to find the optimal balance between firmness and conformity to meet your body's actual needs. Personal experience is crucial; be sure to lie down and feel the comfort and support it provides, and pay special attention to whether your spine and neck posture are natural. Do not be solely attracted by price and promotional activities; durability and excellent quality are long-term investments. Additionally, you should consider your sleeping habits, such as whether you sleep on your back, side, or stomach, and whether you sleep with a partner, ensuring that both of you have enough space and comfort. Finally, be sure to understand the product's warranty period and return policy in detail, as these are the sources of your purchase guarantee and peace of mind.
text_tgt_raw: 选择床垫时，首要考虑的是我们的睡眠质量与身体健康，因为良好的休息直接关系到精力充沛和整体幸福感。在众多材质中，无论是弹簧、记忆棉、乳胶还是普通海绵，关键在于找到硬度与贴合度之间的最佳平衡，以满足您身体的实际需求。亲身体验至关重要，一定要躺下来感受其提供的舒适度和支撑性，并特别留意脊椎和颈部的姿态是否自然。切勿只被价格和促销活动所吸引，耐用性和卓越的品质才是长远的投资。此外，您还应考量自身的睡姿习惯，例如是仰卧、侧卧还是俯卧，以及是否与伴侣同睡，确保两人都能拥有足够的空间和舒适度。最后，务必详细了解产品的质保期限和退换政策，这些都是您购买的保障和安心的来源。
base_en: When choosing a mattress, the key is to prioritize your rest and health, since sleeping well impacts your energy and general well-being. Consider the type of material—springs and memory foam, latex, and foam—looking for the balance between firmness and adaptability that your body needs. It's vital to try it in person; lie down and feel the comfort and support it offers, paying attention to the posture of your back and neck. Don't be guided only by price and offers; durability and quality are long-term investments. Also think about your sleeping posture—on your back and side, on your stomach—and if you share the bed with another person so that both of you've space and comfort. Find out about the warranty and return policies, as they're insurance for your purchase and your peace of mind.

text_es: Reducing food waste is crucial for both environmental protection and social development. This requires us to better plan and purchase food, avoiding unnecessary excess and waste. Properly storing ingredients, fully considering their freshness and shelf life, is key to maintaining food quality and flavor. Furthermore, fully utilizing leftovers, and even giving fruit peels, vegetable stems, and other ingredient scraps a second life, can significantly reduce kitchen waste. This practice not only saves household expenses and conserves water and energy resources, but also effectively improves food security, reduces carbon footprints, and lessens environmental pollution. Therefore, cultivating responsible and conscious consumption habits is key to addressing this global issue, promoting sustainable development, and ensuring the well-being of all.
text_tgt_raw: 减少食物浪费对环境保护和社会发展都至关重要。这要求我们更好地规划和购买食物，避免不必要的过量和浪费。妥善储存食材，充分考虑其新鲜度和保质期，是保持食物品质和风味的关键。此外，充分利用剩饭剩菜，甚至给果皮、菜梗等食材的边角料第二次生命，都能显著减少厨余垃圾。这种做法不仅能节约家庭开支，节省水和能源资源，还能有效提高粮食安全水平，降低碳足迹和环境污染。因此，培养负责任、有意识的消费习惯，是应对这一全球性问题、促进可持续发展和全民福祉的关键所在。
base_en: Reducing food waste is a fundamental action for the environment and society. It involves better food planning and purchasing, avoiding unnecessary excesses and waste. It's crucial to store products properly, considering their freshness and duration, to preserve their properties and flavor. Furthermore, using leftovers and giving ingredients and parts of food—such as peels and stems—a 2nd life, decreases the amount of waste. This practice not only generates economic savings and saves water and energy resources, but it also contributes to food security and reduces the carbon footprint and pollution. Adopting responsible and conscious consumption habits is key to combating this global problem and promoting sustainability and the well-being of everyone.

text_es: Last week, while organizing my refrigerator and pantry, I was surprised to find how much food in my home was being wasted, which made me feel very guilty and frustrated. I have always tried to be a rational consumer, but the fast pace of modern life and daily busyness often lead me to over-purchase or forget about ingredients deep in drawers. So, I made a firm decision to more seriously reduce food waste and began actively looking for practical methods. Now, I have learned to plan menus and purchase quantities in advance, which not only saves time but also unexpectedly saves a lot of money. Additionally, I have tried to repurpose leftovers, such as stale bread and wilted vegetables, by turning them into broths and soups, giving them a second life. I believe that these seemingly small habits and changes in mindset in our daily lives can ultimately bring significant positive impacts to the environment and our wallets. Although this is an ongoing challenge, the satisfaction and benefits it brings are immense.
text_tgt_raw: 上周整理冰箱和储藏室时，我惊讶地发现家中竟然有那么多食物被白白浪费，这让我感到非常内疚和沮丧。我一直努力做到理性消费，但现代生活的快节奏和日常忙碌常常让我过度采购，或是遗忘抽屉深处的食材。于是，我下定决心要更认真地减少食物浪费，并开始积极寻找实用的方法。现在，我学会了提前规划菜单和购买分量，这不仅节约了时间，还意外地省下了不少开支。此外，我还尝试将剩饭剩菜，比如不新鲜的面包和蔫掉的蔬菜，重新利用起来制作成高汤和浓汤，赋予它们第二次生命。我相信，我们日常生活中这些看似微小的习惯和观念上的改变，最终能为环境和我们的钱包带来显著的积极影响。这虽然是一个持续的挑战，但由此带来的满足感和实惠却是巨大的。
base_en: Last week, while organizing the fridge and pantry, I realized the enormous amount of food that sometimes goes to waste, and I felt a pang of guilt and frustration. I've always tried to be conscious with my purchases and consumption, but modern life and daily rushes often lead me to overbuy or forget food at the back of the drawer. I decided it was time to take more serious measures to reduce waste, so I looked for tips and tricks. I started to better plan my menus and quantities, which has resulted in surprising savings of time and money. In addition, I now try to reuse leftovers—like stale bread and wilted vegetables—to make broths and soups, giving them a 2nd chance. I believe that small changes in our habits and attitudes can generate a significant impact on the environment and on our wallets. It's a constant challenge, but the satisfaction and benefit are great.

text_es: Maintaining a bicycle isn't just a matter of aesthetics, but of safety and durability. Regular maintenance can prevent costly breakdowns and ensure optimal performance; it's not something to underestimate. This includes checking tire pressure before each ride, cleaning, and frequently lubricating the chain, and adjusting the brakes so they're always ready. We also shouldn't forget to check the condition of the cables and gears; if they don't work well, the pedaling experience won't be ideal. The truth is that good care prolongs the bike's lifespan and makes every trip more pleasant. It's really not complicated and only requires a little time and attention.
text_tgt_raw: 保养自行车不仅仅是为了美观，更是为了安全和耐用。定期维护可以避免昂贵的故障，并确保最佳性能，这一点不容小觑。这包括每次骑行前检查胎压、清洁并经常润滑链条，以及调整刹车使其始终处于良好状态。我们也不能忘记检查缆线和齿轮的状况；如果它们工作不畅，骑行体验就不会理想。事实上，良好的保养能延长自行车的使用寿命，让每一次骑行都更加愉快。这真的不复杂，只需要一点时间和细心。

text_es: I remember the 1st time I dared to maintain my own bicycle, it wasn't an easy task! My parents always told me that wasn't for kids, but I wanted to learn. The chain wasn't properly adjusted and the gear shift wasn't working, so I decided I could fix it. I got to work with a basic toolkit—which I had bought at a 2nd-hand store—and the help of an internet tutorial; I'm no expert, of course. After about 3 hours, the result wasn't perfect, but I felt proud of having tried; that's what's important, don't you think? Since then, I try to do the maintenance myself, it's a very useful skill.
text_tgt_raw: 我记得第一次尝试自己修理自行车的时候，真不是件容易的事！我父母总说那不是小孩子能干的活儿，可我偏想学。当时链条没调好，变速器也不灵，于是我决定自己动手修。我用的是从旧货店淘来的简易工具包，还参照了网上的教程，当然，我可不是什么专家。大概花了三个小时，虽然结果不尽完美，但我为自己的尝试感到很自豪，你觉得呢？从那以后，我都会尽量自己动手保养自行车，这真的是一项很有用的技能。

text_es: To start with your bicycle, don't forget regular cleaning; that's fundamental for good preservation. You don't need to be an expert mechanic, but you do have to dedicate about 15 minutes every 2 weeks for basic maintenance. Check the tire pressure—you don't want an unexpected flat—and lubricate the chain—it's not a bad idea every 100 km or if you notice it's dry. If you hear strange noises, don't ignore it: sometimes it's just a simple adjustment. It's also not complicated to check the brakes and gears to ensure they're working correctly; that will help you prevent bigger problems. There are no excuses to neglect your bike; it will thank you with a much longer lifespan and safer rides.
text_tgt_raw: 要保养好你的自行车，首先别忘了定期清洁，这是良好维护的基础。你不需要成为专业的机械师，但每两周花大约15分钟进行一些基本保养是很有必要的。检查胎压——你肯定不希望突然爆胎；给链条上油——每骑行100公里或发现链条发干时做一次都不算多余。如果听到奇怪的响声，不要忽视：有时那只是一个小小的调整。检查刹车和变速器是否正常工作也不复杂，这能帮你避免更大的麻烦。所以，没有理由疏忽你的自行车，它会以更长的使用寿命和更安全的骑行来感谢你。

text_es: Organizing a farmers market isn't an easy task, as it involves a lot of planning and coordination. It's not just about finding a location, that's only the 1st step. You have to identify local farmers who want to participate—not all of them have availability—secure municipal permits, and establish a schedule. Furthermore, we can't forget promotion; it's essential to communicate to the community that the market is open. We also shouldn't underestimate the logistics of the stalls and waste management, these are crucial aspects that must be considered in advance. It's not always possible to please everyone, but the main goal is to offer fresh products and support producers. I'm sure that a good plan can lead to success.
text_tgt_raw: 组织农贸市场并非易事，需要大量的规划和协调。这不仅仅是寻找场地那么简单，那只是第一步。你必须找到愿意参与的本地农户——并非所有农户都有空闲时间——还要获得市政许可并制定时间表。此外，我们不能忘记宣传，向社区告知市场开放至关重要。我们也不应低估摊位和垃圾处理的物流问题，这些都是必须提前考虑的关键方面。虽然不可能总是让所有人满意，但主要目标是提供新鲜产品并支持生产者。我相信一个周密的计划定能带来成功。

text_es: To organize a farmers market, the 1st step is clear: it isn't as complicated as it seems if you plan well. Start by identifying a suitable location, one that's accessible and where there aren't too many permits to manage—that's fundamental. Next, you need to contact local farmers; the key is to offer them a good space at a reasonable cost, because they don't have to invest much at the beginning. Promotion is also crucial; it's not enough to open, you have to advertise the market. Use social media, posters, and collaborate with neighborhood businesses, so people will know you're there. Finally, be consistent and listen to suggestions; a good market isn't built in 1 day, and this is something you'll learn over time.
text_tgt_raw: 要组织一个农贸市场，第一步很明确：如果规划得当，它并不像看起来那么复杂。首先要确定一个合适的地点，既要交通便利，又要避免过多的许可手续——这是基础。接下来，你需要联系当地农民；关键是以合理的价格为他们提供一个好的摊位，因为他们初期不需要投入太多。宣传也至关重要；仅仅开业是不够的，你还得推广市场。利用社交媒体、海报，并与周边商家合作，这样人们才会知道你的存在。最后，要持之以恒并听取建议；一个好的市场不是一天建成的，这一点你会在实践中慢慢体会。

text_es: I remember the day I decided to learn to knit a scarf; it wasn't my idea, to be honest. My grandmother, an expert with yarn, told me, "this isn't as hard as it seems, you'll see." At 18 years old, I wasn't very convinced, because my manual skills aren't my strong suit. She taught me the basic stitches, knit, and purl, and at 1st I couldn't even get one right; I didn't understand why the threads got so tangled. But she, patiently, repeated, "don't despair, practice makes perfect." After 3 days and a lot of frustration, the pattern was no longer a mystery and I felt a little proud to see the 1st row more or less straight; that moment was gratifying. Now, every winter, I wear that scarf—even though it's not perfect, it has some loose stitches—and I fondly remember the experience.
text_tgt_raw: 我记得我决定学织围巾的那天，说实话，那并不是我自己的主意。我的奶奶，一位玩毛线的高手，对我说：“这没你想的那么难，你看着吧。”当时我18岁，对此并不太相信，因为我的动手能力从来都不是强项。她教了我基本的针法，平针和反针，起初我连一个都织不好，不明白线为什么总是缠在一起。但她耐心地重复道：“别灰心，熟能生巧。”三天后，经历了无数次挫折，针法对我来说不再是谜团，当我看到第一排织得差不多直的时候，心里还有点小得意；那一刻真是令人满足。现在，每年冬天我都会戴上那条围巾——尽管它并不完美，有些地方还松垮垮的——但我总是深情地回忆起那段经历。

text_es: To start knitting a scarf, the 1st thing you can't forget is that it isn't as difficult as it seems, it just requires patience. There's no need to invest a lot at the beginning; 5 mm or 6 mm needles and a ball of medium-weight yarn are enough. This is the basic stuff. Start with a simple stitch, like the garter stitch or knit stitch, you'll see that it isn't very complicated. Once you master that technique, you'll see that you aren't so far from knitting other things. Don't forget to count your stitches at the beginning and end of each row so that the scarf doesn't unintentionally narrow or widen. You'll see that it's a very relaxing and rewarding activity.
text_tgt_raw: 要开始织围巾，你首先要记住它并没有看起来那么难，只需要一点耐心。初期也不需要投入太多，一双5毫米或6毫米的棒针，再加一团中等粗细的毛线就足够了，这些就是最基础的材料。你可以从简单的针法开始，比如平针或正针，你会发现它其实并不复杂。一旦你掌握了这项技巧，你会发现离织其他东西也就不远了。别忘了在每行的开头和结尾数一下针数，这样可以避免围巾不小心变窄或变宽。你会发现这真是一项非常放松且有成就感的活动。

text_es: Preparing for a move isn't an easy task and requires meticulous planning for everything to go well. This is crucial to avoid unnecessary stress. Don't underestimate the time needed for packing, because one always has more things than they think. Don't forget to label all boxes with their contents and the destination room; that's very useful on moving day. You also can't leave hiring the moving company or renting the van until the last minute. It doesn't hurt to ask several companies for quotes and compare services. Finally, remember to change your address on all your documents and services so you don't have any surprises later.
text_tgt_raw: 搬家绝非易事，需要周密细致的规划才能确保一切顺利，这对于避免不必要的压力至关重要。千万不要低估打包所需的时间，因为人们通常拥有的物品比自己想象的要多。别忘了给所有箱子贴上标签，注明内含物品和目的地房间，这在搬家当天会非常有用。此外，雇用搬家公司或租赁货车也不能拖到最后一刻才办，多向几家公司询价并比较服务总是有益无害的。最后，请务必记得更改所有证件和服务的地址，以免日后遇到麻烦。

text_es: If you're starting to take care of an urban garden, don't despair! It's easier than it seems. 1st, look for a place with at least 6 hours of direct sun; that's essential for almost all plants. Then, don't underestimate the importance of good substrate; not just any soil will do, it's vital that it has good drainage and nutrients. At 1st, don't plant too many things at once; start with 3 or 4 crops that you like and are easy, such as lettuce, spinach, or radishes—that will help you gain confidence. Also, don't forget to water regularly, but without overwatering; too much water isn't good. If you see pests, don't use strong chemical products immediately; often there are organic solutions. And remember, you don't have to be an expert; the key is to observe and learn from your plants.
text_tgt_raw: 如果您正准备开始打理城市花园，请不要绝望！这比看起来容易得多。首先，找一个每天至少有6小时直射阳光的地方，这对几乎所有植物来说都至关重要。接着，不要低估良好基质的重要性；并非任何土壤都行，它必须具有良好的排水性和营养。一开始，不要一次性种植太多东西；先从三四种你喜欢且易于种植的作物开始，比如生菜、菠菜或萝卜——这会帮助你建立信心。此外，别忘了定期浇水，但不要浇水过多；水太多也不好。如果您发现害虫，不要立即使用强效化学产品；通常会有有机解决方案。请记住，您不必成为专家；关键在于观察并从您的植物中学习。

text_es: Planning a train trip isn't as complex as it seems and offers a different experience. It's essential to 1st decide on the destination and dates to be able to look for tickets in advance, as this usually guarantees better prices. One shouldn't underestimate the importance of schedule flexibility, as some connections are limited. It's always a good idea to check the different types of seats and services on board; not all trains have the same amenities. Don't forget to verify if you need to reserve a seat in advance—that's crucial on popular routes. Furthermore, you're free to bring your own food and drink on many journeys, which saves you some money. Finally, you're a click away from an adventure on rails.
text_tgt_raw: 规划一场火车旅行并非想象中那么复杂，它能带来截然不同的体验。首先，确定目的地和出行日期至关重要，这样你才能提前查询车票，通常也能因此获得更优惠的价格。不要低估行程灵活性的重要性，因为有些班次的选择有限。务必提前了解不同座位类型和车上服务，并非所有列车设施都相同。别忘了确认是否需要提前预订座位，这在热门线路上尤其关键。此外，许多旅程都允许你自带食物和饮料，这也能帮你节省一些开支。总之，一次铁路冒险之旅，只需你轻轻一点即可开启。

text_es: To plan a train trip, it isn't difficult if you follow a few key steps. The 1st thing you have to do is decide your destination and dates; it isn't good to leave it until the last minute, as prices can rise considerably. Look for routes and schedules on the railway companies' websites; there isn't a single website for all European trains, so it's better to do a little research. Consider buying a train pass if you're going to make several trips, that's very useful and saves you money. Don't forget to reserve seats either, especially on high-speed trains or if you're traveling in high season, because the train doesn't have to have free seats at the last minute. I'm one of those who always arrive at the station early—you never know what unforeseen event might arise!
text_tgt_raw: 规划一次火车旅行并不难，只要遵循几个关键步骤即可。首先，你需要确定目的地和日期；最好不要等到最后一刻才决定，因为价格可能会大幅上涨。在铁路公司的网站上查找路线和时刻表；欧洲的火车并没有一个统一的网站，所以最好多做些功课。如果你打算进行多次旅行，可以考虑购买火车通票，这样既方便又省钱。另外，别忘了预订座位，尤其是在乘坐高铁或旺季出行时，因为火车不一定总有空座。我总是习惯提前到达车站——你永远不知道会发生什么突发情况！

text_es: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't just for experts. You aren't limited to a single recipe; there's a wide variety of breads you can try, from classic white bread to more complex sourdough options. It isn't difficult to start; you just need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although that isn't all you can add. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough—which doesn't have to be exhausting—letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough grow and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes, that's a wonderful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread doesn't have preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought; you won't regret trying it.
text_tgt_raw: 在家做面包是一件很有成就感的事情，并非只有专业人士才能做到。你不会局限于一种食谱；从经典的白面包到更复杂的酸面包，各种各样的面包你都可以尝试。开始做面包并不难，你只需要面粉、水、酵母和盐，当然你也可以添加其他配料。整个过程包括混合食材、揉面（这并不一定很累）、让面团发酵，然后烘烤。看着面团膨胀，闻着烘烤时厨房里弥漫的香气，那真是一种美妙的体验。此外，自制面包不含防腐剂，味道也远非商店购买的面包可比；你一定不会后悔尝试的。

text_es: If you want to get started in the world of making bread at home, don't stress at 1st; it isn't as complicated as it seems. The 1st thing is to look for a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread, it doesn't have to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. This is key: patience and practice are your best allies, there are no shortcuts to good bread. Make sure you've the essential ingredients—flour, water, yeast, salt—and a reliable scale; precision is important. Don't forget that room temperature greatly influences the rising. I'm sure that with 2 or 3 tries, you'll start to get the hang of it and you'll be surprised how rewarding it's to bake your own bread.
text_tgt_raw: 如果你想开始在家制作面包，一开始不要有压力，它并没有看起来那么复杂。首先要找一个制作白面包或全麦面包的基础食谱，如果你还没有信心，不一定非要尝试酸面包。关键在于：耐心和练习是你最好的帮手，制作好面包没有捷径。确保你备齐了基本食材——面粉、水、酵母、盐——以及一个可靠的秤，精确度很重要。别忘了室温对发酵有很大影响。我相信经过两三次尝试，你就会逐渐掌握技巧，并且会惊讶于亲手烘焙面包是多么有成就感。

text_es: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking the step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you've time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best suits your lifestyle, because a large dog isn't the same as a small one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, only love and care. That's the most important thing, really. You're about to give a 2nd chance to a living being, and the unconditional love you receive in return is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life, but you also free up space for another animal in need.
text_tgt_raw: 领养一只狗不只是把一个动物带回家，这更是一项重大的承诺，一个将彻底改变你和它生活的决定。在采取这一步之前，有几个因素至关重要：你是否有时间遛狗和照顾它？你的家是否适合养狗？不必着急，请仔细考虑哪种品种和体型最适合你的生活方式，因为大型犬和小型犬的需求截然不同。许多收容所里有需要家的动物，它们别无所求，只希望能得到爱和关怀。这才是真正最重要的事。你即将给予一个生命第二次机会，而作为回报，你将收获无价的无条件的爱。此外，通过领养，你不仅拯救了一个生命，也为另一个需要帮助的动物腾出了收容空间。

text_es: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to be well-informed; it's not a decision that should be taken lightly. Think about the time you're going to dedicate to it, because a dog isn't just companionship, it needs walks, games, and daily attention. Are you willing to do that? Also consider your economic situation; you shouldn't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, they aren't exactly low. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that certain breeds need more space than others; it's not a minor factor. Look for a shelter or rescue; not only will you find the perfect companion, but you'll also help an animal in need. That way, you don't just adopt a pet, but you save a life, and that's what really matters.
text_tgt_raw: 在领养狗狗之前，充分了解情况至关重要，这绝非一个可以草率做出的决定。请认真考虑你将投入的时间，因为狗狗不仅是陪伴，它还需要散步、玩耍和日常的照料。你是否愿意为此付出？同时也要考虑你的经济状况；不要低估食物、兽医和各种用品的费用，它们可不低。如果你住在公寓里，别忘了有些品种比其他品种更需要活动空间，这不是一个可以忽视的因素。去当地的动物收容所或救助站看看吧，你不仅能找到完美的伴侣，还能帮助那些需要帮助的动物。那样一来，你领养的不仅仅是一个宠物，更是拯救了一个生命，这才是真正有意义的事情。

text_es: Yesterday I embarked on the adventure of assembling a shelf I bought, and it wasn't easy at all. The box indicated 1 hour for assembly, but of course, that's not possible for someone without experience. I don't have much skill with screwdrivers, and that was noticeable. The instructions, moreover, weren't very clear, a real hieroglyph that wasn't very helpful. I think about 3 hours passed before the structure started to take shape, no joke! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves aren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat the experience soon.
text_tgt_raw: 昨天我开始了组装新买架子的“冒险”，过程真是一点都不轻松。包装盒上写着一个小时就能装好，但对于我这种没经验的人来说，这显然是不可能的。我不太会用螺丝刀，这一点在组装过程中表现得很明显。而且，说明书也写得不怎么清楚，简直是天书，根本帮不上什么忙。我估计大概花了三个小时，架子才开始有点样子，这可不是开玩笑！说实话，最终成果还算不错，虽然有几层架子没有完全水平。不过，我近期肯定不想再重复这种经历了。

text_es: Assembling a shelf, although it seems simple, isn't as easy as many people think—no joke! Before starting, make sure you've all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; there's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through the process. I recommend clearing the work area well, so you aren't tripping over other things. Read the instructions 2 full times before tightening the 1st screw; this is crucial to avoid mistakes. Sometimes the assembly order isn't obvious. If the shelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and this isn't a competition. When finished, check the stability; you don't want all the contents to fall at the 1st oversight.
text_tgt_raw: 组装一个架子，虽然看起来简单，但绝不像许多人想象的那么容易——这可不是开玩笑！在开始之前，请确保你已备齐说明书上列出的所有零件和工具；没有什么比做到一半才发现少了一颗螺丝更令人沮丧的了。我建议彻底清理工作区域，以免被其他东西绊倒。在拧上第一颗螺丝之前，请将说明书完整阅读两遍；这对于避免错误至关重要，因为有时组装顺序并不明显。如果架子很大，请不要犹豫寻求帮助；你不必独自完成，这也不是一场比赛。完成后，请务必检查其稳定性；你肯定不希望所有的物品因为第一次疏忽就全部掉下来。

text_es: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries; it isn't just a matter of money. Planning ahead is key; that's, establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It doesn't hurt to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events. A good strategy is to allocate a fixed amount each month to a specific savings account; that's a habit that works very well. In addition, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as they often aren't available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or meals out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. You're building an unforgettable future trip.
text_tgt_raw: 为度假储蓄至关重要，这样才能在没有经济压力的前提下享受应得的放松，这不仅仅是钱的问题。提前规划是关键，也就是要为交通、住宿、餐饮和活动制定详细的预算，以避免任何意外情况。此外，为突发事件准备一笔应急资金也无妨。一个好的策略是每月将固定金额存入一个专门的储蓄账户，这个习惯非常有效。此外，你可以提前寻找优惠和折扣，因为它们通常不会在最后一刻出现。减少不必要的日常开支，比如咖啡或外出就餐，可以产生可观的储蓄，这并不意味着要放弃一切。你正在为一次难忘的未来旅行打基础。

text_es: I've been saving for 6 months for my next vacation and, honestly, it's not easy at all. Every month I set out to save a fixed amount, but some unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited. This is a constant challenge—I'm not sure if I'll make it this time! For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings went to the repair. Despite the setbacks, there's nothing that motivates me more than thinking about those 10 days of relaxation on the beach.
text_tgt_raw: 为了下一次旅行，我已经存了六个月的钱，说实话，这真是一点都不容易。每个月我都打算存下固定金额，但总会冒出一些意想不到的开销，导致我无法按计划执行。问题在于我热爱旅行，但我的预算又不是无限的。这对我来说是一个持续的挑战——我甚至不确定这次我能否成功！比如，这个月车子坏了，这完全不在计划之内，结果我的一部分存款就花在了维修上。尽管面临这些挫折，但一想到那十天在沙滩上放松的时光，就没有任何事能比这更让我充满动力了。

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's immersing oneself in the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at 1st, there's no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve it, it just requires dedication and constant practice—you're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. It's a journey that, although sometimes not easy, is always worth it.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言是一种丰富的体验，它能打开通往其他文化和新思维方式的大门。这不仅仅是记忆词汇和语法，更是沉浸在一个社区的精髓之中。尽管一开始会充满挑战，但没有什么比流利地理解和交流一门外语更能带来巨大的回报了。毫无疑问，在当今全球化的世界中，这是一项无价的技能。你不需要是天才才能做到，它只需要奉献精神和持续的练习——你又不是在学习驾驶宇宙飞船。此外，这也不必是一项孤独的任务；从手机应用程序到与母语教师一起上课，有许多工具和资源可供选择。这是一段旅程，虽然有时不容易，但总是值得的。

text_es: Learning a new language, like Mandarin which I am currently studying, is by no means easy. At first, the pronunciation almost deterred me because there are no tones in Chinese similar to those in Spanish, which was truly frustrating. I still remember during my first week of learning with my teacher, I tried hard to imitate the tones, but he always said, "No, that's not right." Despite putting in a lot of effort, I felt like I wasn't doing well. It took three months before I could gradually distinguish between tones and words, but even then, when watching movies without subtitles, I still understood almost nothing. This isn't to say I haven't made progress; it's just that the speed of speech and context are still huge challenges for me. But I am determined to persevere because I know that with continuous practice, I will eventually master this language one day.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言，就拿我正在学的普通话来说，绝非易事。起初，发音简直让我望而却步，因为汉语中没有与西班牙语相似的音调，这着实令人沮丧。我还记得第一周跟老师学习时，我努力模仿声调，但他总是说：“不对，不是这样的。” 尽管我付出了很多努力，却觉得自己做得不好。三个月后，我才逐渐能区分声调和词语，但即便如此，看电影不带字幕时，我还是几乎什么都听不懂。这并非说我没有进步，只是语速和语境对我来说仍是巨大的挑战。但我下定决心要坚持下去，因为我知道，只要持续练习，终有一天会熟练掌握这门语言。
base_en: Starting to learn a new language, Mandarin Chinese in my case, isn't an easy task, I assure you. At 1st, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Spanish and that's frustrating. I remember the 1st week with the teacher, when I was trying to imitate the tones and he would tell me: "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it well, despite my effort. After 3 months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I don't understand almost anything. It's not that I haven't learned, but that speed and context are challenges. I'm determined to continue, because I know that mastery will come with constant practice.

text_es: Learning a new language is undoubtedly a very rewarding journey, but remember that it is by no means an overnight success. Perseverance and patience are key to success, and beginners should not be discouraged if they find it difficult. Immersive learning is crucial: listen to songs in the target language, watch original TV shows and movies with subtitles, and most importantly, try to speak from the very beginning of your studies, even if it's just a few words, as this is extremely important. Never underestimate the power of making mistakes, because making mistakes is an essential stage in the learning process, so please try boldly and don't be afraid. Furthermore, there is no one-size-fits-all perfect learning method; you should actively explore and find the strategy that works best for you. You will find that with enough effort and focus, your progress will be limitless, and you will soon be able to communicate fluently with others.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言无疑是一段非常有益的旅程，但切记这绝非一蹴而就之事。持之以恒和耐心是成功的关键，初学者若觉得困难重重，切莫因此灰心丧气。沉浸式学习至关重要：多听目的语歌曲，观看原版影视剧并搭配字幕，更要从学习伊始便尝试开口说，哪怕只是寥寥数语，这都极其关键。千万不要低估犯错的力量，因为学习过程中犯错乃是必经阶段，所以请大胆尝试，不必畏惧。此外，并没有一种放之四海而皆准的完美学习方法，你应该积极探索，找出最适合自己的那套策略。你会发现，只要付出足够的努力和专注，你的进步将是无限的，很快就能流利地与人交流。
base_en: Learning a new language is a very rewarding experience, but it's not something that happens overnight. You need consistency and patience; don't despair if it seems difficult at 1st. Immersion is key: listen to music, watch series or movies in their original version with subtitles, and try to speak from the 1st day, even if it's just a few words—that's essential. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; you're learning and making mistakes is part of the process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one single perfect methodology for everyone, experiment, and discover what works best for you. You'll see that with dedication, your progress has no limits and soon you'll be communicating fluently.

text_es: Participating in mass running events is not a competition among elites, but a non-professional sports activity open to everyone, regardless of physical ability. These races typically set standard distances of 5K or 10K, with routes often winding through city streets or park trails, and there are no strict age limits for participants. Their core purpose is to enjoy the process of exercise and promote a healthy lifestyle, often combined with charity fundraising, rather than solely pursuing personal best times. Registration fees are usually not high and include benefits such as bib numbers, commemorative T-shirts, and post-race refreshments. I particularly enjoy the social platform these activities provide, offering opportunities to meet like-minded friends. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere on site and the cheers and encouragement from spectators along the route make the entire experience exceptionally fulfilling and meaningful, definitely worth trying.
text_tgt_raw: 参加大众跑步赛事，并非精英之间的较量，而是一种不限体能、向所有人开放的非专业体育活动。这类比赛通常设定5公里或10公里的标准距离，路线多半穿梭于城市街道或公园小径，且对参赛者的年龄并无严格限制。其核心目的在于享受运动过程、倡导健康生活方式，很多时候还会结合慈善募捐，而非仅仅追求个人最佳成绩。报名费用通常不高，并且会包含号码布、纪念T恤及赛后补给等福利。我特别喜欢这种活动所提供的社交平台，让人有机会结识志同道合的朋友。再者，现场热烈的节日氛围和沿途观众的加油鼓励，都让整个体验变得格外充实和有意义，绝对值得一试。
base_en: Running a popular race is participating in a non-professional sporting event, open to everyone regardless of their physical level; it isn't an elite competition. Normally, predefined distances like 5 km or 10 km are covered through urban streets or paths, and there's no age limit to participate. The main objective is usually to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a charitable cause; it isn't just for a personal best. Registration isn't excessively expensive and usually includes a bib, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests—this is something I really like. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and the encouragement of the people make it a very rewarding experience; you won't regret it.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a very meaningful job; it not only allows the furniture to regain its former glory but also extends its lifespan. This task is by no means easy; it involves a series of meticulous steps, from thorough cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and refinishing, each step being crucial. Identifying the wood type and original finish is essential for choosing the appropriate restoration materials, as not all products are suitable for all materials. This work often requires patience and exquisite craftsmanship, and if you are unsure how to proceed, seeking professional help is a wise choice. Furthermore, we should not overlook the value of traditional craftsmanship, which often yields the best restoration results, even though it may be more time-consuming. The ultimate goal is to restore the furniture to its inherent splendor while preserving the unique marks left by time, rather than sanding it down to look like a new factory product.
text_tgt_raw: 修复古董家具是一项非常有意义的工作，它不仅能让家具重现昔日风采，更能延长其使用寿命。这项任务绝非易事，它包含一系列细致入微的步骤，从彻底清洁、修复结构性损伤，到打磨和重新上漆，每一步都至关重要。识别木材种类和原始漆面对于选择合适的修复材料至关重要，因为并非所有产品都适用于所有材质。这项工作往往需要耐心和精湛的技艺，如果不确定如何操作，寻求专业人士的帮助是明智之举。此外，我们不应忽视传统工艺的价值，它们通常能带来最佳的修复效果，尽管可能耗时较长。最终目标是让家具恢复其固有的华丽，同时保留岁月留下的独特痕迹，而非将其打磨得如同工厂新品一般。
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that not only recovers its original beauty, but also extends its useful life. It isn't a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous steps, from deep cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and applying new finishes. It's important to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the right products, since not all of them are compatible with every material. Often, this is a job that requires patience and skill, and one shouldn't be afraid to ask for help if one isn't sure. Nor should one forget that traditional techniques are usually the ones that offer the best results, although they aren't always the fastest. The final goal is to return the furniture to its splendor without erasing the traces of time that give it character; it isn't about making it look factory new.

text_es: I still clearly remember my first attempt at restoring old furniture; it was truly a valuable learning process. It was a small dresser from my grandmother, and honestly, its condition was not ideal. The drawers wouldn't close properly, and the wood color was uneven, as if every part told a story. At first, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed and didn't know where to start, but this didn't discourage me. I looked up a lot of tutorials online and also consulted a knowledgeable friend. Although the final result wasn't perfect, I am still proud of it because it holds extremely deep emotional value for me. Nowadays, this dresser is no longer an old item in the attic, but rather shines brightly in the living room, and every day I gaze at it with a bit of love.
text_tgt_raw: 我至今仍清晰记得第一次尝试修复旧家具的经历，那真是一次宝贵的学习过程。那是一只来自奶奶的小梳妆台，老实说，它的状况并不理想。抽屉合不严，木头的颜色也不均一，仿佛每一处都写满了故事。起初我确实有些手足无措，不知从何下手，但这并没有让我气馁。我上网查阅了大量教程，也向一位懂行的朋友请教。虽然最终的成果并非完美无瑕，但我依然为它感到自豪，因为它对我而言承载着极其深厚的情感价值。如今，这只梳妆台已不再是阁楼里的旧物，而是光彩照人地摆放在客厅里，每天我都会带着几分爱意凝视它。
base_en: I remember the 1st time I tried to restore an old piece of furniture, it was a learning experience. It was a small dresser from my grandmother, and it wasn't in very good condition, to be honest. The drawers didn't close well and the wood wasn't a uniform color, it seemed to have a thousand stories to tell. At 1st, I didn't know where to start, but this didn't discourage me; I looked for tutorials online and asked a friend who does know about these things. I'm proud of the result, although it's not perfect, it has a lot of sentimental value for me. The dresser is no longer in the attic, now it looks beautiful in the living room and there isn't a day that I don't look at it with affection.

text_es: Restoring old furniture is no small feat, and my primary advice is to fully understand the situation and never act rashly. First, research the style and wood type of the furniture, which is crucial for choosing appropriate restoration products and avoiding damage. Do not rush; thorough planning is the key to success; if you lack sufficient space or basic tools, it's better to postpone. While a large workshop isn't necessary, a well-ventilated, tidy area is essential. Before applying any product to the main surface, always test it in an inconspicuous area to observe how the wood reacts. If the furniture has woodworms, remember to treat them thoroughly before proceeding with restoration to prevent the infestation from spreading. Please remember that restoration is not just about repainting; it's about restoring its original charm and essence.
text_tgt_raw: 修复老旧家具绝非小事，我的首要建议是充分了解情况，切勿草率行事。首先要研究家具的风格和木材种类，这对于选择合适的修复产品、避免损坏至关重要。切忌急躁，周密的计划是成功的关键；如果没有足够的空间或缺乏基本工具，宁可暂缓。虽然不需要大型车间，但一个通风、整洁的区域是必需的。在将任何产品涂抹到主要表面之前，务必先在不显眼的地方进行测试，以观察木材的反应。如果家具有蛀虫，切记要彻底处理后才能进行修复，以防虫害扩散。请记住，修复不仅仅是重新上漆，更是要恢复其原有的韵味和精髓。
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, my 1st recommendation is to inform yourself well; it's not a task that should be taken lightly. Start by researching the style and the wood, as this is fundamental for choosing the right products and not damaging the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key; if there isn't adequate space or you don't have the basic tools, wait. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface, because you don't know how the wood will react. If the furniture has woodworm, don't try to restore it without 1st treating it thoroughly—you don't want it to spread. Remember that it's not just about painting, but about restoring its essence.

text_es: Hosting a birthday party sounds exciting, but if you want everything to be perfect, it's far more complex than you might imagine. First, you need to finalize the theme, budget, and guest list; if you want an intimate and cozy gathering, the list shouldn't be too long. The venue selection is crucial, as celebrating at home and renting a venue are completely different experiences, requiring careful planning. Next, food and drinks (don't forget to consider allergies) and decorations to set the mood must also be thoughtfully considered. To liven things up, you can prepare some games or activities, especially if children are attending, and soft background music can also add a lot to the party. I believe that thorough organization and planning will not only ensure guests have a good time but also allow the host to enjoy the party.
text_tgt_raw: 举办一场生日派对听起来令人兴奋，但若想一切尽善尽美，其复杂程度远超想象。首先，你得敲定主题、预算和宾客名单；如果想办得温馨私密，名单就不宜过长。场地选择至关重要，毕竟在家庆祝和租用场地是截然不同的体验，这需要周密的计划。接着，食物和饮品（别忘了考虑过敏情况）以及烘托氛围的装饰也必须用心考量。为了活跃气氛，可以准备一些游戏或活动，尤其是有小朋友参与时，轻柔的背景音乐也能为派对增色不少。我相信，周密的组织安排不仅能让宾客尽兴，也能让主人享受到派对的乐趣。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting task, although it isn't as simple as it seems if you want everything to turn out perfectly. 1st, you must decide on the theme, the budget, and the guest list, which shouldn't be excessively long if you're looking for something intimate. The choice of venue is key, as celebrating at home isn't the same as renting a space; this is something that requires planning. You also have to think about the food and drinks—don't forget allergies—as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain the attendees, it's a good idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children, and it doesn't hurt to consider some music to set the mood. Finally, I'm sure that good organization guarantees that the host can also enjoy the celebration.

text_es: The preparations for my 30th birthday party were an "Odyssey," far from as easy as I imagined! First, there was the guest list; how could I invite thirty people without feeling overwhelmed? Then came the venue problem: my house doesn't have a big garden, so I had to find a place that could accommodate everyone, and honestly, that was the trickiest part. A gathering of ten people and a party of thirty are completely different things, and I didn't want anyone to not have a comfortable seat. The catering was also a headache; I was torn between pizza and paella. In the end, I decided to go with a mix, hoping to satisfy everyone's tastes, although I'm not sure if it's the best option. But the most important thing is for everyone to have fun, right? That's what truly matters!
text_tgt_raw: 三十岁生日派对的筹备过程简直是一场“奥德赛”，远没有我想象的那么轻松！首先是宾客名单，要邀请三十人却不觉得吃力，这怎么可能？接着是场地问题：我家没有大花园，所以得找一个能容纳所有人的地方，老实说，这才是最棘手的部分。十个人的聚会和三十个人的派对完全是两码事，我可不想有人没有舒服的座位。餐饮方面也让人头疼，披萨和西班牙海鲜饭之间我犹豫不决。最后我决定来个混搭，希望能满足所有人的口味，虽然我也不确定这是否是最好的选择。不过，最重要的是大家玩得开心，不是吗？那才是真正重要的！
base_en: Planning my 30th birthday party was an odyssey—it wasn't easy at all! 1st, the guest list, who invites 30 people without breaking a sweat? Then, the venue: I don't have a huge garden, so I looked for a place with capacity for everyone; this is the most complicated part, honestly. A place for 10 isn't the same as one for 30. I didn't want anyone to be without a good seat. The catering wasn't simple either: I couldn't decide between pizza or paella. In the end, I opted for a mix to please everyone, although I'm not sure if it was the best idea. The important thing is that everyone has fun, right? That's what really matters!

text_es: Caring for indoor plants isn't as complicated as you might think, but it does require careful attention and some basic knowledge. The first thing to consider is light, because each plant has different light intensity requirements, so understanding the specific species' needs is crucial to avoid sunburn or poor growth. Watering is equally critical; there isn't a fixed pattern, as it depends on the plant type, pot size, and season, but generally, it's better to underwater than overwater. Furthermore, environmental humidity and temperature are also factors that cannot be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget to fertilize regularly in spring and summer to replenish the nutrients lacking in the potting soil.
text_tgt_raw: 打理室内植物并非想象中复杂，但确实需要细心和一些基础知识。首先要考虑的是光照，因为每种植物对光照强度要求不同，所以了解具体品种的需求至关重要，以免晒伤或生长不良。浇水也同样关键，这并非有固定模式，而是取决于植物种类、花盆大小及季节，通常情况下，宁可少浇也不要过量。此外，环境湿度和温度也是不可忽视的因素，尤其是对于热带植物而言。别忘了在春夏季节定期施肥，为它们补充盆土中缺乏的养分。
base_en: Caring for houseplants isn't as complicated as it seems, but it does require attention and basic knowledge. The 1st thing to consider is light; not all plants need the same intensity, so it's essential to research the specific needs of each species so they don't burn or fail to grow. Watering is also crucial: there isn't a fixed rule, as this depends on the type of plant, the size of the pot, and the season, but in general, it's better to water less than excessively. Furthermore—this is important—ambient humidity and temperature are factors that can't be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer, to provide them with the nutrients they don't find in the potting soil.

text_es: For me, caring for indoor plants is more than just a hobby; it's practically a life philosophy. I remember it wasn't easy at first; my first two plants, the poor little things, didn't survive three weeks because I knew nothing about their needs. Now, about five years later, my home has practically become a "mini jungle," and I have around twenty-something plants, each with its unique personality and temperament, and I swear, that's no exaggeration. If a plant isn't happy, it immediately "tells me" through its leaves, and of course, I always pay attention to those subtle changes to avoid bigger problems. It's actually not as complicated as it first seems; you just need to observe them carefully and give them a little love.
text_tgt_raw: 对我而言，照料室内植物不仅仅是一种爱好，它简直就是一种生活哲学。我记得最开始的时候，这并非易事，我最初的两盆植物，可怜的小东西们，都没活过三个星期，因为我对它们的需求一无所知。如今，大约五年过去，我的家简直成了一片“小丛林”，我养了大概二十多盆植物，每一盆都有它独特的个性和脾气，我发誓，这绝非夸张。如果哪一盆植物不开心了，它会立刻通过叶子“告诉我”，而我当然总是留意那些细微的变化，以避免出现更大的问题。这其实并没有一开始看起来那么复杂，你只需要用心观察它们，并给予它们一点爱。
base_en: Taking care of houseplants, for me, isn't just a hobby, it's almost a philosophy of life. I remember that at 1st, this wasn't easy; my 1st 2 plants, poor things, didn't survive more than 3 weeks because I didn't know anything about their needs. Now, after about 5 years, my house is a jungle; I've about 20 plants and each one has its own personality and its quirks, I swear, this isn't an exaggeration. If one isn't happy, it immediately "tells" me with its leaves, and I, of course, am always attentive to those small details so that there aren't bigger problems. It isn't as complicated as it seems at 1st, you just have to observe them and give them a little love.

text_es: When successfully caring for indoor plants, do not overcomplicate things at first. The core point is that they are not accustomed to outdoor environments, so providing a stable growing environment is crucial. This is very important: before buying each type of plant, be sure to research its two to three basic needs, such as light, watering, and temperature, because not all plants are the same. Avoid overwatering; this is often the primary reason plants die and is difficult to remedy afterward. I recommend touching the soil with your hand before watering to confirm if it is dry. Additionally, do not overlook environmental humidity; some plants have poor tolerance for high humidity, while for others, it is indispensable. I believe that by mastering these basic techniques, your plants will thrive and you will avoid many unnecessary problems.
text_tgt_raw: 成功养护室内植物，初期切勿过于复杂化。核心要点在于，它们不习惯室外环境，因此提供一个稳定的生长环境至关重要。这一点非常关键：在购买每种植物之前，务必研究其两到三个基本需求，例如光照、浇水和温度，因为并非所有植物都一样。切忌浇水过多，这通常是导致植物死亡的首要原因，且事后很难挽救。我建议在浇水前先用手触摸土壤，确认其是否干燥。此外，不要忽视环境湿度，有些植物对高湿度耐受性差，而另一些则不可或缺。我相信，只要掌握这些基本技巧，您的植物一定会茁壮成长，避免许多不必要的问题。
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, don't overcomplicate things at 1st. The fundamental thing is that they aren't used to the outdoors, so you have to give them a stable environment. This is crucial: research 2 or 3 basic needs of each plant you acquire—light, watering, temperature—because not all of them are the same. Don't overwater; it's the 1st cause of death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I advise you to touch the soil to check if it's dry before adding water. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it. I'm sure that with these basic tips, your plants will thrive, and you won't have problems.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is no small matter; it directly impacts our sleep quality and even our physical health. Among the many factors to consider, firmness is paramount because everyone's preferences and needs are different: some prefer firm support, while others favor soft comfort. Material selection is equally important: the market offers various types such as spring, memory foam, latex, or multi-material combinations, each with vastly different support and breathability. Furthermore, our sleeping position is also key, as back sleepers and side sleepers have different mattress requirements; if sleeping with a partner, it's even more important to consider both people's feelings. Finally, personally trying out mattresses in a physical store is especially necessary, because only by experiencing it firsthand can you truly know if a mattress is right for you.
text_tgt_raw: 挑选床垫绝非小事，它直接关乎我们的睡眠质量乃至身体健康。在众多考量因素中，硬度首当其冲，因为每个人的偏好和需求不尽相同，有人喜欢硬朗支撑，有人则钟情柔软舒适。材质选择同样重要：市面上有弹簧、记忆棉、乳胶或多材质组合等多种类型，它们各自的支撑感和透气性大相径庭。此外，我们的睡姿也是关键，仰卧和侧卧对床垫的要求不同；如果与伴侣同睡，更要兼顾双方的感受。最后，亲身试躺在实体店里显得尤为必要，因为只有亲自体验，才能真正了解床垫是否适合自己。
base_en: Choosing a mattress isn't a decision that should be taken lightly, as it directly affects the quality of our rest and, therefore, our health. It's essential to consider several factors, such as the type of firmness, which isn't the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. Also, we can't forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of them, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Furthermore, it's important to consider our sleeping position—sleeping on your back isn't the same as sleeping on your side—and if we share the bed, since it's not always easy to please 2 people. Finally, we shouldn't underestimate the importance of trying the mattress for a few minutes in the store; you don't know how you'll feel until you try it.

text_es: You can't be careless when buying a mattress; it's not a small expense, as it directly relates to our sleep quality. There are many types of mattresses on the market, and not all of them are suitable for you, so be sure to consider many factors when choosing. Remember, the most expensive doesn't necessarily mean the best; the key is to find what best meets your personal needs. First, consider your sleeping position. Whether you sleep on your side, back, or stomach, different sleeping positions require vastly different levels of mattress support, which is an important factor in determining comfort. When trying out mattresses in the store, you should lie down for at least 10 to 15 minutes to personally experience whether it's truly comfortable. Furthermore, the firmness of the mattress cannot be ignored; it's not that softer or firmer is better, but rather that what suits you is the best choice.
text_tgt_raw: 选购床垫可不能马虎，这可不是一笔小开销，毕竟它直接关系到我们的睡眠质量。市面上的床垫种类繁多，并非所有都适合你，因此在挑选时务必多方考量。记住，最贵的并不意味着最好，关键在于找到最符合你个人需求的。首先要考虑自己的睡姿，无论是侧卧、仰卧还是俯卧，不同的睡姿对床垫的支撑力要求截然不同，这是决定舒适度的重要因素。在店里试躺时，至少要花上10到15分钟，亲身体验才能判断是否真正舒适。此外，床垫的软硬度也不容忽视，并非越软或越硬就越好，适合自己的才是最佳选择。
base_en: When you go to choose a mattress, don't rush; it's not just any purchase. Several factors must be considered, since not all mattresses are the same, and this is fundamental for your rest. You don't have to buy the most expensive one, look for the one that best suits your specific needs. Think about your sleeping position—if you're on your side, back, or stomach—because that's key for the support you need. Don't forget to try it for about 10 to 15 minutes in the store; truly, there's no better way to know if you'll feel comfortable. Also, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, since the softest or hardest isn't always ideal.

text_es: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainable development; it not only benefits the environment but also brings positive economic returns. This is not a trivial issue, as one-third of the food produced globally each year is lost or wasted, which is alarming, especially considering that many people still do not have access to enough food. We cannot ignore that food production consumes large amounts of resources like water and energy, and food waste signifies inefficiency throughout the entire supply chain. Although there is no one-size-fits-all solution, we can start by better planning our purchases, properly storing food, and utilizing leftovers, which is not as complicated as it might seem. Raising awareness across society about this global challenge is essential; we can no longer afford this unsustainable consumption pattern.
text_tgt_raw: 减少食物浪费对可持续发展至关重要，它不仅有利环保，更能带来积极的经济效益。这不是一个微不足道的问题，因为全球每年生产的食物有三分之一被损失或浪费，令人警醒，特别是考虑到仍有许多人无法获得足够的食物。我们不能忽视食物生产消耗大量水和能源等资源，而食物浪费则意味着整个供应链的低效。尽管没有一劳永逸的解决方案，但我们可以从更好地规划购买、妥善储存食物和利用剩饭剩菜入手，这并没有想象中那么复杂。提高全社会对这一全球性挑战的认识至关重要，我们不能再承受这种不可持续的消费模式了。
base_en: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainability; it not only benefits the environment but also has a positive economic impact. It isn't a minor problem, as 1/3 of all food produced globally is lost or wasted annually. This is alarming if we consider that many people don't have access to adequate food. We can't ignore that food production consumes large quantities of resources like water and energy, and its waste implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There isn't a single solution, but we can start by better planning purchases, properly storing food, and utilizing leftovers; it isn't as complicated as it seems. It's important to raise awareness in society about this global challenge; we can't afford to continue with this unsustainable consumption rate.

text_es: A few days ago, while preparing dinner for four people, I suddenly realized how much food we would waste if I didn't change my habits. It wasn't until that moment that I truly understood what reducing waste meant. Before, I didn't pay much attention to leftovers, thinking it wasn't a big deal or that serious. However, now I see things completely differently. I decided I couldn't maintain that attitude anymore, so I started planning each meal more carefully and creatively using leftovers, which is indeed something everyone should do. For example, instead of throwing away the leftover roast chicken from the day before, I made delicious croquettes with it the next day, and I was very proud of my "invention"! Honestly, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as one might imagine, and the Earth will thank us for it.
text_tgt_raw: 前几天给四个人准备晚餐时，我突然意识到，如果我不改变习惯，我们会有多少食物被浪费掉。直到那一刻，我才真正明白减少浪费意味着什么。以前，我对剩饭剩菜并不太在意，觉得那不是什么大问题，也没那么严重。然而，现在我完全不这么看了。我决定不能再抱持那种态度，于是开始更精心地计划每餐，并且对剩菜进行创新利用，这确实是我们每个人都应该做的。例如，前一天吃剩的烤鸡，我没有扔掉，而是第二天做成了美味的炸丸子，我对自己这项“发明”感到非常自豪！说真的，减少食物浪费并没有想象中那么困难，地球也会因此感谢我们的。
base_en: The other day, preparing dinner for 4 people, I realized how much food we were going to throw away if I didn't change my habits. I didn't realize until that moment what reducing waste really means. Before, I didn't care too much if there was something left over; I thought that wasn't a problem, that it isn't something so serious. However, now I don't see it that way. I decided I couldn't continue with that attitude, so I started to plan meals better and to be more creative with leftovers; that's something we should all do. For example, with the roasted chicken from one day, I didn't throw away what was left, but instead I made some delicious croquettes the next day; I'm very proud of that invention! Really, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as it seems, and the planet is going to thank us for it.

text_es: To reduce food waste, careful planning is essential: it's not as hard as it sounds, and the benefits are huge. Before shopping, be sure to thoroughly check your refrigerator and pantry; this effectively prevents duplicate purchases and allows you to make a list of truly needed items, which is key to controlling expenses. At the supermarket, don't get carried away by promotions for items you won't be able to use up; remember, a larger quantity isn't necessarily a better option if you can't consume it all in the end. After returning home, organize your food properly, placing older items or those nearing their expiration date in more accessible locations to prevent them from spoiling. Finally, never casually discard leftovers; with a little imagination, yesterday's food can be given new life and will never be boring.
text_tgt_raw: 为了减少食物浪费，周密的计划至关重要：这并非听起来那么困难，而且益处巨大。购物前务必彻底检查冰箱和储藏室，这样能有效避免重复购买，并列出真正所需的物品清单，这是控制开支的关键。在超市时，不要被那些你根本用不完的促销活动冲昏头脑，记住，如果最终不能全部消耗掉，再大份的商品也未必是更好的选择。回到家后，合理整理食物，将较旧的或临近保质期的产品放在更容易取用的位置，以防它们变质。最后，千万不要随意丢弃剩饭剩菜；只要发挥一点想象力，昨天的食物也能焕发新生命，绝不会乏味。
base_en: To reduce food waste, good planning is essential: it isn't as difficult as it seems, and the benefit is enormous. Before going shopping, thoroughly check the refrigerator and pantry—that way you'll avoid duplicate purchases—and make a list of what you really need; this is key to not overspending. When you're at the supermarket, don't get carried away by offers that you won't fully use, and remember that bigger isn't always better if you don't consume it later. At home, organize food so that older products or those with closer expiration dates are more accessible—you don't want them to spoil. Finally, don't throw away leftovers; yesterday's food doesn't have to be boring if you give it new life with a little imagination.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is not as complicated as many people imagine; instead, it is a very rewarding experience. Many people might be deterred by fear, mistakenly believing they can't learn, but there is never an age limit to mastering this important skill. Many sports centers offer specialized adult swimming classes, which typically focus on helping students overcome their fear of water and teach basic techniques, so the learning process is never solitary. The most crucial thing is to maintain a calm mindset and learn progressively in a stress-free environment, which is essential for building confidence. You are definitely not alone on this journey; many adults share the same goal and usually gain a great sense of accomplishment from it. Swimming can not only improve physical condition but also bring a great sense of security and freedom in the water.
text_tgt_raw: 作为成年人学习游泳，并非如许多人想象的那么复杂，而是一个极具回报的体验。不少人可能因为恐惧而望而却步，误以为自己学不会，但掌握这项重要技能从来没有年龄限制。许多体育中心都提供专门的成人游泳课程，这些课程通常侧重于帮助学员克服对水的恐惧，并从基础技巧教起，所以学习过程绝非孤单一人。最关键的是要保持平和的心态，在没有压力的环境下循序渐进地学习，这对于建立自信至关重要。在这条路上你绝不孤单，许多成年人都有着相同的目标，并且通常都能从中获得巨大的成就感。游泳不仅能改善身体状况，更能带来在水中极大的安全感和自由。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding experience that, truly, isn't as complicated as some people think. Many people feel intimidated, believing they can't do it, but there's no age limit to acquiring this vital skill. There are many sports centers that offer specific classes for adults, focused on overcoming the fear of water and teaching basic techniques; it doesn't have to be a solitary process. The important thing is to start calmly, without pressure; this is fundamental for building confidence. You're not alone in this, many adults share this goal, and progress is usually gratifying. It's a skill that not only improves physical condition but also offers a great sense of security and freedom in the water.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is truly a unique experience, and I'm sure it feels completely different from learning as a child! I used to think it was impossible for me to learn in this lifetime, that it was too late. But in the summer when I was 35, I impulsively signed up for a swimming class, and to be honest, the process wasn't easy. At first, I was very afraid of deep water and couldn't relax at all in the water. Fortunately, my coach was very patient and always encouraged me, saying, "Don't rush, take your time." Now, I can say that I can swim freely, and I don't regret my decision at all; it's an invaluable sense of freedom. So, if you're also thinking about learning to swim, please don't hesitate, it's definitely worth it!
text_tgt_raw: 成年后学游泳真是一段独特的经历，这和儿时学游泳的感觉是完全不同的，我敢肯定！我以前总觉得这辈子不可能学会了，已经太晚了。但35岁那年夏天，我心血来潮报了一个游泳班，说实话，过程并不轻松。起初，我非常害怕深水，在水里根本无法放松。幸运的是，我的教练非常有耐心，总是鼓励我：“别着急，慢慢来。”现在，我可以说我已经能够自如地游泳了，一点也不后悔当初的决定，这是一种无价的自由感。所以，如果你也有学游泳的想法，请不要犹豫，这绝对是值得的！
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a peculiar experience; it's not the same as when you're a child, I assure you of that! I always thought it wouldn't be for me, that it was already too late. But one summer, at 35 years old, I decided to sign up for a course, and it wasn't easy, I won't lie. At 1st, I was terrified of the depth, and I couldn't relax in the water. My instructor, however, was very patient, and always told me, "There's no rush, little by little." Now I can say that I swim with a certain ease, and I don't regret having done it; it's a priceless feeling of freedom. So, if you're thinking of learning, don't hesitate, this is something that's worth it!

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is undoubtedly a fulfilling and liberating experience, and it's never too late! First, finding an experienced instructor is crucial, especially one who specializes in teaching adults, because adults and children learn very differently. Please don't put too much pressure on yourself; there's no need to expect to become an Olympic swimmer overnight. Give yourself enough time to get comfortable in the water. There's absolutely no need to feel ashamed about using aids like kickboards or pull buoys in the beginning, as these are very helpful for building confidence. Persistence and overcoming fear are the keys to success: it's not impossible! I believe that as long as you are patient enough with yourself, you will definitely master this skill.
text_tgt_raw: 成年后学习游泳，无疑是一次充实而解放身心的体验，永远都不算晚！首先，找一位经验丰富的教练至关重要，特别是那些擅长教授成年人的，因为成年人和儿童的学习方式大相径庭。请不要给自己太大压力，不必奢望一夜之间成为奥运选手；给自己足够的时间去适应水性。初期使用浮板或浮条等辅助工具，完全不必感到羞耻，这些对建立信心非常有益。持之以恒和克服恐惧是成功的关键所在：这并非不可能！我相信只要您对自己有足够的耐心，一定能够掌握这项技能。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is an enriching and liberating experience; it's not too late to start! The 1st thing is to find a good instructor with experience teaching adults, as it's not the same as with children. Don't pressure yourself; you don't have to be an Olympic swimmer overnight; take your time to get used to the water. There's no need to be ashamed of using aids like kickboards or pool noodles at 1st—this is very useful—they'll give you confidence. The key is consistency and overcoming fear: it's not impossible! I'm sure you'll achieve it if you're patient with yourself!

text_es: Painting a room isn't difficult if it's organized properly. First, the walls must be thoroughly prepared, and while this is often not fun, it's crucial: clean the walls, repair all holes or cracks, and sand them if necessary. Remember to protect the floor and furniture with plastic sheeting or canvas, which effectively prevents paint splatters. Next, we choose the appropriate paint and tools; rollers and brushes each have their uses, especially when dealing with edges. Usually, two to three coats of paint are needed, and sufficient drying time must be allowed between each coat, which is key to achieving the desired results. I believe the final outcome will be satisfying, as it will give the entire space a fresh new look.
text_tgt_raw: 如果组织得当，粉刷房间并非难事。首先，必须彻底准备墙面，虽然这通常不那么有趣，但至关重要：要清洁墙壁，修补好所有孔洞或裂缝，必要时还要进行打磨。切记要用塑料布或帆布保护好地板和家具，这能有效避免油漆飞溅。接着，我们选择合适的油漆和工具，滚筒和刷子各有用途，特别是在处理边缘时。通常需要涂刷两到三层油漆，每层之间都要留出充足的干燥时间，这是获得理想效果的关键。我相信最终的成果会令人满意，因为这能让整个空间焕然一新。
base_en: Painting a room isn't a complicated task if one organizes well. 1st, you have to prepare the surface, which isn't always fun, but it's essential: clean the walls, patch holes or cracks, and sand if necessary. You mustn't forget to protect the floor and furniture with tarps or plastic; this is crucial to avoid stains. Then, we select the appropriate paint and tools; using a roller isn't the same as using a brush for the edges. Normally, 2, or 3 coats of paint are applied, allowing drying time between each one—that's fundamental for a good finish. I'm sure the final result is gratifying, as it gives the space a completely new feel.

text_es: Last week I had to paint the guest room, which is by no means my favorite pastime. I really didn't like the previous color, which was a terrible pistachio green, so I decided to change it to light blue. To be honest, the painting itself wasn't difficult, but moving the furniture was torture for me; it would have been impossible without help! I bought 15 liters of paint and 3 rollers, thinking that would be enough. I'm very happy with the final result; the room looks brand new and completely different from before, and you should know I'm no expert! However, my back isn't too happy right now.
text_tgt_raw: 上周我不得不粉刷客房，这绝不是我最喜欢的消遣。我实在不喜欢之前的颜色，那是一种可怕的开心果绿，所以我决定把它改成浅蓝色。老实说，粉刷本身并不难，但搬家具对我来说简直是折磨，没有帮手根本没法完成！我买了15升油漆和3个滚筒，心想应该足够了。我对最终效果非常满意，房间看起来焕然一新，完全不像以前了，要知道我可不是什么专家！不过，我的背部现在可不怎么高兴。
base_en: It's not my favorite pastime, but last week I had to paint the guest room. I didn't like the previous color at all—it was a horrible pistachio green—so I decided to change it to a light blue. That wasn't hard, honestly, but moving the furniture was a torment for me; there's no way to do it without help! I bought 15 liters of paint and 3 rollers, thinking I wouldn't need more. I'm very proud of the final result, it doesn't look like the same room, and I'm not even an expert! My back, on the other hand, isn't so happy.
