The key to success lies in personal and intrinsic motivation and in maintaining a positive attitude toward mistakes—an inherent part of the process—considering them learning opportunities. With 15% of the world's population speaking more than 1 language, it's a valuable skill.

text_es: I clearly remember my first attempt at learning Japanese five years ago. It was, and still is, a real challenge, after all, the Japanese writing system is completely different from ours. Initially, memorizing hiragana and katakana was torture; each system has forty-six basic characters, and at the time, I felt like I would never learn them. Every day I would dedicate at least an hour to reviewing, using flashcards to aid memorization, and trying to watch anime without subtitles, which was indeed a very effective learning strategy. The frustration during the learning process was real, but every time I could understand a simple conversation, even just one sentence, that sense of satisfaction motivated me to keep going. Now, after years of effort, although I'm still on the learning journey, I can have basic daily conversations and read manga. This has definitely been a very enriching life experience, and I sincerely recommend it to everyone.
text_tgt_raw: 我清晰地记得五年前第一次尝试学习日语的经历。那真是一项挑战，至今仍是，毕竟日语的书写系统与我们的截然不同。起初，记忆平假名和片假名简直是煎熬，每个系统都有四十六个基本字符，当时我觉得自己永远也学不会。每天我都会投入至少一个小时复习，用闪卡辅助记忆，并尝试观看无字幕动画，这确实是一个非常有效的学习策略。学习过程中的挫败感是真实的，但每当能听懂一句简单的对话，哪怕只是一句话，那种满足感都激励着我坚持下去。现在，经过这些年的努力，虽然还在学习的路上，我已经能进行基本的日常交流，也能阅读漫画了。这绝对是一次非常丰富的人生体验，我真心向大家推荐。
base_en: I vividly remember the 1st time I tried to learn Japanese—5 years ago now. It was a challenge—it still is—because the writing system is completely different from ours. At 1st, memorizing hiragana and katakana was torture—I thought I'd never succeed—with their 46 basic characters each. Every day I dedicated 1 hour—or even more—to reviewing, using flashcards and watching anime without subtitles—a good strategy. The frustration was real, but the satisfaction of understanding a sentence—even if it was simple—drove me to continue. Now, after so much effort—and still in process—I can hold basic conversations and read manga. It has been an enriching experience—and one I recommend to everyone.

text_es: Learning a new language is undoubtedly a rewarding challenge, and immersive learning is key to success. First, completely immerse yourself in the language environment by listening to music or podcasts, which you can play even while doing other things, and watching original TV shows and movies (with subtitles initially); this will gradually accustom your ears to the pronunciation and intonation of the new language. Practice consistently every day, even if only for ten to fifteen minutes, and try to speak from day one. Don't be afraid to make mistakes, as errors are part of the learning process. If your budget allows, find a language partner or teacher who can correct your mistakes promptly and offer encouragement. In the beginning, don't get too hung up on grammar; fluency is far more important than perfect grammar, and the focus should be on effective communication and understanding basic content. At the same time, when expanding your vocabulary, prioritize learning common and practical words and phrases used in daily life. Persistence and patience will be your best companions on this exciting journey.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言，无疑是一项充满回报的挑战，而沉浸式学习是成功的关键。首先，让自己完全置身于语言环境中，比如听音乐或播客，即使在做其他事情时也可以播放，以及观看原版影视剧（初期可带字幕），这样能让耳朵逐渐适应新语言的发音和语调。每天坚持练习，哪怕只有短短的十到十五分钟，也要从第一天起就尝试开口说，不要害怕犯错，因为错误本身就是学习过程的一部分。如果预算允许，找一位语伴或老师，他们能及时纠正你的错误并给予鼓励。初期不必过于纠结语法，流利度远比完美语法重要，重点应放在有效沟通和理解基本内容上。同时，扩充词汇量时，要优先学习日常生活中常用且实用的词语和短语。在这段激动人心的旅程中，持之以恒和耐心将是你最好的伙伴。
base_en: To learn a new language—a rewarding challenge—immersion is key. Start by surrounding yourself with the language, listening to music or podcasts—even while doing other things—and watching series or movies in their original version—with subtitles at 1st—to get your ear accustomed to the sounds and intonation. Practice daily—even if it's 10 or 15 minutes—trying to speak from day 1, without fear of making mistakes—they're part of the learning process. Find an exchange partner or a teacher—if your budget allows—who can correct and motivate you. Don't obsess over grammar at 1st—fluency comes 1st—; focus on communicating and understanding the essentials, expanding your vocabulary with useful words and phrases for your daily life—prioritize what you'll use. Consistency and patience are your best allies on this exciting journey.

text_es: Participating in a popular running event, whether a full or half marathon, means being part of a mass sporting spectacle open to runners of all levels. These races are typically held in cities and feature fixed distances such as 5K, 10K, 21K (half marathon), or 42K (full marathon). Beyond the competition itself, their main appeal lies in the sense of collective participation and the strong festive atmosphere. From experienced athletes to first-time novices, participants prepare diligently for months in advance according to specialized training plans to improve endurance and avoid injury. Registration usually includes a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and services at aid stations along the route. Completing a mass participation race, especially for the first time, is a great affirmation of personal perseverance and often inspires people to pursue a more active and healthy lifestyle. Many runners also use these events to raise funds for charity out of a desire to give back to the community.
text_tgt_raw: 参加一项广受欢迎的跑步赛事，无论是全程马拉松还是半程马拉松，都意味着置身于一场全民体育盛会，向所有水平的跑者开放。这类比赛通常在城市举行，设有5公里、10公里、21公里（半程马拉松）或42公里（全程马拉松）等固定距离。除了竞技本身，其主要吸引力在于集体参与感和浓厚的节日氛围。从经验丰富的运动员到初次尝试的新手，参赛者们会提前数月，按照专门的训练计划刻苦备战，以提高耐力并避免受伤。报名通常会包含一块带有计时芯片的号码布、一件纪念T恤以及沿途补给站的服务。跑完一场大众赛事，尤其是第一次，是对个人毅力的极大肯定，往往能激励人们追求更积极健康的生活方式。许多跑者还会出于公益之心，利用这些活动为慈善事业募集善款。
base_en: Running a popular race—also known as a marathon or half marathon—involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all skill levels. These events—often urban—have predefined distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), or 42 km (marathon), and their main appeal—beyond the competition—is the collective experience and festive atmosphere. Participants—from experienced athletes to beginners—prepare months in advance, following specific training plans to improve their endurance and avoid injuries. Registration usually includes a bib number—with a timing chip—a commemorative t-shirt, and access to aid stations along the route. Finishing a popular race—especially the 1st one—is a significant personal achievement that often promotes a more active and healthy lifestyle. Many runners—motivated by solidarity—use these events to raise funds for charitable causes.

text_es: Participating in that popular running race for the first time was an unexpected challenge for me, even though I had always longed for such an experience. I only registered three weeks in advance, and I usually just ran casually, so I hadn't really prepared at all. To be honest, I greatly underestimated the difficulty of the race. Race day was a sunny spring Sunday, and the atmosphere was lively, with cheering crowds everywhere. At first, everything went smoothly, and I felt the power of the collective, but around the five-kilometer mark, my legs started to give out, and my calves burned. I remember really wanting to give up then because I was so tired, but seeing the support of other runners and spectators, I regained the motivation to keep going. In the end, I crossed the finish line, which was a huge personal achievement for me, and although I was exhausted, that immense sense of satisfaction still lingers in my heart to this day.
text_tgt_raw: 第一次参加那种备受欢迎的跑步比赛，对我来说是一次意想不到的挑战，尽管我一直都渴望有这样的经历。我只提前三周报名，平时也只是随便跑跑步，根本没怎么准备，说实话，我大大低估了比赛的难度。比赛那天是个阳光明媚的春天周日，现场气氛热烈，到处都是加油助威的人群。起初一切顺利，我感受到了集体的力量，但大约跑到五公里处，我的腿就开始不听使唤了，小腿火辣辣地疼。我记得当时真想放弃，因为实在太累了，但看到其他跑者和观众的支持，我又重新获得了坚持下去的动力。最终，我冲过了终点线，那对我而言是一次巨大的个人成就，虽然精疲力尽，但那种巨大的满足感至今仍然萦绕心头。
base_en: The 1st time I decided to run a popular race—an experience I always wanted to have—it was an unexpected challenge. I signed up 3 weeks before, without much preparation—just a little daily jogging—and the truth is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day—a sunny spring Sunday—the atmosphere was electrifying, with people cheering everywhere. At 1st everything went well—I felt the group's energy—but around km 5 my legs started to give out—my calves were burning. I remember thinking about quitting—I was exhausted—but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line—a personal achievement—exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today.

text_es: If you're new to the fun world of mass participation running events, thorough preparation is crucial to fully enjoy the experience. First, be sure to train gradually, never rushing or putting unnecessary pressure on yourself, and slowly increase your running distance and intensity to avoid injuries, as inadequate preparation easily leads to them. Regarding diet, pay special attention to balanced nutrition, which is like fueling your body with essential energy; at the same time, staying well-hydrated is key, so be sure to drink plenty of water before, during, and after your run. Choose a pair of well-fitting and functional running shoes, as this investment is absolutely worthwhile; wear comfortable clothing that allows for free movement. During the race, maintain a steady pace, don't sprint too fast at the start, and always listen to your body's feedback, never overexerting yourself. Enjoy the race atmosphere, cherish every mile you run, and remember, the finish line is often just a new beginning!
text_tgt_raw: 如果你初涉大众跑步赛事这个充满乐趣的领域，充分准备至关重要，方能尽情享受。首先，务必循序渐进地训练，切勿急于求成或施加不必要的压力，逐渐增加跑步的距离和强度，以避免受伤，因为准备不充分极易导致伤病。饮食方面，需特别注意均衡营养，这如同为身体补充必不可少的燃料；同时，保持良好水分是关键，务必在跑前、跑中和跑后充分饮水。选择一双合脚且功能性强的跑鞋，这笔投资绝对物有所值；穿着舒适的服装，确保肢体活动自如。比赛过程中，保持匀速，不要一开始就冲刺过快，并时刻倾听身体的反馈，切勿过度透支体力。尽情享受比赛的氛围，珍惜跑过的每一公里，请记住，终点线往往只是新的开始！
base_en: If you're starting in the world of popular races—a rewarding experience—it's essential to prepare properly to enjoy it to the fullest. Start with gradual training—without haste or unnecessary pressure—progressively increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries—something very common if you're not careful. It's crucial to take care of your diet—essential fuel for your body—and ensure good hydration—drink water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate footwear—the investment is worth it—and comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. During the race, maintain a consistent pace—don't start too fast—and listen to your body, without overexerting yourself. Enjoy the atmosphere and every kilometer covered—the finish line is just the beginning!

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a task that is both meticulous and rewarding, with its core being to revive its former glory without altering its historical essence. This work requires immense patience and expertise. First, a comprehensive assessment of the furniture's condition must be conducted, carefully checking for issues such as structural damage, insect infestation, or surface aging. Subsequently, a thorough cleaning is performed to remove years of accumulated dirt and old paint layers, revealing the wood's original appearance. Structural repair is crucial for ensuring the furniture's stability, such as gluing loose mortise and tenon joints or replacing damaged parts. Finally, based on the furniture's age and style, a new protective layer is applied, which can be shellac, beeswax, or oil-based paint, both protecting the furniture and enhancing its aesthetic appeal. Through this series of processes, this piece of furniture, which has witnessed history, can continue to tell its story and be passed down.
text_tgt_raw: 修复古董家具是一项既细致又充满成就感的任务，其核心在于在不改变其历史本质的前提下，使其重现昔日的光彩。这项工作需要极大的耐心和专业知识。首先，要对家具的状况进行全面评估，仔细检查是否有结构性损伤、虫蛀或表面老化等问题。随后，进行彻底的清洁，去除积年累月的污垢和旧漆层，以显露出木材的原貌。结构性修复是确保家具稳固的关键，例如粘合松动的榫卯或替换破损的部件。最后，根据家具的年代和风格，涂覆新的保护层，这可以是虫胶、蜂蜡或油性漆，既能保护家具，又能提升其美感。通过这一系列过程，这件见证了历史的家具得以继续讲述它的故事，流传下去。
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture—a meticulous and rewarding task—involves a process that seeks to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. This work—which requires patience and knowledge—begins with a thorough evaluation of the piece's condition—identifying structural damage, woodworm, or deterioration in the finish. Subsequently, cleaning proceeds—removing layers of dirt or old varnishes—to reveal the original wood. Structural repairs—such as gluing joints or replacing broken parts—are fundamental to ensuring the furniture's stability. Finally, a new finish is applied—respecting the era and style—which can be shellac, wax, or oil-based, protecting it and enhancing its beauty, thus allowing the furniture—a witness to the past—to continue telling its story for many more years.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding project. First, be sure to thoroughly clean the surface using a specialized wood cleaner. Next, carefully assess the furniture's condition to identify any damage such as cracks or woodworm. If woodworm holes are found, it is essential to inject an anti-woodworm agent, which is crucial for the furniture's long-term preservation. Afterward, patiently sand along the wood grain, gradually using finer sandpaper until the surface is smooth. Once everything is ready, apply the final protective material—whether wax, varnish, or paint—according to the desired style, following the manufacturer's instructions, and allow it to dry completely. You will enjoy the entire restoration process and ultimately have a revitalized piece of furniture!
text_tgt_raw: 修复一件古董家具是项回报丰厚的工程。首先，务必使用专用木材清洁剂彻底清洁表面。接着，仔细评估家具状况，找出裂缝或蛀虫等损坏。如果发现蛀虫孔，务必注射防蛀剂，这对于家具的长期保存至关重要。随后，用砂纸顺着木纹方向耐心打磨，逐渐使用更细的砂纸，直至表面光滑。待一切准备就绪，根据所需的风格，涂上最后一层保护材料，无论是蜡、清漆还是油漆，都请遵循制造商的说明，并让其完全干燥。您将享受整个修复过程，并最终拥有一件焕然一新的家具！
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture—a rewarding project—start by thoroughly cleaning the surface—use specific wood products. Then, assess the condition of the piece—identify damage such as cracks or woodworm. If there are woodworm holes, inject an anti-woodworm product—it's vital for the furniture's longevity. Afterward, sand the wood patiently and in the direction of the grain—use progressively finer grit sandpaper. Once ready, apply the final coat—wax, varnish, or paint, depending on the desired style—and let it dry completely—follow the manufacturer's instructions. You'll enjoy the process and your renewed piece!

text_es: Hosting a memorable birthday party requires meticulous planning and thorough consideration. First, determining the date and time of the party is crucial, as they directly impact guest attendance. Ideally, the approximate number of guests should be determined and invitations sent out three to four weeks in advance. Second, choosing a venue is a fundamental step; whether you choose to host it at home or rent a professional venue, it must be decided based on your budget, which is an aspect that needs careful weighing. Additionally, the party's theme (if one is set) and corresponding decoration style need to be clear, and the menu must also be carefully designed, not to mention the birthday cake and drinks. Don't forget the music, which is a key element in creating the party atmosphere. If conditions allow, you can also prepare some small activities or games to entertain guests, ensuring everyone can fully enjoy themselves, which is the ultimate goal of a birthday party.
text_tgt_raw: 举办一场令人难忘的生日派对，需要细致的规划和周全的考虑。首先，确定派对的日期和时间至关重要，它们直接影响宾客的出席率。理想情况下，应提前三到四周确定好大致的宾客数量并发出邀请。其次，场地的选择是一个基本步骤，无论是选择在家中举办还是租赁专业场地，都必须根据预算来决定，这是需要认真权衡的一个方面。此外，派对的主题（如果设定的话）以及相应的装饰风格也需要明确，同时还要精心设计菜单，当然少不了生日蛋糕和饮品。别忘了音乐，它是营造派对氛围的关键元素。如果条件允许，还可以准备一些小活动或游戏来招待宾客，确保每个人都能尽情享受，这才是生日派对的最终目的。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party—a memorable event for many—requires planning and attention to detail. Initially, the date and time must be set—crucial factors for attendance—and the number of guests decided—ideally, 3, or 4 weeks in advance to send out invitations. The choice of venue—whether at home or a rented space—is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget—an aspect to consider seriously. Additionally, the theme—if there's one—and the decoration must be defined, as well as the menu—including the cake, of course—and the drinks. Don't forget the music—a key element for the atmosphere—and, if desired, activities, or games to entertain attendees, ensuring everyone enjoys themselves to the fullest—the main goal of the celebration.

text_es: Preparing for my sister's tenth birthday party was truly an unexpected experience. I first made a guest list of fifteen children, then fully dedicated myself to the party decorations. I bought colorful balloons, some helium-filled and some regular, and also various ribbons. The biggest challenge was the cake; she insisted on a three-tiered cake, which I had to order two weeks in advance. The day of the party was a sunny Saturday, and everything was perfect. The children had a great time, their laughter never ceased, and the food like pizza, sandwiches, and various desserts was also very popular. Seeing the happy smile on my sister's face, I felt all the effort was well worth it.
text_tgt_raw: 为我妹妹筹备她的十岁生日派对，真是一次意想不到的经历。我先列了十五个小朋友的宾客名单，然后全身心投入到派对的装饰上。我买了五颜六色的气球，有充氦气的，也有普通的，还买了各种彩带。最大的挑战是蛋糕，她坚持要一个三层蛋糕，我不得不提前两周预订。派对当天是个阳光明媚的星期六，一切都完美无缺。孩子们玩得很开心，欢声笑语不断，披萨、三明治和各式甜点等食物也大受欢迎。看到妹妹脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容，我觉得所有的努力都非常值得。
base_en: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party—she was turning 10—was an unexpected adventure. I started with a guest list—a total of 15 children—and then I dedicated myself to the decorations. I bought colorful balloons—many, helium, and regular—and garlands. The biggest complication was the cake—she wanted a 3-tier cake—since I had to order it 2 weeks in advance. On the day of the party—a sunny Saturday—everything went perfectly. There were games, laughter, and the food—pizzas, sandwiches, and many sweets—was a total success. Seeing my sister's happy face—her smile was worth all the effort—made every detail worthwhile.

text_es: To plan an unforgettable birthday party, it's crucial to start preparing two to three weeks in advance. First, establishing a budget is fundamental, and simultaneously determining the number of guests is a key factor. Next, choose the party venue, whether it's at home, a rented space, or outdoors, and finalize the date and time, making sure to consider the convenience of most guests. Don't forget the party theme (if desired), food types (accommodating different tastes), and beverage supply. Be sure to send out invitations in advance so guests can confirm their attendance, and prepare a list of activities or games, especially if children will be attending. After careful preparation, on the day of the party, you can relax and fully enjoy this wonderful moment.
text_tgt_raw: 要策划一场令人难忘的生日派对，提前两到三周开始准备至关重要。首先，明确预算是基础，同时确定来宾人数，这是关键因素。接下来，选择派对场地，无论是在家、租赁场所还是户外，并敲定日期和时间，务必考虑大多数宾客的便利。别忘了派对主题（如果需要）、食物种类（兼顾不同口味）和饮品供应。务必提前发出邀请函，以便宾客确认出席，并准备好活动或游戏清单，尤其是有小朋友参加的情况。经过精心准备后，派对当天你就可以放松心情，尽情享受这美妙的时刻了。
base_en: To organize a birthday party—a memorable event—it's crucial to start 2 or 3 weeks in advance. 1st, define the budget—the basis of everything—and the number of guests—a key factor. Then, choose the venue—at home, a rented place, or outdoors—and the date and time—considering the availability of most. Don't forget the theme—if you want one—the food—think of options for everyone—and the drinks. Send out invitations in advance—so they can confirm attendance—and prepare a list of activities or games—especially if there are children. Finally, relax, and enjoy the day—after so much work.

text_es: I've never been very good at gardening, but since moving into my new, brighter apartment, I've unexpectedly fallen in love with the joy of caring for houseplants. I started with a resilient pothos, and before I knew it, my small balcony was filled with green plants. Watering, pruning, and occasionally fertilizing—these seemingly simple daily tasks bring an incredible sense of peace and satisfaction. Every morning, the first thing I do, even before drinking coffee, is check on my "little ones." I've found that with them, my home's previously somewhat monotonous atmosphere has become vibrant, and even the air feels fresher. I now have a total of seven plants and am even considering adding one or two more, perhaps a fiddle-leaf fig.
text_tgt_raw: 我一直以来园艺方面都不太擅长，但自从搬进现在光线更充足的新公寓后，我意外地爱上了照料室内植物的乐趣。我从一盆生命力顽强的绿萝开始，不知不觉间，我的小阳台就被一片绿色植物填满了。浇水、修剪、偶尔施肥，这些看似简单的日常小事，却能带来难以置信的平静与满足感。每天早上，我做的第一件事，甚至在喝咖啡之前，就是去看看我的“小家伙”们。我发现，有了它们，我家原先略显单调的氛围变得生机勃勃，连空气都仿佛清新了不少。现在我一共养了七盆植物，甚至还在考虑再添一两盆，也许是一株琴叶榕。
base_en: I've always been—a bit—bad at gardening, but since I moved to my new apartment—with more light, fortunately—I've discovered the pleasure of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos—quite resilient, actually—and little by little my small balcony has filled with green. It's incredible how something so simple—watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then—can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the 1st thing I do—even before coffee—is check on my little ones. I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home—previously a bit bland—has improved a lot with them; even the air feels—subjectively, of course—fresher. Now I already have 7 plants and I'm thinking of adding a couple more—a fiddle-leaf fig, perhaps.

text_es: To successfully grow indoor plants, it's crucial to first understand their specific needs, which is a very rewarding task. Each plant has different light requirements; some prefer direct light, while others prefer indirect light, so it's essential to research this thoroughly to place them in the most suitable spot in your home. Watering is key to their care, and you should neither overwater nor underwater: before each watering, always check the soil moisture with your finger, and only add water when the top two or three centimeters of soil are dry. At the same time, choosing pots with drainage holes and good drainage is also very important, as this effectively prevents waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of plant death. Additionally, consider environmental humidity, especially in winter, and regular fertilization every two to three months to promote healthy plant growth. Finally, be aware of potential pests and diseases, such as spider mites, and take swift action to protect the plant's health if any are discovered.
text_tgt_raw: 想要养好室内植物，首先了解它们的具体需求至关重要，这是一项非常有益的任务。每种植物对光照的要求不同，有喜直射光的，也有喜散射光的，务必研究清楚，才能将它们放置在家里最合适的位置。浇水是养护的关键，既不能过多也不能过少：每次浇水前，务必用手指检查土壤湿度，只有当表层两三厘米的土壤干燥时才需要补充水分。同时，选择底部带孔、排水良好的花盆也十分重要，这能有效避免积水，积水是导致植物死亡的主要原因之一。此外，还要考虑环境湿度，尤其是在冬季，以及每两三个月进行一次的定期施肥，以促进植物健康生长。最后，要留意可能出现的病虫害，例如红蜘蛛，一旦发现，应迅速采取措施，保护植物的健康。
base_en: To start caring for your indoor plants—a rewarding task—it's essential to know their specific needs. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires—direct or indirect—to place them in the right spot in your home. Watering is crucial—neither too much nor too little: always check the soil's moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the 1st 2 or 3 cm are dry. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage—with holes in the bottom—to prevent waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity—especially in winter—and periodic fertilization—every 2 or 3 months—to encourage healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to possible pests—like spider mites—and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants.

text_es: Choosing a good mattress is crucial for ensuring quality sleep and good spinal health. There are many types of mattresses on the market, from spring mattresses to memory foam mattresses, each with its unique characteristics to suit different needs and preferences. When choosing, it is essential to consider the mattress's firmness (neither too soft nor too hard), breathable materials, and a size that fits both the bed frame and the user's body type. Furthermore, factors such as user weight (a detail often overlooked), whether one sleeps with a partner, and usual sleeping positions (back, side, or stomach) can significantly influence the final purchasing decision. Before buying, be sure to lie down on the mattress for a few minutes, even trying different sleeping positions, to ensure you make the right choice. Investing in a high-quality mattress, although the initial cost may be higher, is a wise investment in personal health and well-being in the long run.
text_tgt_raw: 选择一张好床垫对于保证优质睡眠和良好的脊柱健康至关重要。市面上的床垫种类繁多，从弹簧床垫到记忆棉床垫，每种都有其独特的特性，以适应不同的需求和偏好。在选择时，必须考虑床垫的软硬度（既不能太软也不能过硬），透气性好的材质，以及适合床架和使用者体型的尺寸。此外，用户体重（这一细节常被忽视）、是否与伴侣同睡以及通常的睡姿（仰卧、侧卧或俯卧）等因素，都会显著影响最终的购买决定。在购买前，务必亲自试躺几分钟，甚至尝试不同的睡姿，以确保做出正确的选择。投资一张高质量的床垫，尽管初始费用可能较高，但从长远来看，是对个人健康和福祉的明智投资。
base_en: Choosing a good mattress is essential to ensure restful sleep and good postural health—a crucial aspect for the back. There are various types of mattresses on the market—from springs to memory foam—each with particular characteristics that adapt to different needs and preferences. It's important to consider the level of firmness—neither too soft nor excessively hard—the material—which should be breathable—and the size—appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the sleeper. In addition, factors such as the user's body weight—a detail often underestimated—whether one sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping posture—on one's back, side, or stomach—significantly influence the final decision. Trying the mattress for a few minutes—even in different positions—is indispensable before making the purchase to ensure a correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress—although it may seem like a high expense initially—is an investment in long-term well-being.

text_es: I thought choosing a mattress would be simple, but it turned out to be an unexpected "epic" journey. After fifteen years with my old mattress, I finally decided to replace it, but I never imagined there would be hundreds of options on the market, which was absolutely dazzling. I visited no fewer than five specialty stores, encountered some very aggressive salespeople, and spent hours online reading various reviews, which only confused me more. In the end, I chose a memory foam mattress, as the salesperson had promised. After three nights of trying it out, which was a decisive factor, its support and conformity completely won me over. Now, I can finally sleep soundly like a baby; it's truly fantastic, and I don't regret this investment one bit.
text_tgt_raw: 选择床垫本以为是件简单事，没想到却成了我意想不到的“史诗”之旅。用了十五年的旧床垫，终于下定决心要换，但万万没想到市面上竟然有数百种选择，简直令人眼花缭乱。我前后跑了不下五家专业门店，遇到了一些推销非常积极的销售员，还在网上花了数小时查阅各种评论，结果反而更让我一头雾水。最终，我选择了一款记忆棉床垫，商家当时是这么承诺的。经过三晚的试睡体验，这真是个决定性因素，它的支撑度和贴合性彻底征服了我。现在，我终于可以像婴儿一样安稳入睡了，确实棒极了，对这次投资一点也不后悔。
base_en: The decision to choose a mattress—and it seems so simple—became an unexpected odyssey for me. After 15 years using the same one, I decided it was time for a change, but I didn't know the number of options—hundreds!—that awaited me. I visited at least 5 specialized stores—some with very insistent salespeople—and spent hours reading reviews online, which only increased my confusion. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one—or so they promised me—which, after 3 nights of testing—a decisive factor—convinced me with its firmness and adaptability. Now, finally, I sleep like a baby—the truth is it's wonderful—and I don't regret the investment.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is an important decision that affects sleep quality, and the first thing to consider is which firmness level best suits your sleeping position. If you usually sleep on your back, a medium-firm mattress is often the ideal choice, as it provides good support without being too stiff. For side sleepers, to avoid excessive pressure on the shoulders and hips, softer, more adaptive mattresses like memory foam are often the best option. When trying out mattresses in a store, be sure to spend at least 10 to 15 minutes lying down to experience it firsthand, rather than just sitting, to ensure it is truly comfortable. Additionally, pay attention to the mattress material, which is especially crucial for people with allergies or sensitivities, and also carefully check the warranty period provided by the manufacturer, as this is often strong evidence of product quality. A good quality mattress can last 8 to 10 years and is a long-term investment, so be sure to take your time and choose carefully.
text_tgt_raw: 选购床垫是一项关乎睡眠质量的重要决定，首先要考虑哪种硬度最适合您的睡姿。如果您习惯仰卧，中等偏硬的床垫通常是理想选择，它既能提供良好支撑，又不会过于僵硬。而对于侧卧者，为了避免肩膀和臀部承受过大压力，记忆棉等更柔软、更具适应性的床垫往往是上佳之选。在商店试躺时，务必花上至少10到15分钟亲身体验，而不仅仅是坐一下，以确保其真正舒适。此外，还要留意床垫的材质，这对过敏或敏感体质的人尤为关键，同时也要仔细查看制造商提供的保修期，这通常是产品质量的有力佐证。一张优质床垫能使用8到10年，是一笔长期的投资，因此请务必花时间精心挑选。
base_en: When choosing a mattress—an important decision for your rest—consider 1st the type of firmness that best suits your sleeping posture. If you sleep on your back—the most common position—a medium-firm mattress could be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side—thus avoiding pressure on shoulders and hips—a softer, more adaptable mattress, like a memory foam one, is often the best option. Don't forget to try the mattress in the store for at least 10 or 15 minutes—don't just sit on it—to make sure it's really comfortable for you. Also check the materials—important for allergies or sensitivities—and the warranties offered by manufacturers—an indicator of quality. A good mattress can last between 8 and 10 years—a long-term investment—so take your time to choose well.

text_es: Reducing food waste is crucial for the planet's sustainable development and food security, and it is a global challenge. It is estimated that one-third (approximately 1.3 billion tons) of the food produced globally each year is lost or wasted, leading to severe economic, social, and environmental consequences. To address this issue, we need to cultivate more conscious consumption habits, such as planning grocery shopping in advance and making full use of leftover ingredients; properly storing food to extend its shelf life and prevent premature spoilage; and accurately understanding expiration dates and best-by dates. The food industry, from production to distribution, also plays a key role in optimizing processes and reducing losses, while public policies encouraging the donation of edible food are equally indispensable. Every individual's small effort, such as not casually discarding food that is still in good condition, can accumulate into a positive collective effect.
text_tgt_raw: 减少食物浪费对地球的可持续发展和粮食安全至关重要，这是全球性难题。据估计，每年生产的食物有三分之一（约13亿吨）被损耗或浪费，这带来了严重的经济、社会和环境后果。要解决这一问题，需要我们培养更自觉的消费习惯，比如提前规划购物、充分利用剩余食材；妥善储存食物以延长保质期，避免过早变质；并准确理解保质期和最佳食用日期。从生产到分销的食品行业在优化流程、减少损耗方面也扮演着关键角色，同时，鼓励捐赠可食用食物的公共政策同样不可或缺。每个人的点滴努力，比如不随意丢弃状况良好的食物，都能汇聚成积极的集体效应。
base_en: Reducing food waste—a global problem of great magnitude—is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—approximately 1.3 billion tons—which has serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this involves adopting more conscious consumption habits—such as planning purchases and utilizing surpluses—properly storing food to extend its shelf life—thus preventing its premature spoilage—and thoroughly understanding expiration and best-by dates. The role of the food industry—from production to distribution—is also fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food suitable for consumption. Every small individual gesture—like not discarding food in good condition—contributes to a positive collective impact.

text_es: Reducing food waste has been a top priority in my household ever since I became aware of the environmental impact of our actions a few years ago. I remember one time I cooked dinner for eight friends, which was quite a culinary challenge, and ended up with three days' worth of leftovers, which made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning my menus more precisely in advance and only buying necessities, thus avoiding those impulse purchases that I admit are my weakness. I also developed the habit of creatively using leftovers—a simple stew could turn into delicious croquettes the next day. To be honest, I discovered my hidden talent for clever cooking because of this. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits, no matter how insignificant they seem, can have a huge impact. Now, when I see leftovers, I always think, "How can I give them a second life?" And answering that question itself brings me joy.
text_tgt_raw: 自从几年前我开始意识到我们行为对环境的影响以来，减少食物浪费就成了我家的头等大事。记得有一次我为八位朋友准备晚餐，那真是一次烹饪挑战，结果剩下了三天的食物，这让我感到非常糟糕。从那以后，我开始提前更精确地计划菜单，只购买必需品，从而避免了那些我承认是我的弱点的冲动购物。我还养成了创造性地利用剩饭剩菜的习惯——一锅简单的炖菜第二天就能变成美味的炸丸子。说实话，我因此发现了我自己巧妙烹饪的隐藏天赋。我坚信，我们日常习惯中的微小改变，无论看起来多么微不足道，都能产生巨大的影响。现在，当我看到还有剩饭剩菜时，我都会想：“我该如何赋予它们第二次生命呢？”而回答这个问题本身就让我乐在其中。
base_en: Ever since I started becoming more aware—some years ago now—of the environmental impact of our actions, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember 1 time I organized a dinner for 8 friends—which is always a culinary challenge—and ended up with leftovers for 3 days, something that made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning menus in advance—and with much more precision—and buying only what was necessary, thus avoiding impulse purchases—which are my downfall, I confess. I've also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers—a simple stew can be transformed into croquettes the next day—and the truth is, I discovered a hidden talent for resourceful cooking. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits—however insignificant they may seem—can make a big difference. Now, when I see that there's some food left, I think, "How can I give this a 2nd life?"—a question I enjoy answering.

text_es: To effectively reduce the serious global problem of food waste, we can start with small daily actions. First, planning meals in advance is crucial; make a precise shopping list and stick to it strictly to avoid impulse purchases. Second, proper food storage can effectively extend its shelf life, for example, storing different types of fruits and vegetables separately and regularly checking the refrigerator and pantry to ensure the "first-in, first-out" principle is followed. For fresh ingredients that are starting to wilt, such as vegetables, consider freezing them or turning them into broths, soups, or stews, giving them new life. Furthermore, make full use of leftovers by creatively incorporating them into other meals; this not only saves money but also minimizes food waste to the greatest extent. When cooking, especially for one or two people, pay attention to portion control to avoid cooking too much. If there are still leftovers, consider sharing them with others, or composting inedible parts, which is a very environmentally friendly option.
text_tgt_raw: 为了有效减少严重的全球性粮食浪费问题，我们可以从日常点滴做起。首先，提前规划膳食至关重要，列出精确的购物清单，并且严格遵守，避免冲动消费。其次，正确储存食物能有效延长其保质期，例如将不同种类的蔬果分开存放，并定期检查冰箱和储藏室，确保“先进先出”的原则。对于那些开始枯萎的新鲜食材，比如蔬菜，不妨考虑冷冻保存，或者将其制作成高汤、汤羹或炖菜，赋予它们新的生命。此外，充分利用剩饭剩菜，发挥创意将其融入其他餐点中，这不仅能节省开支，更能最大程度地减少食物浪费。在烹饪时，尤其是一个人或两个人用餐，应注意控制分量，避免烹饪过多。如果仍有剩余，可以考虑分享给他人，或者将无法食用的部分进行堆肥处理，这是一种非常环保的选择。
base_en: To reduce food waste—a serious global problem—start by planning your meals in advance, making a shopping list—only of what you need—and sticking to it strictly to avoid impulse purchases. It's essential to store food correctly—separating fruits and vegetables according to their needs—to prolong its shelf life, and to regularly check the fridge and pantry to use the oldest products 1st. If you've leftover fresh ingredients—for example, vegetables that are starting to wilt—think about freezing them or turning them into broths, soups, or stews. Also, use leftovers—creatively, of course—in other meals; this way you not only save money, but you also minimize the waste of valuable food. Also consider portion sizes—especially when cooking for 1 or 2 people—to avoid overcooking, and if you still have leftovers, share them or think about composting—an excellent ecological option—as a 3rd alternative.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult, though sometimes challenging, is undoubtedly a highly valuable experience that greatly benefits both physical and mental health. Many people fail to learn to swim in childhood for various reasons; however, age is absolutely not a barrier to mastering this important skill. Swimming lessons specifically designed for adults usually focus on helping students overcome common fears of water and gradually teach basic floating and stroking techniques. With patience and consistent practice, training two to three times a week can often lead to significant progress in a short amount of time. Swimming is not only a survival skill but also a joint-friendly, low-impact exercise, as well as an excellent way to relieve stress, thereby comprehensively enhancing well-being. No matter your age, it's never too late to learn to swim; it can open up a whole new world of leisure and exercise opportunities for you.
text_tgt_raw: 成年后学习游泳，尽管有时充满挑战，但无疑是一项极具价值的经历，对身心健康大有裨益。许多人因各种原因未能在童年时期学会游泳，然而，年龄绝不是掌握这项重要技能的障碍。专门为成年人设计的游泳课程，通常侧重于帮助学员克服常见的恐水心理，并逐步教授基础的漂浮和划水技巧。只要有耐心并持之以恒地练习，每周两到三次的训练，通常能在短时间内取得显著进步。游泳不仅是一项生存技能，更是一种对关节友好的低冲击运动，同时也是释放压力的绝佳方式，从而全面提升幸福感。无论年龄多大，学习游泳永远都不晚，它能为你开启一个充满休闲和运动机会的全新世界。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding—though sometimes challenging—experience that offers numerous benefits for physical and mental health. Many people—for various reasons—didn't have the opportunity to learn in childhood, but adulthood isn't an impediment to acquiring this vital skill. Courses for adults usually focus on overcoming the fear of water—a common obstacle—and on developing basic floating and propulsion techniques. With patience and constant practice—generally 2 or 3 sessions per week—significant progress can be made in a short time. In addition to being a survival skill, swimming is a low-impact exercise—ideal for the joints—and an excellent way to release stress—which improves overall well-being. No matter the age—it's never too late to start—swimming opens up a world of opportunities for leisure and sport.

text_es: Maintaining a bicycle is crucial for its safety, durability, and optimal performance. It involves a series of routine and periodic care to ensure the proper functioning of its essential components. Tire pressure, brake condition, and chain tension should be checked regularly, as they're vital elements for safe riding. To do this, it's advisable to frequently clean, lubricate, and adjust the gears, brakes, and steering, thus preventing premature wear. It's also essential to check that the screws, nuts, and quick releases are properly tightened to prevent accidents. A visual inspection of the wheels, frame, and fork can reveal possible damage or cracks that need attention. With these simple tasks, the bicycle's lifespan is extended, and a more pleasant, efficient, and safe cycling experience is guaranteed for the user.
text_tgt_raw: 自行车保养对其安全性、耐用性和最佳性能至关重要。这包括一系列常规和定期的维护，以确保其关键部件的正常运作。应定期检查轮胎气压、刹车状况和链条张力，因为它们是安全骑行的重要元素。为此，建议经常清洁、润滑和调整齿轮、刹车和转向系统，从而防止过早磨损。同时，检查螺丝、螺母和快拆是否拧紧到位也至关重要，以防发生事故。对车轮、车架和前叉进行目视检查，可以发现可能需要注意的损坏或裂缝。通过这些简单的任务，不仅能延长自行车的使用寿命，还能为使用者提供更愉悦、高效和安全的骑行体验。

text_es: To start with bicycle maintenance, focus on 3 key elements: cleaning, lubrication, and regular inspection. After each ride, clean the frame, wheels, and components with water, soap, and a brush, removing dirt, dust, and mud. Pay special attention to the chain, sprockets, and chainrings, as a clean chain extends the lifespan of these elements. Lubricate the chain with a specific product every 100 km, or every 15 days, or if you notice excessive noise, making sure the lubricant penetrates the links well. Regularly check tire pressure, brake adjustment, and the general condition of cables, screws, and quick releases for your safety and comfort. Learning these 3 basic tasks will allow you to enjoy your bicycle more, reduce breakdowns, and save money, time, and trouble on repairs. If you've questions, consult tutorials, an expert friend, or a mechanic for more complex adjustments.
text_tgt_raw: 自行车保养首先要关注三个关键要素：清洁、润滑和定期检查。每次骑行后，用清水、肥皂和刷子清洁车架、车轮和各个部件，清除污垢、灰尘和泥土。特别注意链条、飞轮和牙盘，因为干净的链条能延长这些部件的使用寿命。每骑行100公里或每15天，或者当你发现有异常噪音时，就要用专用润滑剂给链条上油，确保润滑剂充分渗入链节。为了您的安全和舒适，请定期检查胎压、刹车调整以及线缆、螺丝和快拆的整体状况。掌握这三项基本任务将让您更享受骑行的乐趣，减少故障，并节省修理的费用、时间和麻烦。如果您有疑问，可以查阅教程、请教懂行的朋友或咨询专业的机械师，以进行更复杂的调整。

text_es: Organizing a farmers market requires considerable planning, effort, and coordination for its success. 1st, it's essential to establish an organizing committee that will be in charge of the logistics, promotion, and management of the event, covering aspects such as permits, regulations, and insurance. The selection of the ideal location, one that's accessible, visible, and has enough space for stalls, visitors, and parking, is crucial to attract a broad and diverse public. In addition, the type of farmers, products, and services that will be offered must be defined, seeking variety, quality, and authenticity in the offerings. Effective communication with farmers, the local community, and authorities is vital to coordinate schedules, prices, and expectations. Promoting the market through media, social networks, and local events will attract buyers, producers, and volunteers. Finally, day-to-day management, including stall arrangement, customer service, and resolving unforeseen issues, will ensure a pleasant and productive experience for everyone.
text_tgt_raw: 成功举办农贸市场需要周密的规划、大量的努力和协调。首先，成立一个负责活动物流、推广和管理的组织委员会至关重要，该委员会需涵盖许可、法规和保险等方面。选择一个理想的地点——既要交通便利、显眼，又要能容纳足够的摊位、访客和停车位——对于吸引广泛多样的公众至关重要。此外，必须明确将要提供的农户类型、产品和服务，力求在产品种类上做到多样化、高质量和原汁原味。与农户、当地社区和相关部门进行有效沟通，对于协调时间、价格和预期至关重要。通过媒体、社交网络和本地活动推广市场将吸引买家、生产者和志愿者。最后，日常管理，包括摊位安排、客户服务以及解决突发问题，将确保每个人都能拥有愉快而富有成效的体验。

text_es: The 1st time I set out to organize a farmers market, honestly, I didn't know what I was getting myself into. I remember thinking it would be something simple, like setting up some tables, bringing fruits, vegetables, and bread, and that's it. However, I soon discovered that it involved an arduous process: permits, logistics, and promotion, among many other things. We had to contact the farmers, explain the conditions to them, and ensure their participation, which required patience, diplomacy, and a lot of communication. We set up the 1st market in a local park, surrounded by trees, flowers, and grass, creating a very welcoming atmosphere. The day was a success, with people buying fresh tomatoes, lettuce, and cheeses, and 90% of the stalls selling everything. It was incredible to see the community's response, appreciating the local product, the quality, and the direct interaction. I learned that, with dedication, effort, and goodwill, great things can be achieved.
text_tgt_raw: 第一次着手组织农贸市场时，说实话，我并不知道自己将面临什么。我原以为这会是件简单的事，就像摆几张桌子，把水果、蔬菜和面包摆上去就完事了。然而，我很快发现这涉及一个艰巨的过程：许可证、物流、推广等等。我们必须联系农民，向他们解释条件，并确保他们的参与，这需要耐心、策略和大量的沟通。我们把第一个市场设在一个当地公园里，四周环绕着树木、鲜花和草地，营造出非常温馨的氛围。那天非常成功，人们购买了新鲜的西红柿、生菜和奶酪，90%的摊位都售罄了。看到社区的积极响应，对当地产品、品质和直接交流的认可，真是令人难以置信。我认识到，只要有奉献、努力和善意，就能成就一番伟大的事业。

text_es: To organize a successful farmers market, start by researching the location, permits, and local regulations. It's crucial to select a site that's accessible, safe, and visible to customers, farmers, and vendors. Establish a clear vision, mission, and values for the market, promoting sustainability, community, and healthy eating. Contact local farmers, artisans, and food producers to ensure a varied and quality offering: fruits, vegetables, and bread. Promote the market through social media, flyers, and community events to attract buyers, sellers, and visitors. Consider the necessary infrastructure such as tables, awnings, and clear signage. Finally, organize a dedicated team of volunteers for the setup, management, and cleanup of the event, ensuring the smooth operation of the 1st market and its future growth.
text_tgt_raw: 要成功组织一个农贸市场，首先要研究选址、许可证和当地法规。选择一个交通便利、安全且对顾客、农民和摊主都显眼的位置至关重要。为市场建立清晰的愿景、使命和价值观，倡导可持续发展、社区参与和健康饮食。联系当地农民、手工艺人和食品生产商，确保提供多样化和高质量的产品，例如新鲜水果、蔬菜和面包等。通过社交媒体、传单和社区活动宣传市场，以吸引买家、卖家和访客。考虑必要的市场基础设施，如桌子、遮阳篷和清晰的标识。最后，组建一支专业的志愿者团队，负责活动的搭建、管理和清理工作，以确保首次市场顺利运营并为未来的发展奠定基础。

text_es: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding activity that offers the opportunity to create something useful, beautiful, and personal. To begin, some basic materials are needed: needles, yarn, and scissors. There are various types of yarns, such as alpaca, merino, or acrylic, each with its own characteristics of softness, warmth, and durability. The process involves mastering 3 essential stitches: the knit stitch, the purl stitch, and the slipped stitch, which form the basis of most knitting. With practice, more complex stitches can be incorporated, such as the brioche stitch, cable stitch, or moss stitch, to add texture and design. Once the scarf is knitted, it can be finished in several ways: with fringes, tassels, or a simple hem, which adds a final touch. It's a relaxing, creative, and accessible hobby for people of all ages.
text_tgt_raw: 学习编织围巾是一项很有意义的活动，它让你有机会创造出实用、美观且富有个人特色的物品。首先，你需要准备一些基本材料：织针、毛线和剪刀。毛线种类繁多，例如羊驼毛、美利奴羊毛或腈纶，每种都有其独特的柔软度、保暖性和耐用性。编织过程需要掌握三种基本针法：正针、反针和滑针，它们是大多数编织技法的基础。随着熟练度的提高，你可以尝试更复杂的针法，如棒针编织、麻花针或珍珠针，以增加围巾的质感和设计感。围巾织好后，可以通过多种方式进行收尾，例如加上流苏、穗子或简单的卷边，这些都能为作品画上点睛之笔。编织是一项老少皆宜、轻松愉快的创意爱好。

text_es: The idea of learning to knit a scarf came about 3 months ago, on a cold, windy, and boring day. I had seen many older people knit with a patience, skill, and serenity that fascinated me, so I decided it was time to try. My grandmother, with her infinite wisdom, love, and good humor, offered to teach me the basic stitches: knit, purl, and garter stitch. At 1st, it was a disaster; my fingers were clumsy, slow, and constantly tangled with the yarn. It took me 2 weeks to master the tension, direction, and regularity of the knitting, but little by little, the scarf began to take shape, with its blue, gray, and white stripes. The satisfaction of seeing my 1st creation, imperfect, personal, and unique, was immense, and now I can say that it's one of my favorite hobbies, a way to relax, concentrate, and create.
text_tgt_raw: 学习织围巾的想法始于大约三个月前，那是一个寒冷、多风又无聊的日子。我曾多次看到老年人以一种令我着迷的耐心、技巧和从容不迫地编织，所以我决定是时候尝试一下了。我的祖母，凭借她无限的智慧、爱心和幽默感，主动提出要教我基本的针法：平针、反针和搓板针。起初，这简直是一场灾难；我的手指笨拙、缓慢，还总是和毛线缠在一起。我花了两个星期才掌握编织的松紧、方向和规律，但渐渐地，这条蓝、灰、白相间的围巾开始初具雏形。看到我的第一件作品——虽然不完美，却充满个性和独特——所带来的满足感是巨大的，现在我可以说，它是我最喜欢的爱好之一，一种放松、专注和创造的方式。

text_es: Last week I prepared for my 1st big move and it was chaos, an adventure, a challenge. I had to empty every closet, drawer, and shelf in my apartment, sorting objects, clothes, and books mercilessly. The process of packing boxes, labeling them, and sealing them took me 3 full days, leaving my back, neck, and shoulders quite sore. It was fascinating how each object brought back memories, stories, or anecdotes; each trinket, bauble, or knick-knack transported me to another time. I discovered things I had completely forgotten: old photos, unopened letters, and 1 pair of mismatched socks. The key to not getting overwhelmed is to go in stages, little by little, and without rushing, organizing objects by categories such as kitchen, bedroom, or bathroom. Now all that's left is the transport, assembly, and decoration phase in the new home.
text_tgt_raw: 上周我为我的第一次大搬家做准备，那真是一团糟，一次冒险，一次挑战。我必须清空公寓里所有的壁橱、抽屉和架子，毫不留情地分类物品、衣物和书籍。打包、贴标签和封箱的过程足足花了我三天时间，搞得我腰酸背痛，脖子和肩膀都非常僵硬。令人着迷的是，每件物品都勾起了我的回忆、故事或趣闻；每一件小饰品、小玩意儿都将我带回了另一个时空。我发现了一些我完全忘记的东西：旧照片、未开封的信件，还有一双不匹配的袜子。不至于手足无措的关键在于分阶段进行，一点一点地来，不要着急，按照厨房、卧室或浴室等类别整理物品。现在只剩下在新家的运输、组装和装饰阶段了。

text_es: To prepare for a stress-free move, organize your tasks with anticipation, planning, and patience. Start 2 or 3 months before: decide what furniture, clothes, and objects you'll take, donate, or throw away. Buy boxes, packing tape, and bubble wrap, and label each box clearly with its contents, destination, and fragility. Hire a reliable moving company, with good references and competitive prices, or ask friends, family, and neighbors for help if you're going to do it yourself. Make a survival box with important documents, hygiene items, and essential medications for the 1st days in your new home. Before D-day arrives, confirm services like electricity, water, and gas, and organize cleaning, painting, or small repairs in your old house.
text_tgt_raw: 为了确保搬家过程轻松无忧，你需要提前规划，有条不紊地组织各项任务，并保持耐心。提前两到三个月开始准备：决定哪些家具、衣物和物品要带走、捐赠或丢弃。购买纸箱、胶带和气泡膜，并在每个箱子上清楚标明内含物品、目的地和易碎程度。雇佣一家口碑好、价格合理且值得信赖的搬家公司，如果打算自己动手，则可向亲朋好友和邻居寻求帮助。准备一个应急箱，里面放入重要文件、洗漱用品和必需药品，以备在新家安顿下来的头几天使用。在搬家日到来之前，确认好水电煤气等服务的开通，并安排好旧居的清洁、粉刷或小修小补工作。

text_es: Caring for an urban garden implies dedication, knowledge, and daily observation, allowing for the cultivation of fresh, organic, and healthy foods. It requires selecting the appropriate location—sunny, sheltered, and with good drainage—and preparing the substrate, which must be rich in nutrients, aerated, and well-structured. The choice of plants is key, prioritizing species adapted to the local climate, with growth cycles according to the available space, such as lettuces, radishes, and spinach, or aromatic herbs like basil, mint, and parsley. Watering is fundamental, adapting to the time of year, type of crop, and specific water needs of each plant. It's vital to control pests and diseases organically, using preventive methods, traps, or natural remedies. Pruning, fertilizing, and crop rotation are essential practices to maintain soil fertility, optimize production, and ensure the long-term health of the plants. An urban garden is a space for learning, relaxation, and connection with nature, offering both nutritional and environmental benefits.
text_tgt_raw: 打理好一个城市菜园，意味着投入、知识和每日的细致观察，从而能够种出新鲜、有机、健康的食物。这需要选择合适的地点——阳光充足、避风且排水良好，并准备好基质，它必须富含养分、透气且结构良好。植物的选择是关键，应优先选择适应当地气候、生长周期符合可用空间的物种，比如生菜、萝卜和菠菜，或是罗勒、薄荷和欧芹等芳香草本植物。浇水至关重要，要根据季节、作物类型和每种植物的特定需水量进行调整。有机地控制病虫害也十分关键，可采用预防措施、陷阱或天然疗法。修剪、施肥和轮作是维持土壤肥力、优化产量并确保植物长期健康的必要做法。城市菜园是一个学习、放松和亲近自然的场所，兼具营养和环境效益。

text_es: Caring for an urban garden has been a transformative experience for me, a window into patience, effort, and reward. I remember the 1st time I sowed tiny tomato, lettuce, and pepper seeds; I didn't know what to expect, but the excitement was immense. Every morning, the 1st thing I do is check my plants, observe if new leaves, flowers, or fruits have sprouted, or if they need watering, nutrients, or a little sun. It's fascinating to see how a strong, healthy, and productive plant emerges from a small germ, providing me with fresh, organic, and delicious ingredients for my kitchen. Sometimes there are challenges—pests, diseases, or adverse weather conditions—but learning to identify, treat, and prevent them is part of the process. In the end, the satisfaction of harvesting my own eggplants, zucchini, and herbs is indescribable, a joy that connects me with nature, with the earth, and with the cycle of life, and that I recommend to everyone.
text_tgt_raw: 打理一方城市菜园对我而言，是一次蜕变式的经历，一扇通往耐心、努力与收获的窗户。我记得第一次播下番茄、生菜和辣椒的细小种子时，心中充满期待却不知会迎来什么。每天清晨，我做的第一件事就是查看我的植物，观察是否有新叶、新花或新果萌发，抑或它们是否需要浇水、施肥或一些阳光。亲眼看着一粒小小的种子如何长成健壮、丰产的植株，为我的厨房提供新鲜、有机、美味的食材，这真是令人着迷。有时也会遇到挑战——虫害、病菌或恶劣天气——但学会识别、处理和预防它们，也是整个过程的一部分。最终，亲手采摘茄子、西葫芦和香草的满足感无以言表，那是一种将我与大自然、与土地、与生命循环紧密相连的喜悦，我真心推荐给每一个人。

text_es: To successfully care for an urban garden, it's crucial to start with planning, choosing the space, and determining the species to cultivate. Make sure the location receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day, whether it's a balcony, a terrace, or a patio. Select plants suitable for your climate, such as lettuces, tomatoes, and aromatic herbs, which are hardy and easy to maintain. Soil preparation is fundamental; use a nutrient-rich mixture that drains well and is of good quality. Watering is another important pillar: do it regularly, avoiding waterlogging or extreme dryness of the soil. Observe your plants daily to detect pests, diseases, or nutritional deficiencies in time, such as yellow leaves, spots, or the presence of insects. With patience, dedication, and constant monitoring, you'll see your crops grow healthy, strong, and productive.
text_tgt_raw: 要成功打理城市花园，规划是关键，首先要选好空间并确定种植的物种。确保种植地点每天至少能接受6小时的直射阳光，无论是阳台、露台还是庭院。选择适合当地气候的植物，比如生菜、番茄和香草，这些都比较耐寒且易于打理。土壤准备也至关重要，要使用营养丰富、排水良好且质量上乘的混合土。浇水是另一个重要环节：要定期浇水，避免土壤积水或过度干燥。每天观察植物，及时发现病虫害或营养缺乏，例如叶片发黄、出现斑点或有虫子。只要有耐心、有投入并持续监测，你就能看到你的作物健康、茁壮地成长，硕果累累。

text_es: Planning a train trip is an excellent option for those seeking comfort, efficiency, and picturesque landscapes. To begin, it's crucial to choose the destination, dates, and duration of the trip, considering whether it's a weekend getaway, a long vacation, or a business trip. Next, you should research available routes, types of trains—regional, high-speed, or overnight—and the railway companies operating in the desired area. Buying tickets in advance usually offers better prices, flexibility, and the opportunity to select specific seats, cars, or classes. It's advisable to pack intelligently, bringing essentials, identification documents, and some entertainment like books, music, or podcasts. During the journey, you can enjoy reading, converse with other travelers, or simply admire the scenery, architecture, and nature. Finally, having a transportation plan upon arrival—taxi, bus, or subway—will ensure a smooth and stress-free transition.
text_tgt_raw: 规划一次火车旅行是寻求舒适、高效和沿途美景的绝佳选择。首先，确定目的地、出行日期和时长至关重要，要考虑这趟旅行是周末短途、长假还是商务出行。接下来，您应该研究可行的路线、火车类型（如区域列车、高速列车或卧铺列车）以及在目标区域运营的铁路公司。提前购票通常能获得更优惠的价格、更大的灵活性，并有机会选择特定的座位、车厢或舱位。明智地打包行李是必要的，带上必需品、身份证明以及一些娱乐物品，比如书籍、音乐或播客。旅途中，您可以尽情阅读、与其他旅客交谈，或者只是欣赏沿途的风景、建筑和自然风光。最后，抵达后提前规划好交通方式，无论是出租车、公交车还是地铁，都将确保一个顺利无压力的转场。

text_es: I remember the 1st time I tried to plan a train trip through Europe, it was quite an odyssey of schedules, connections, and prices. I started by searching for routes online, comparing destinations like Paris, Berlin, and Rome, and then trying to match high-speed, regional, and night trains. The most complicated thing was coordinating the dates, departure locations, and arrivals, so I wouldn't miss any important connections. I spent hours on the Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, and SNCF websites, checking tickets, seats, and luggage—a task that required patience, attention, and some luck. Finally, with everything booked—hotels, tickets, and excursions—I felt great satisfaction, ready to enjoy the landscapes, food, and culture. I learned that the key is organization, foresight, and a good map to avoid surprises.
text_tgt_raw: 我记得第一次尝试规划欧洲火车之旅时，那简直是一场时刻表、换乘和价格的漫长探索。我先是在网上搜索路线，比较巴黎、柏林和罗马等目的地，然后努力将高速列车、区域列车和夜车匹配起来。最复杂的是协调日期、出发地点和到达时间，以确保不会错过任何重要的换乘。我在Renfe、德铁和法铁的网站上花费了数小时，核对车票、座位和行李——这项任务需要耐心、细致和一些运气。最终，当一切都预订妥当——酒店、车票和行程——我感到非常满足，准备好去享受那里的风景、美食和文化。我明白了，避免意外的关键在于有条不紊的组织、周密的预见和一张好地图。

text_es: To plan a train trip, 1st, research routes, schedules, and fares in advance, visiting official company websites, traveler forums, or travel agencies. Consider your priorities: comfort, speed, or price, as there are regional, high-speed, and night trains. Book your tickets in advance, especially if you're traveling during high season, holidays, or weekends, to secure the best seats and fares. Pack your luggage efficiently, bringing essentials, necessary documentation, and entertainment, so you don't carry unnecessary weight. On the day of travel, arrive at the station with enough time to locate your platform, check the information, and board without rushing or stress. On board, enjoy the scenery, reading, or resting, taking advantage of the benefits of this comfortable, ecological, and scenic mode of transportation.
text_tgt_raw: 规划一次火车旅行，首先要提前研究路线、时刻表和票价，可以通过访问官方网站、旅行论坛或咨询旅行社来获取信息。在选择火车类型时，要考虑自己的优先需求是舒适度、速度还是价格，因为有区域列车、高速列车和夜间列车等多种选择。务必提前订票，尤其是在旺季、节假日或周末出行时，这样才能确保订到最佳座位和最优惠的票价。高效打包行李，只携带必需品、必要证件和娱乐用品，避免不必要的负重。旅行当天，请预留充足的时间抵达车站，以便找到站台、核对信息并从容登车，避免匆忙和压力。在火车上，您可以尽情欣赏沿途风景、阅读或休息，享受这种舒适、环保又富有观赏性的交通方式带来的益处。

text_es: Making bread at home is a rewarding, simple, and economical experience that allows you to enjoy a basic food with an unbeatable flavor, aroma, and texture. To start, you only need fundamental ingredients: flour, water, and yeast or sourdough. The basic process involves mixing, kneading, and letting the dough rise 2 or 3 times before baking it. There are diverse techniques and recipes, from rustic breads with a crispy crust, airy crumb, and complex aroma to softer breads for sandwiches or toast. You can add seeds, spices, or nuts to customize the bread, giving it a unique and delicious touch. Mastering the baking is key, paying attention to the time, temperature, and humidity in the oven to avoid raw, dry, or burned bread. It's an activity that, in addition to an excellent culinary result, offers a moment of relaxation, creativity, and learning.
text_tgt_raw: 在家制作面包是一种有益、简单又经济的体验，它能让你享受到一种风味、香气和口感都无与伦比的基本食物。入门所需仅是面粉、水和酵母或天然酵种这些基本原料。其基本过程包括混合、揉面，然后让面团发酵两到三次再进行烘烤。面包的制作技术和食谱多种多样，从表皮酥脆、内部松软、香气复杂的乡村面包，到适合制作三明治或吐司的柔软面包，应有尽有。你还可以添加种子、香料或坚果来定制面包，赋予它独特而美味的触感。掌握烘焙是关键，需要注意烤箱中的时间、温度和湿度，以避免烤出生的、干的或焦糊的面包。这不仅能带来出色的烹饪成果，更是一项能提供放松、创造和学习时刻的活动。

text_es: I fondly remember the 1st time I decided to bake bread at home, a culinary whim that brought me joy, nervousness, and great satisfaction. I started with a simple recipe, using flour, water, and yeast, basic but crucial elements. Kneading the dough was an arduous task; my arms, back, and hands ached, but the idea of freshly baked bread motivated me. While it fermented, the aroma of yeast, oil, and patience filled the kitchen, creating a cozy atmosphere. Finally, upon taking the bread out of the oven, its golden crust, crispy texture, and homey smell transported me. I cut a slice, spread it with butter, jam, or honey, and enjoyed every bite—an unforgettable, comforting, and delicious experience. Since that day, baking has become a passion, a ritual I share with my family and friends.
text_tgt_raw: 我深情地回忆起第一次在家尝试烤面包的经历，那是一次心血来潮的烹饪尝试，带给我喜悦、忐忑和巨大的满足感。我从一个简单的食谱开始，只用了面粉、水和酵母这些基本但至关重要的原料。揉面团是一项艰苦的工作；我的手臂、背部和双手都酸痛不已，但新鲜出炉面包的念头支撑着我。在面团发酵的时候，酵母、油和耐心的香气弥漫了整个厨房，营造出一种温馨的氛围。最终，当面包从烤箱中取出时，它金黄的酥皮、松脆的口感和家常的香气让我心驰神往。我切下一片，涂上黄油、果酱或蜂蜜，品尝着每一口——那是一次难忘、舒适又美味的体验。从那天起，烘焙就成了我的一种热情，一种我与家人朋友分享的仪式。

text_es: When you start making homemade bread, patience, precision, and practice are your best allies. It's essential to acquire good ingredients like quality flour, water, and yeast to ensure an optimal result. Start with simple recipes—white bread, whole wheat bread, or a basic focaccia—before venturing into more complex preparations. Don't get discouraged if the 1st or 2nd attempts aren't perfect; kneading, fermentation, and baking require skill, intuition, and time. A good thermometer, a scale, and a dough scraper will be indispensable tools for measuring, mixing, and handling with ease. Observe the dough carefully—its elasticity, its texture, its growth—and adjust the hydration if necessary to avoid a dry, sticky, or hard consistency. With perseverance, passion, and attention to detail, you'll soon enjoy fresh, aromatic, and delicious loaves.
text_tgt_raw: 当你开始制作自制面包时，耐心、精准和练习是你最好的帮手。选用优质面粉、水和酵母等好食材是确保最佳效果的关键。在尝试更复杂的制作之前，可以先从简单的食谱开始，比如白面包、全麦面包或基础佛卡夏。如果第一次或第二次尝试不完美，也不要气馁；揉面、发酵和烘烤都需要技巧、直觉和时间。一个好的温度计、一个秤和一个刮板将是您轻松测量、混合和处理面团不可或缺的工具。仔细观察面团——它的弹性、质地和膨胀情况——并在必要时调整水量，以避免面团过干、过粘或过硬。凭借毅力、热情和对细节的关注，你很快就能享受到新鲜、芳香、美味的面包了。

text_es: Adopting a dog is an act of love, responsibility, and commitment. This process involves offering a home to an animal that needs affection, security, and attention. Before making this decision, it's crucial to consider the available time, economic resources, and physical space for the new family member. There are diverse options to find your ideal companion: shelters, rescues, and associations specializing in animal rescue. By adopting, you not only save a life, but you also contribute to reducing the number of abandoned, mistreated, or homeless animals. It's important to learn about the dog's character, age, and specific needs to ensure a good adaptation and a lasting, happy, and harmonious coexistence. Remember that adoption is an opportunity to give a 2nd life to a living being—faithful, loyal, and grateful.
text_tgt_raw: 领养一只狗是爱、责任和承诺的体现。这个过程意味着为一只需要关爱、安全感和关注的动物提供一个家。在做出这个决定之前，仔细考虑你是否有足够的时间、经济能力和物理空间来接纳这位新家庭成员至关重要。寻找理想伴侣的方式多种多样，你可以选择去动物收容所、救助站或专门从事动物救援的协会。通过领养，你不仅拯救了一个生命，也为减少流浪、受虐或无家可归的动物数量做出了贡献。了解狗狗的性格、年龄和特殊需求非常重要，这能确保它能很好地适应新环境，并与你建立一段持久、幸福、和谐的共生关系。请记住，领养是一次给予一个忠诚、忠实、感恩的生命第二次机会的善举。

text_es: I remember the day I decided to adopt a dog as if it were yesterday. I was looking for a loyal, affectionate, and playful companion, and after visiting several shelters, I found Luna, a 3-month-old mixed-breed puppy, at a local pound. Her big, sad, and curious eyes instantly moved me, and her timidly wagging tail told me she was the one. The 1st days were chaotic: I had to teach her where to relieve herself, not to chew on furniture, and to socialize with other dogs, cats, and people. Now, after 2 years, she's the joy of the house, an inexhaustible source of happiness, laughter, and adventures that I wouldn't trade for anything. Her presence has transformed my life, bringing me unconditional love, constant companionship, and a new perspective on life. It's incredible how a small decision can bring so much joy, warmth, and renewed purpose to your daily life.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚地记得我决定收养一只狗的那一天，仿佛就在昨天。我当时想找一个忠诚、充满爱意又活泼的伴侣，在逛了好几家收容所之后，最终在当地一个动物收容所里找到了露娜，那是一只三个月大的混血幼犬。她那双又大又忧伤却又充满好奇的眼睛立刻打动了我，而她小心翼翼摇摆的尾巴告诉我，就是她了。最初的几天非常混乱：我得教她去哪里大小便，不能啃家具，还要让她学会和其他狗、猫以及人打交道。现在，两年过去了，她成了家里的欢乐源泉，给我带来了无穷无尽的快乐、笑声和冒险，这些都是我用什么都换不来的。她的出现彻底改变了我的生活，带给我无条件的爱、持续的陪伴和对生活全新的视角。真令人难以置信，一个看似微小的决定竟然能为日常生活带来如此多的喜悦、温暖和新的意义。

text_es: When adopting a dog, be sure to consider its breed, size, and personality. Before bringing it home, it's necessary to thoroughly understand its dietary, exercise, and socialization needs. Prepare your home environment in advance, setting up a safe and comfortable dedicated space and toys for the dog. For training, use positive reinforcement, patience, and persistence to teach the dog basic commands like sit, stay, and come, which is crucial for its harmonious coexistence with family members. Please remember that dog ownership is a long-term responsibility that requires a significant investment of time, money, and energy. Regularly take your dog to a trusted veterinarian for health check-ups, vaccinations, and deworming to ensure its health and well-being. Enjoy the love, joy, and adventures that come with living with your new companion.
text_tgt_raw: 领养狗狗时，务必综合考虑它的品种、体型和性格。在带回家之前，有必要深入了解其饮食、运动以及社会化需求。提前布置好家庭环境，为狗狗准备一个安全舒适的专属空间和玩具。训练方面，利用正向强化、耐心和持之以恒的态度，教导狗狗坐下、待命、过来等基本指令，这对其与家庭成员和谐共处至关重要。请记住，养狗是一项长期责任，需要投入大量的时间、金钱和精力。定期带狗狗去信任的兽医那里进行健康检查、疫苗接种和驱虫，以确保它的健康和福祉。享受与新伙伴共同生活带来的爱意、欢乐与冒险吧。
base_en: When adopting a dog, consider its breed, size, and temperament. Before bringing it home, research its feeding, exercise, and socialization needs. Prepare your home by creating a safe, comfortable space with toys. It's crucial to teach it basic coexistence rules like sitting, staying, and coming, using positive reinforcement, patience, and consistency. Be aware that a dog is a long-term responsibility: it requires time, money, and commitment. Find a trusted veterinarian and perform regular check-ups, vaccinations, and deworming to ensure its health and well-being. Enjoy this new stage full of affection, joy, and adventures.

text_es: Assembling a shelving unit, regardless of whether it's made of wood, metal, or plastic, requires following several key steps to ensure its stability, practicality, and aesthetic appeal. First, be sure to prepare tools such as screwdrivers, hammers, and a level, and count all parts including boards, brackets, and screws. Site preparation is crucial; ensure the work surface is flat, clean, and can support the expected weight. During assembly, strictly follow the manufacturer's instructions to precisely connect side panels, shelves, and reinforcement pieces to avoid misalignment, damage, or instability. After assembly, carefully check if the shelving unit is sturdy and level, and if necessary, securely fasten it to the wall to prevent tipping, falling, or accidents. Finally, you can begin organizing books, decorations, and documents, paying attention to evenly distributing weight to maximize storage space. This DIY project, with careful planning and diligent execution, can significantly enhance the tidiness and overall aesthetic of any room, office, or storage area.
text_tgt_raw: 组装置物架，无论材质是木质、金属还是塑料，都需遵循几个关键步骤，以确保其稳固性、实用性和美观性。首先，务必准备好螺丝刀、锤子、水平尺等工具，并清点板材、支架和螺丝等所有零件。场地准备至关重要，确保操作面平整、干净，且能承受预期的重量。组装时，应严格按照制造商的说明书，精准地连接侧板、层板和加固件，以避免出现偏差、损坏或不稳固的情况。组装完成后，仔细检查置物架是否牢固、水平，必要时需将其妥善固定在墙上，以防倾倒、坠落或发生意外。最后，便可开始整理书籍、装饰品和文件，注意均匀分配重量，最大限度地利用存储空间。这项DIY工程，只要精心规划并认真执行，就能显著提升任何房间、办公室或储藏室的整洁度和整体美观。
base_en: Assembling a shelving unit, whether made of wood, metal, or plastic, involves several key steps to ensure its stability, functionality, and aesthetics. Initially, it's crucial to gather the right tools, such as a screwdriver, a hammer, and a level, and organize all the parts: the boards, the brackets, and the screws. Space preparation is fundamental; make sure the surface is flat, clean, and suitable for the intended weight. The assembly process begins by precisely attaching the sides, shelves, and reinforcements, following the manufacturer's instructions to the letter to avoid errors, damage, or instability. Once assembled, verify that it's firm, level, and well-anchored to the wall if necessary to prevent tipping, falling, or accidents. Finally, you can start organizing your books, decorative objects, and files, distributing the weight evenly and making the most of the available storage space. This DIY project, with careful planning and execution, can significantly improve the organization and appearance of any room, office, or storage room.

text_es: On May 1st, filled with great optimism, I decided to assemble a new bookshelf to organize my books, magazines, and decorations. I excitedly opened the box, took out the panels, screws, and various parts, firmly believing this would be a simple, quick, and satisfying task. However, when I followed the instructions, which were like an indecipherable ancient text, I realized reality was far from it; the diagrams were blurry, tiny, and ambiguous. I spent two whole hours trying to piece it together, hammering, tightening, and loosening screws, my heart filled with frustration, exhaustion, and annoyance. Eventually, despite one panel being installed backward, three screws being loose, and one shelf wobbling, the bookshelf somehow managed to stand up, fully proving my ability to turn a simple task into something complicated, arduous, and infuriating. Nevertheless, it more or less stably performs its function, with a rugged, imperfect, yet uniquely individual charm.
text_tgt_raw: 五月一日，我怀着极大的乐观，决定组装一个新书架，好把我的书、杂志和装饰品整理一番。我兴致勃勃地打开包装盒，取出面板、螺丝和各种零件，坚信这将是一件简单、快捷又令人满足的差事。然而，当我照着那如同天书般的说明书操作时，才发现现实远非如此，那些示意图既模糊又小，还模棱两可。我花了整整两小时，又是尝试拼接，又是敲打，又是拧紧又松开螺丝，内心充满了挫败、疲惫和恼怒。最终，尽管有一块板子装反了，三颗螺丝松着，还有一块隔板摇摇晃晃，书架总算是勉强立了起来，这充分证明了我能把一件简单的事情变得复杂、费力又让人抓狂。尽管如此，它还是或多或少稳定地履行着它的功能，带着一种粗犷、不完美却又独具个性的韵味。
base_en: On May 1st, I decided, with great optimism, to assemble a new bookshelf to organize my books, magazines, and decorations. I started with enthusiasm, opening the box and taking out the panels, screws, and hardware, convinced that it would be a simple, quick, and gratifying task. However, upon following the instructions—which seemed like hieroglyphics—I realized that the reality was quite different; the diagrams were confusing, small, and ambiguous. I spent 2 hours trying to fit pieces, hammering, tightening, and loosening screws, feeling a mix of frustration, tiredness, and anger. Finally, with 1 panel upside down, 3 loose screws, and 1 wobbly board, the bookshelf stood—barely—upright, demonstrating my ability to turn something simple into something complex, laborious, and maddening. Despite everything, there it's, fulfilling its function more or less stably, though with a rustic, imperfect, and personal touch that makes it unique.

text_es: To successfully assemble a shelf, thorough planning, adequate tool preparation, and carefully reading the instructions are essential. Before you start, be sure to count all parts, screws, and hardware, as sometimes nuts, washers, or brackets may be missing. Organize your work area, ensuring good lighting, comfortable operation, and a safe environment, which will greatly improve assembly efficiency. It is crucial to strictly follow the manufacturer's instructions step by step and never skip any steps, as this is vital for ensuring the shelf's stability and functionality. Use the correct screwdriver to securely fasten each shelf board, side panel, and back panel. If the shelf is large or heavy, it's best to ask for help from another person; an extra pair of hands can effectively avoid the risk of falling, damage, or injury. Finally, carefully check that the shelf is level, sturdy, and safe, ensuring it can securely hold your books, decorations, and other items.
text_tgt_raw: 想要成功组装一个置物架，周密的计划、充分的工具准备和仔细阅读说明书是必不可少的。在动手之前，务必清点所有零件、螺丝和五金件，因为有时螺母、垫片或支架可能会缺失。整理好工作区域，确保光线充足、操作舒适且环境安全，这将大大提升组装效率。务必严格按照制造商的说明书一步步操作，切勿跳过任何步骤，这对于确保置物架的稳固性和功能性至关重要。使用正确的螺丝刀，将每一块层板、侧板和背板都牢固地固定好。如果置物架体积较大或较重，最好能寻求他人帮助，多一双手能有效避免坠落、损坏或受伤的风险。最后，仔细检查置物架是否水平、牢固且安全，确保它能稳妥地承载您的书籍、摆件和其他物品。
base_en: To successfully assemble a shelf, plan each step well, prepare the tools, and read the instructions. Before starting, verify that you've all the necessary parts, screws, and hardware, because sometimes nuts, washers, or brackets are missing. Organize your workspace to have good light, comfort, and safety, which will make assembly easier for you. Follow the manufacturer's instructions 1st, 2nd, and 3rd, without skipping steps, to ensure stability and functionality. Make sure to properly secure each shelf, panel, and back, using the correct screwdriver. Ask someone for help if the shelf is large or heavy—it's better to work with an extra pair of hands—to avoid falls, damage, or injuries. Finally, check that the shelf is level, firm, and secure, ready to support your books, decorations, and objects.

text_es: To achieve your dream vacation, you first need a clear plan, a realistic budget, and measurable goals. The first step is to examine your current expenses, whether daily, weekly, or monthly, and identify areas where you can save, such as reducing dining out, bringing your own coffee, or avoiding impulse purchases. To do this, it's best to open a dedicated savings account to keep this money separate, ensuring its safety and focusing on your vacation goal. Consider habit changes that seem small but can have a significant impact over time, such as bringing lunch from home to work every day, reducing unnecessary subscription services (like Netflix, gym memberships, or magazines), or taking full advantage of various offers and discounts. Set a fixed weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly savings amount and try to stick to it, making it a daily habit or a disciplined practice. Consistent small deposits are far more effective than occasional large contributions because they lay a solid and reliable foundation for your travel fund. Remember, every penny counts, so be patient, persistent, and optimistic about the wonderful vacation ahead.
text_tgt_raw: 为了实现梦想中的假期，首先需要一个清晰的计划、一个切合实际的预算以及可衡量的目标。第一步是审视您当前的各项开支，无论是每日、每周还是每月，找出可以节省的地方，例如减少外出就餐、自带咖啡或避免冲动消费。为此，最好专门开设一个储蓄账户，将这笔钱独立存放，确保安全并专注于 vacation 目标。考虑一些看似微小但长期坚持能带来显著效果的习惯改变，比如每天从家里带午餐到公司，减少非必要的订阅服务（像 Netflix、健身房会员或杂志），或者充分利用各种优惠和折扣。设定一个固定的每周、每两周或每月储蓄金额，并尽量坚持下去，使其成为一种日常习惯或自律行为。持续稳定的小额存款远比偶尔的大笔投入更有效，因为它能为您的旅行基金奠定坚实可靠的基础。请记住，每一分钱都至关重要，所以请保持耐心、持之以恒，并对即将到来的美好假期充满乐观。
base_en: To save for vacation, start with a clear plan, a realistic budget, and measurable goals. 1st, review your current expenses—daily, weekly, and monthly—to identify areas where you can cut back, such as eating out, morning coffee, or impulse purchases. Open a specific savings account for this purpose, so the money will be separate, secure, and focused. Consider small habit changes that add up significantly, such as bringing lunch to work, reducing non-essential subscriptions—Netflix, the gym, magazines—or taking advantage of offers and discounts. Establish a fixed weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly savings amount and try not to deviate, so it becomes a routine, a habit, or a discipline. Small, consistent contributions are much more effective than large, sporadic sums, as they create a solid, reliable, and continuous foundation. Remember that every euro counts, so be patient, consistent, and optimistic on your way to your dream vacation.

text_es: Learning a new language is undoubtedly a life-enriching experience that opens doors to different cultures, ideas, and opportunities. This process involves not only learning vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation but also significantly enhances cognitive abilities, memory, and concentration. To master a new language, people can adopt various strategies, such as complete immersion, attending structured courses, or self-studying through apps, books, and movies. Persistence, patience, and daily practice are key to maintaining learning motivation, overcoming difficulties, and ultimately achieving fluency. Many people choose to learn a language, whether for work, travel, or personal interest, hoping to enrich their lives with new perspectives, friendships, and experiences. This is a path that requires effort, dedication, and curiosity, but the lasting professional, personal, and cultural benefits it brings are absolutely worth it.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言无疑是一种充实人生的体验，它能为我们打开通往不同文化、思想和机遇的大门。这个过程不仅涉及词汇、语法和发音的学习，还能显著提升认知能力、记忆力和专注力。为了掌握一门新语言，人们可以采用多种策略，比如完全沉浸式的环境、参加结构化的课程，或者通过应用程序、书籍和电影进行自学。持之以恒、保持耐心以及每天的练习是维持学习动力、克服困难并最终达到流利程度的关键。许多人选择学习语言，无论是出于工作、旅行还是个人兴趣，都希望通过新的视角、友谊和经历来丰富自己的生活。这是一条需要付出努力、奉献和好奇心的道路，但它所带来的职业、个人和文化层面的长久益处，绝对是值得的。
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, ideas, and opportunities. This process involves acquiring vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, which improves cognitive abilities, memory, and concentration. There are various strategies to achieve this, such as total immersion, structured classes, or self-taught learning through apps, books, and movies. Consistency, patience, and daily practice are essential to maintain motivation, overcome obstacles, and achieve desired fluency. Many students choose to learn languages for work, travel, or personal reasons, seeking to enrich their lives with new perspectives, friendships, and experiences. It's a path that requires effort, dedication, and curiosity, but it rewards with lasting benefits in professional, personal, and cultural spheres.

text_es: I still remember my first trip to Portugal five years ago. That journey was exciting and rewarding, yet also a little nerve-wracking, as my Portuguese language skills were barely even "basic." At first, communication was indeed a huge challenge: ordering food, asking for directions, and even simple greetings all became an "odyssey" of gestures, smiles, and broken pronunciation. But gradually, as the days passed, with every conversation and every new word I learned, I started to feel more comfortable, and more importantly, I began to understand. My strategy was complete immersion: listening to the radio, watching TV, and talking to everyone I met, whether they were shopkeepers, waiters, or curious passersby. It was a slow, arduous, and sometimes even frustrating process, but the ability to converse fluently and gain a deep understanding of the local culture, customs, and people made all the effort worthwhile. Today, I can confidently say that learning Portuguese not only opened a linguistic door for me but also unlocked a whole new worldview.
text_tgt_raw: 还记得五年前我第一次去葡萄牙的经历，那次旅程既令人兴奋、收获颇丰，又带有一丝紧张，毕竟我的葡萄牙语水平，用“基础”来形容都显得有些勉强。起初，沟通确实是个大挑战：点餐、问路，甚至是简单的问候，都成了一场手势、微笑和蹩脚发音的“奥德赛”。但渐渐地，随着一天天过去，每一次交谈，每一个新学会的词语，我都开始感到更自在，更重要的是，我开始理解了。我的策略是完全沉浸式学习：听广播、看电视，并与遇到的每个人交流，无论是店员、服务员，还是好奇的过路人。这是一个缓慢、艰苦，有时甚至令人沮丧的过程，但能够流利地交谈，并深入了解当地文化、习俗和人民，这些回报都让所有的努力变得值得。如今，我可以自信地说，学习葡萄牙语不仅为我打开了一扇语言之门，更开启了一种全新的世界观。
base_en: I remember my 1st trip to Portugal 5 years ago; it was an exciting, enriching, and a little terrifying experience, since my command of Portuguese was, let's say, basic. At 1st, communication was a real challenge: ordering food, directions, or even a simple "hello" became an odyssey of gestures, smiles, and dubious pronunciations. But little by little, with each day, each conversation, and each new word learned, I began to feel more comfortable and, most importantly, to understand. My strategy was based on total immersion: I listened to the radio, watched television, and spoke with every person I met, whether they were clerks, waiters, or curious passersby. It was a slow, demanding, and, at times, frustrating process, but the reward of being able to converse fluently and understand the local culture, its customs, and its people, was worth the effort. Today, I can say that learning Portuguese not only opened the doors to a new language for me, but also to a new way of seeing the world.

text_es: When learning a new language, persistence is key, so setting realistic, specific, and measurable goals is crucial. You can start with basic content, such as greetings, self-introductions, and numbers, and don't be afraid to make mistakes, as this is part of the learning process. Try to immerse yourself in the language environment: listen to music, watch movies or TV shows with subtitles, and read books, articles, or comics in the target language. Practice by communicating with native speakers, repeating phrases, and writing short essays; this can effectively improve your listening comprehension, spoken expression, and writing skills. Additionally, exploring the culture associated with the language, such as food, history, and traditions, can enrich your learning experience in unexpected ways and help maintain your motivation. Remember, patience, dedication, and enjoyment are necessary for achieving effective and lasting progress.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言，持之以恒是关键，因此设定实际、具体、可衡量的目标至关重要。可以从基础内容开始，例如问候、自我介绍和数字，并且不要害怕犯错，因为这是学习过程的一部分。尽量让自己沉浸在语言环境中：听音乐、看带字幕的电影或电视剧、阅读目标语言的书籍、文章或漫画。通过与母语人士交流、重复短语和写短文来练习，这能有效提升听力理解、口语表达和写作能力。此外，探索与该语言相关的文化，如美食、历史和传统，能以意想不到的方式丰富你的学习体验，并保持学习动力。请记住，耐心、投入和享受乐趣是取得有效和持久进步的必要条件。
base_en: To learn a new language, consistency is key, so set realistic, tangible, and measurable goals. Start with the basics—greetings, introductions, and numbers—and don't be afraid to make mistakes, as they're part of the process. Surround yourself with the language as much as possible: listen to music, watch movies or series with subtitles, and read books, articles, or comics in the target language. Practice daily by speaking with native speakers, repeating phrases, and writing short texts. This will strengthen your listening comprehension, oral expression, and writing. Stay motivated by exploring the culture associated with the language—gastronomy, history, and traditions—which will enrich your learning in unexpected ways. Remember that patience, dedication, and fun are essential for effective and lasting progress.

text_es: Participating in a mass running event is a sporting activity open to all audiences, regardless of fitness level, age, or past experience. These events are usually organized by municipal authorities, clubs, or associations, aiming to promote sportsmanship, foster community harmony, and sometimes raise funds for charity.
