base_en: Last year, I decided I wanted to go to Japan, and, while the idea seemed crazy at 1st, I started saving immediately. Every month, while I received my salary, I put a fixed percentage into a separate account, something that, among my colleagues, few did. Amid the daily work routine, it was easy to forget the goal, but the thought of the temples and the food, while my friends were out partying, kept me motivated. It was a challenge, but, while I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and, among sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the money. Now, while I'm writing this, I'm 3 days away from my flight, amid the excitement of what awaits me, and I can say that the effort was worth it.

text_es: To achieve your vacation dreams, it's crucial to set a clear budget and closely monitor your monthly expenses. Even if the amount is small, prioritize consistently saving a fixed sum each month, as maintaining savings between income and expenses is fundamental. Consider opening a separate savings account for this purpose, which helps prevent misusing the money. Also, actively look for ways to cut unnecessary expenses in your daily life. For example, you can reduce dining out or look for various service discounts, and plan your trips in advance to get better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving amidst daily responsibilities might seem complicated, but with discipline and appropriate adjustments, you will see your savings steadily grow, and your well-deserved vacation will be increasingly within reach.
text_tgt_raw: 为了实现度假梦想，制定清晰的预算并密切监控每月开支至关重要。即使金额不大，也要优先每月固定存入一笔钱，因为在收支之间坚持储蓄是基础。可以考虑为此开设一个独立的储蓄账户，这有助于避免挪用这笔钱，同时也要积极寻找日常生活中削减不必要开支的方法。例如，可以减少外出就餐，或者留意各种服务优惠，并提前规划行程，以期获得更优惠的机票和住宿价格。在日常责任中进行储蓄可能看起来很复杂，但只要有纪律性并做出适当调整，你就会看到存款稳步增长，而你应得的假期也正日益临近。
base_en: To save for vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget, while monitoring your monthly expenses. Prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small, as consistent saving among your income and expenses is fundamental. Consider opening a separate savings account for that purpose, which will help you avoid the temptation to use that money for other things, while looking for ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your daily life. You can, for example, limit eating out or look for deals on services, while planning ahead to find better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving amid your daily responsibilities may seem complicated, but with discipline and adjustments, you'll see your savings grow, while your well-deserved rest approaches.

text_es: Learning a new language is undoubtedly a self-enriching experience; it not only opens the door to different cultures for us but also broadens our channels for communicating with people around the world. This is a process that requires a lot of effort and patience, and various challenges will be encountered along the way, but as long as one perseveres, they will eventually be overcome one by one. While acquiring new language skills, our brains also get exercise, and many aspects such as cognitive flexibility and problem-solving abilities will be enhanced. There are various learning methods, ranging from intensive course study to complete self-study, but many people believe that complete immersive learning in the target language's native country is the most efficient way. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially when hitting a plateau, feeling frustrated, or making slow progress. The more one practices, the more natural and fluent language use will become, gradually transforming the unknown into the familiar.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言无疑是一种充实自我的经历，它不仅为我们打开了通往不同文化的大门，也拓宽了我们与世界各地人民交流的渠道。这是一个需要投入大量精力和耐心的过程，其间会遇到各种挑战，但只要持之以恒，终将一一克服。在习得新语言技能的同时，我们的大脑也得到了锻炼，认知灵活性和解决问题的能力等诸多方面都会得到提升。学习方法多种多样，从密集的课程学习到完全的自学，不一而足，但许多人都认为，在目标语言的母语国家进行完全沉浸式学习是最为高效的方式。维持学习的动力至关重要，尤其是在遇到瓶颈期、感到沮丧或进步缓慢时。练习越多，语言运用就会变得越自然流畅，从而将未知逐渐转化为熟悉。
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, while allowing us to communicate with more people. It's a process that demands dedication and patience, amid constant challenges that, with perseverance, are overcome. While we develop new linguistic skills, we also train our mind, improving cognitive agility and problem-solving ability, among other benefits. Many methods exist to achieve this—from intensive courses to self-taught learning—while total immersion in the language's country of origin is considered by many the most effective way. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially amid the most difficult phases, between frustration and slow progress. The more one practices, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unknown into the familiar.

text_es: I clearly remember starting to learn Japanese five years ago; it was truly an important journey that changed my perspective. At the time, I was working full-time while also enrolling in Japanese classes, which was indeed a significant challenge in terms of time management. During those days spent with grammar books and dictionaries, I gradually discovered a fascinating cultural world; as hiragana and katakana intertwined in my mind, it felt like I was back in childhood. Initially, the soft consonants and short vowel sounds in Japanese felt a bit unfamiliar to me. There were also days when the frustration was particularly evident as I tried to construct complex sentences. However, even when facing difficulties, the immense satisfaction I felt each time I understood a new word or successfully formed a correct sentence was indescribable; while others gradually became discouraged, I persevered because this sense of accomplishment from "understanding" was the greatest motivation pushing me forward.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚地记得五年前开始学习日语的经历，那真是一段改变我认知的重要旅程。当时我一边全职工作，一边报名参加日语课程，这在时间安排上确实是个不小的挑战。在与语法书和词典为伴的日子里，我逐渐发现了一个引人入胜的文化世界；当平假名和片假名在我脑海中交织时，我仿佛回到了童年。起初，日语中那些柔和的辅音和短促的元音发音让我觉得有些陌生。也曾有过好几天，在尝试组织复杂句式时，挫败感尤其明显。然而，即便身处困境，每当理解一个新词或成功造出一个正确句子时，那种巨大的满足感都无法言喻；当旁人逐渐气馁时，我却坚持了下来，因为这种“理解”的成就感正是激励我前进的最大动力。
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese 5 years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I signed up for classes while working full-time, which was a significant logistical challenge. Amid grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; while hiragana and katakana characters mixed in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, among the soft consonants and short vowels, felt strange to me at 1st. There were days, while I was trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amid the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; while others became discouraged, I persisted, because the reward of understanding was my driving force.

text_es: When learning a new language, it's crucial to be fully immersed, but also to maintain realistic expectations. One common mistake is rushing to achieve results, wanting to master everything at once, instead of embracing a gradual process; it's important to celebrate every small improvement and actively engage with authentic language materials. When listening and reading, try not to translate word-for-word, but instead strive to understand the overall context, which is a very effective method. When facing inevitable frustration, remember your initial motivation and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes each day, while actively seeking opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the many available resources, choose two or three that truly suit you, don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, and enjoy the process of learning.
text_tgt_raw: 学习一门新语言时，全身心投入至关重要，但同时也要保持切合实际的期望。常见的错误之一是急于求成，想一口气掌握所有知识，而不是接受循序渐进的过程；重要的是要庆祝每一个小进步，并积极接触真实的语言材料。在听和读时，尽量不要逐字翻译，而是努力理解整体语境，这是一种非常有效的方法。面对不可避免的挫折感，请记住你最初的动机，并保持每天的自律；每天至少投入30分钟，同时积极寻找与母语者交流练习的机会。在众多可用的资源中，选择两到三个真正适合你的，不要用过多的方法压垮自己，并在学习过程中享受乐趣。
base_en: When beginning to learn a new language, it's crucial to immerse yourself completely, while maintaining realistic expectations. Among the most common mistakes is wanting to master everything at 1st, instead of accepting gradual progress; it's important to celebrate every small advance while exposing yourself to authentic material. While listening and reading, try not to translate every word, but rather to understand the general context, a very effective method. Amid the frustration that will inevitably arise, remember why you started and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes a day, while looking for opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the available resources, choose 2 or 3 that really work for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, while having fun with the process.

text_es: Mass participation running events, as a widely popular sports activity, attract runners of different ages and skill levels to participate together; they not only embody the spirit of coexistence and self-improvement but are also an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance. These types of events typically cover distances such as 5K, 10K, and even half marathons, allowing participants to challenge their limits while enjoying a festive and enthusiastic atmosphere. The cheers and encouragement from spectators along the route create a highly infectious energy field, motivating every runner to sprint hard and strive to achieve their goals. Usually, to better prepare, runners need to undergo gradual and consistent training two to three months before the race, while also focusing on diet and rest. Finally, the moment a runner crosses the finish line, amidst a wave of applause, the satisfaction of completing the challenge spontaneously arises; this in itself is an unparalleled reward, and many people at this moment are already looking forward to the next event.
text_tgt_raw: 全民跑步赛事作为一项广受欢迎的体育活动，吸引着不同年龄和技能水平的跑者共同参与，它不仅体现了共存与自我提升的精神，更是检验体能耐力的绝佳机会。这类赛事通常涵盖5公里、10公里乃至半程马拉松等距离，让参与者在享受节日般热烈氛围的同时，挑战自我极限。沿途观众的呐喊助威，营造出一种极具感染力的能量场，激励着每位跑者奋力冲刺，力求达成自己的目标。通常，为了更好地备战，跑者需要在赛前两三个月进行循序渐进且持之以恒的训练，并同时注重饮食与休息的调理。最终，当跑者冲过终点线的那一刻，在如潮的掌声中，完成挑战的满足感油然而生，这本身就是一份无与伦比的奖赏，而许多人在此刻已然开始憧憬下一场赛事的到来。
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a sporting event open to the general public, where runners of various ages and skill levels compete together, while fostering coexistence and a spirit of self-improvement. These races, which often include distances of 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, are an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance, while enjoying the festive atmosphere. It's common to see people cheering in the streets, creating an atmosphere of contagious energy, while participants strive to achieve their goals. Preparation for a popular race usually requires gradual and constant training, while taking care of diet and rest, between 2 and 3 months before the event. Finally, the moment of crossing the finish line is a reward in itself, amid the applause of the public and the satisfaction of having completed the challenge, while many are already thinking about the next race.

text_es: This Sunday, I finally decided to participate in the community's first public long-distance run, which was an experience I had been looking forward to for a long time. I woke up early before it was fully light, feeling a mix of nervousness and excitement. The atmosphere at the starting line was truly amazing: over five hundred people gathered together, including experienced runners and novices like me, and everyone had a smile on their face. While waiting for the starting gun, I chatted with a fellow runner next to me, and he gave me some encouragement. The first two kilometers were a bit tough, but the energy of the crowd and the continuous cheers gave me immense motivation, pushing me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the familiar streetscapes along the way, and the sense of accomplishment I felt when crossing the finish line amidst applause was simply unparalleled. Without a doubt, as long as my legs and feet allow, I will participate again very soon.
text_tgt_raw: 这个周日，我终于决定参加了社区里的第一次大众长跑，这正是我期待已久的体验。天还没完全亮我就早早地醒了，心里交织着紧张与兴奋。起跑线旁的氛围真是太棒了：超过五百人齐聚一堂，既有经验丰富的跑者，也有像我这样的新手，每个人脸上都带着笑容。在等待发令枪响的时候，我跟身边的一位跑友聊了几句，他给了我一些鼓励。前面两公里跑得有些吃力，但人群的活力和此起彼伏的加油声给了我巨大的动力，推着我不断向前。我按照自己的节奏跑着，一路上欣赏着熟悉的街景，而冲过终点线时，在掌声中感受到的那种成就感，简直无与伦比。毫无疑问，只要我的腿脚还允许，我很快就会再次参加。
base_en: This Sunday I decided to run my 1st popular race in the neighborhood, an experience I'd been wanting to try for a while. I woke up early, while the sun wasn't fully out yet, with that mix of nerves and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was incredible: there were more than 500 people, among experienced athletes and novices like me, all with a smile. While we waited for the starting gun, I chatted a bit with the person next to me, who gave me some encouragement. The 1st 2 km were tough, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement amid the crowd, pushed me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amid all the applause, was unbeatable. Without a doubt, I'll repeat soon, while my legs allow me to.

text_es: For your first public running race, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and maintain a steady, comfortable pace. When starting, avoid sprinting too fast with the crowd, as that can easily deplete your energy too soon; it's best to jog slowly first to let your body adapt. Before the race, be sure to get enough sleep and eat some light food two to three hours before the competition, while also paying attention to hydration. During the race, always pay attention to your body's signals; if you feel unwell in the crowd, you should slow down or take a short break immediately. Remember, the goal is to finish the race smoothly, not to compete for a ranking. The moment you cross the finish line, that sense of accomplishment will make you feel incredibly satisfied. Fully enjoy the enthusiastic atmosphere around you and feel the shared energy of running alongside all the other participants.
text_tgt_raw: 首次参加大众跑步比赛，最重要的是享受过程，保持匀速舒适的节奏。起跑时切忌和人群一起冲得太快，那样很容易过早耗尽体力，最好是先慢跑让身体适应。赛前务必保证充足睡眠，并在比赛前两三小时吃些清淡食物，同时注意补充水分。比赛过程中，要时刻留意身体的信号，如果在人群中感觉不适，应及时减速或稍作休息。记住，目标是顺利完赛，而不是争夺名次。当你冲过终点线的那一刻，那种成就感会让你倍感满足。尽情享受周围的热烈气氛，感受与所有参赛者一同奔跑的这份共享能量吧。
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience, while maintaining a constant and comfortable pace. Don't try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, as you'll get exhausted quickly; it's preferable to start slowly while your body adapts. Make sure you've rested well and eaten something light 2 or 3 hours before, while hydrating adequately. During the race, listen to your body and, if you feel bad amid the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the goal is to finish it, not to win, and while you cross the finish line, you'll feel great satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, among the rest of the participants, and the shared energy amid all the runners.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that allows historical objects to regain their luster, restore their original functionality, and effectively preserve their cultural value. This typically involves multiple stages, beginning with a deep cleaning of the furniture and the removal of old varnish or paint layers, while also assessing its structural integrity. During this process, for damaged parts such as broken legs or detached veneers, we usually repair them using traditional techniques and materials consistent with the furniture's original era, avoiding overly aggressive restoration methods. The choice of the final finish is crucial; whether opting for oil, wax, or varnish, the goal should be to restore the furniture's original appearance or give it new life. This craft requires both patience and the restorer's professional skills, while also fully considering the furniture's historical background and stylistic characteristics. Although various challenges may arise during the restoration process, the final result is a revitalized piece of furniture that can be used for many more years, continuing to adorn spaces and tell its own story.
text_tgt_raw: 修复古董家具是一个充满成就感的过程，它能让那些承载着历史的物件重焕光彩，恢复其原有的功能性，并有效保护其文化价值。通常，这需要经过多个阶段，首先是对家具进行深度清洁，并去除旧有的清漆或油漆层，同时评估其结构完整性。在此过程中，对于诸如断裂的桌腿或脱落的饰面等受损部件，我们通常会采用与家具原始年代相符的传统工艺和材料进行修缮，避免采取过于激进的修复方案。最终饰面的选择至关重要，无论是选择使用油、蜡还是清漆，都应力求还原家具的原始外观，或是赋予它全新的生命力。这门技艺既需要耐心，也考验着修复师的专业技能，同时更要充分考量家具的历史背景和风格特点。尽管修复过程中可能会遇到各种挑战，但最终成果是一件重获新生、可继续使用多年的家具，它将继续装点空间，并讲述它自己的故事。
base_en: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that revives the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, while preserving their cultural value. Generally, it involves several stages, among them deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, while the structural integrity of the piece is evaluated. Amid this work, damaged parts, such as broken legs or detached veneers, are repaired using traditional techniques and materials compatible with the furniture's original era, while drastic solutions are avoided. The choice of the final finish is crucial, among options like oils, waxes, or varnishes, while seeking to replicate the original look or give the furniture new life. It's an art that requires patience and skill, while considering the furniture's history and style. Amid the challenges that may arise, the final result is a restored piece that can last many more years, while decorating and telling its own story.

text_es: The idea of restoring an antique piece of furniture suddenly came to me during a casual stroll through a flea market. I was drawn to an Elizabethan chest of drawers, faded and covered with several layers of paint, completely obscuring its original charm. At first, I started the project with a bit of trepidation. Every day, I patiently sanded every corner, and amidst flying sawdust and the pervasive smell of varnish, I gradually revealed the beautiful wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was truly a long and meticulous process, during which I learned various woodworking and finishing techniques by consulting professional books and watching online tutorials, while also getting used to relaxing by listening to classical music. The sense of accomplishment when I saw the furniture restored to its former glory was unparalleled. All the effort I put in was richly rewarded, and I could almost see it beginning a new life in my living room.
text_tgt_raw: 在一次偶然逛旧货市场时，修复一件古董家具的念头突然萌生。我被一个伊丽莎白时代的五斗柜所吸引，它褪色且覆盖着好几层油漆，完全掩盖了其原有的风采。起初，我带着几分忐忑不安的心情开始了这项工程。每天，我耐心地打磨着每一个角落，在木屑纷飞和清漆气味弥漫中，一点点揭示出那些被尘封了几十年的美丽木纹。这真是一个漫长而细致的过程，期间我通过查阅专业书籍和观看在线教程，学习了各种木工和涂饰技艺，同时还习惯了边听古典音乐边放松。当看到这件家具重新焕发出昔日的光彩时，那种成就感无与伦比。所有付出的努力都得到了丰厚的回报，我仿佛已经看到它在我的客厅中开启新的生命。
base_en: The decision to restore an antique piece of furniture came suddenly, while I was strolling through an antique market. I saw an Elizabethan chest of drawers, discolored, and with several layers of paint that hid its original beauty; among all the objects, this piece caught my attention. I started the project with some trepidation, while carefully sanding every corner, discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amid wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that required a lot of patience as I progressed day by day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, among specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing the furniture regain its original splendor was incredible; amid all the effort, the reward was immense, while I imagined its new life in my living room.

text_es: When restoring antique furniture, patience is key throughout the entire process. First, a deep cleaning is necessary to thoroughly remove years of accumulated dust and grime. Next, carefully inspect and assess the furniture's damage, then decide on a restoration plan—whether to preserve the original patina or opt for a more modern finish. Be sure to sand carefully, gradually transitioning from coarse to fine sandpaper, to prepare for subsequent staining or painting. Finally, apply the topcoat in multiple thin, even layers, allowing ample drying time between each coat. Enjoy the process; watching an antique piece of furniture regain its luster in your own hands is a joy in itself.
text_tgt_raw: 修复古董家具，耐心是贯穿整个过程的关键。首先要进行深度清洁，彻底清除多年积攒的灰尘和污垢。接着，仔细检查并评估家具的损伤情况，然后决定修复方案——是保留原始包浆，还是选择更现代的表面处理。打磨时务必小心，要从粗砂纸逐渐过渡到细砂纸，为接下来的上色或涂漆做好准备。最后，分多次薄而均匀地涂抹面漆，每次之间都要留出充足的干燥时间。享受这个过程，看着一件古董家具在自己手中重新焕发光彩，这本身就是一种乐趣。
base_en: When restoring an antique piece of furniture, patience is key while you work through each stage of the process. Start with a deep cleaning, while you remove accumulated dust and dirt from over the years. Identify the damage and define your approach, while you consider whether you want to maintain the original patina or if you prefer a more modern finish among the options. Sand carefully, while you gradually progress from a coarser grit to a finer one, and prepare the surface for the next step, which could be staining or painting. Apply thin, even coats of finish, while you wait the appropriate drying time between each one. Enjoy the process of watching the beauty of the antique furniture resurface in your hands.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party requires meticulous planning and extensive coordination. First, determine the number of guests to invite, including family and friends, and allocate the budget reasonably; if you want it to be more interesting, you can also choose a theme. The choice of venue is crucial, whether hosting at home or renting an external location; once decided, be sure to send out invitations in advance so guests can arrange their schedules. Food and drinks for the party also need to be carefully selected, and you should consider preparing some games or activities to liven up the atmosphere, especially to entertain children. Of course, the birthday cake is the soul of the party and must not be forgotten, and the decorations should also create a joyful and festive atmosphere. In all these preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the entire planning process and spend quality time with loved ones.
text_tgt_raw: 筹办一场生日派对需要细致的规划和多方协调。首先要确定邀请的宾客数量，包括亲朋好友，并合理分配预算，如果想更有趣，还可以选定一个主题。场地的选择至关重要，无论是在家中举办还是租用外部场所，确定后务必提前发出邀请函，以便宾客安排时间。派对上的餐饮和酒水也需精心挑选，同时要考虑准备一些游戏或活动来活跃气氛，尤其是为了招待小朋友。当然，生日蛋糕是派对的灵魂，绝不能遗漏，同时装饰布置也要营造出欢快喜庆的氛围。在所有这些准备工作中，最核心的是享受整个筹备过程，并与所爱之人共度美好时光。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires careful planning while coordinating various elements. It's essential to define the number of guests—among family and friends—and the available budget, while choosing a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is crucial, whether at home or renting a space, and it's important to send it in advance so that guests can organize themselves while the food and drinks are chosen. Activities or games should be considered to entertain attendees, especially the little ones, amid the celebration. Don't forget the cake, the central element of the party, while organizing the decoration to create a festive atmosphere. Finally, amid all the preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the company.

text_es: Preparing for my 40th birthday party was truly an "Odyssey" of excitement and chaos. I started planning two months in advance, listing guests and brainstorming party themes. During the preparation, I realized my home wasn't big enough, so I had to find another venue, and the expenses consequently soared. To accommodate the tastes of about fifty guests, I carefully selected a menu with vegetarian and gluten-free options. On the afternoon of the party, as the venue was set up and the first guests began to arrive, even though the music was playing and laughter gradually filled the space, I still felt a little overwhelmed. However, in the end, when I was singing and dancing with my family and friends, all the stress vanished, and at that moment, I truly felt happy, and all the previous challenges became insignificant.
text_tgt_raw: 筹备我四十岁的生日派对，真是一场激动与混乱并存的“奥德赛”。我提前两个月就开始规划，罗列宾客名单，构思派对主题。在准备过程中，我发现家里的空间不够，不得不另觅场地，开销也随之水涨船高。为了照顾到大约五十位宾客的口味，我在素食和无麸质选项中精心挑选了菜单。派对当天下午，随着场地布置妥当，首批宾客陆续抵达，尽管音乐已经响起，欢声笑语也逐渐充满空间，我仍然感到一丝手足无措。然而，最终当我和亲朋好友们一起载歌载舞时，所有的压力都烟消云散，那一刻我真切地感受到了幸福，所有的前期挑战都变得不值一提。
base_en: Organizing my 40th birthday was a real odyssey, between the excitement and the chaos it entailed. I started planning it 2 months in advance, while making guest lists and thinking about the theme. Amid the preparation, I realized that the space in my house wasn't enough, so I had to look for a venue, while expenses soared. I chose a menu that everyone would like, among vegetarian and gluten-free options, while trying to please each of my 50 guests. On the afternoon of the party, amid the decorations and the arrival of the 1st attendees, I felt overwhelmed, while the music was already playing and laughter began to fill the air. In the end, while dancing and celebrating with my loved ones, all the tension dissipated and I felt truly happy, despite the initial challenges.

text_es: Successfully hosting a birthday party requires careful planning. First, you need to determine the guest list to get an idea of how many people will attend, and at the same time, set a realistic budget to avoid overspending. Choose the date and venue in advance; if it's a large event, it's best to do so two to three months ahead. When deciding on a theme and decorations, you can look for more inspiration. For food and drinks, consider if guests have allergies or special dietary preferences. To avoid being overwhelmed, you can delegate some tasks to trusted friends or family members. Don't forget to prepare music and entertainment to ensure everything is under control, so you can also enjoy the party. Most importantly: have fun!
text_tgt_raw: 成功举办一场生日派对需要周密的计划。首先要确定宾客名单，了解大概会有多少人参加，同时制定一个切合实际的预算，避免超支。选择日期和场地要提前，如果是大型活动，最好提前两到三个月。在确定主题和装饰方面，可以多找些灵感。食物和饮品方面，要考虑宾客是否有过敏或特殊饮食偏好。为了避免手忙脚乱，可以把一些任务分派给信任的朋友或家人。别忘了准备好音乐和娱乐项目，确保一切尽在掌握，这样你也能在派对中尽情享受。最重要的是：玩得开心！
base_en: Organizing a successful birthday party requires planning. Start with the guest list to know how many people will attend, while defining a realistic budget so you don't overspend. Decide on the date and venue with enough anticipation—2 to 3 months if it's a large event—while looking for inspiration for the theme and decorations. Think about food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences among your guests, and delegate tasks to trusted friends or family members so you don't get overwhelmed. Don't forget the music and entertainment, while making sure everything is under control so you can also enjoy yourself amid the celebration. And most importantly: have fun.

text_es: Caring for indoor plants aims to ensure their healthy growth and harmonious coexistence with the home environment, which requires us to pay attention to several key elements. First, choosing plants suitable for the indoor environment is crucial; one must fully consider light, temperature, and humidity conditions, and avoid overwatering or underwatering. Adequate light is the foundation for plants to thrive; some plants prefer bright light near a window, while others prefer diffused light in a corner. Watering should be adjusted according to the needs of different plants; some prefer moisture and need the soil to remain damp, while others prefer the soil to dry out slightly between waterings. In addition to daily water and fertilizer management, regular fertilization and wiping dust off the leaves are also very important, as this helps plants perform photosynthesis, and one must also closely monitor for the occurrence of pests and diseases. Common care mistakes include overwatering and a lack of good drainage, both of which can lead to plants becoming sick or even dying.
text_tgt_raw: 室内植物的养护，旨在确保其健康成长并与家居环境和谐共存，这需要我们关注几个关键要素。首先，选择适合室内环境的植物至关重要，要充分考虑光照、温度和湿度条件，并避免浇水过多或不足。充足的光照是植物茁壮成长的基础，有些植物喜欢窗边的明亮光线，而另一些则偏爱角落的散射光。浇水要根据不同植物的需求进行调整，有些喜湿，需要保持土壤湿润，而有些则偏好在两次浇水之间让土壤稍微干燥。除了日常的水肥管理，定期施肥和擦拭叶片上的灰尘也非常重要，这有助于植物进行光合作用，同时也要密切留意病虫害的发生。常见的养护误区包括浇水过量和缺乏良好的排水，这些都可能导致植物生病甚至死亡。
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires attention to several key factors to ensure their health and optimal growth, while integrating them harmoniously into our home. It's essential to choose suitable species for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity, while avoiding over or under watering. Good lighting is crucial; many plants thrive near windows, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering must be adapted to each plant, as some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry slightly between waterings. Amid this care, it's also important to fertilize periodically and clean dust from the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, while monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage, which can cause diseases and the death of the plant.

text_es: Caring for houseplants has become my personal form of therapy; it allows me to find a sense of calm when the outside world is chaotic. Every morning, while brewing coffee, I spend a few minutes observing them, watching how the attic sunlight—filtering through the clouds—illuminates their leaves. I still remember when my first orchid bloomed; it was a tremendous joy, one that few things can compare to, and it made me realize how valuable this hobby is amidst daily stress. I strictly adhere to a watering schedule, especially for the delicate plants, and I'm also figuring out the nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my Ficus or Pothos, looking forward to rushing home to see them. This constantly makes me feel life and growth, and my home is filled with fresher, purer air because of it. Among my friends, I've been dubbed the "plant expert," and I'm incredibly proud of that.
text_tgt_raw: 照顾室内植物已成为我个人的疗愈方式，在外界喧嚣不止时，它能让我找到一份宁静。每天早上，在冲泡咖啡的同时，我都会花几分钟观察它们，看阁楼上的阳光——透过云层——如何照亮它们的叶片。我还记得我的第一株兰花盛开时的情景，那是一种巨大的喜悦，少有事物能与之媲美，这让我意识到在日常压力中，这份爱好是多么有价值。我严格遵守浇水计划，特别是对那些娇弱的植物，同时也在摸索它们所需的营养。有时，在工作会议或繁重的项目进行到一半时，我发现自己会想起我的榕树或绿萝，期待着赶紧回家看看它们。这让我不断感受到生命和成长，而我的家也因此充满了更清新、更纯净的空气。在朋友们中间，我已被大家称为“植物达人”，对此我感到无比自豪。
base_en: Caring for my indoor plants has become a personal therapy, a way to find calm while the outside world continues its frantic pace. Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, seeing how the attic sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves. I remember the 1st time one of my orchids bloomed; it was an immense joy, comparable to few things, and it made me realize how rewarding this hobby is, among the daily stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the most delicate ones, while I try to figure out what nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my ficuses or my pothos, wanting to get home to see how they're. It's a constant reminder of life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady," and I couldn't be prouder of it.

text_es: When starting to care for indoor plants, first choose suitable varieties based on your home's lighting conditions. It's best to select those that are relatively drought-tolerant, less prone to disease, and don't require excessive care among many types, as this helps beginners gain experience. Ensure each plant uses the correct potting mix and master the proper watering method to avoid root rot caused by standing water; observe the soil's moisture level between waterings. Fertilize sparingly, strictly following product instructions to avoid burning the plant's delicate root system. Place plants in a location with ample light but protected from direct strong midday sun. At the same time, maintain appropriate indoor humidity according to the specific needs of different plants. Regularly check plants for pests or diseases, and take immediate action to control them if found.
text_tgt_raw: 室内养护植物入门时，首先要根据家中的光照条件选择合适的品种，最好是那些在众多品类中相对耐旱、不易生病、不需要过多照料的，这样有助于新手积累经验。确保每种植物都使用正确的基质，并掌握正确的浇水方法，避免积水导致烂根；两次浇水之间要观察土壤的干湿情况。施肥要适量，严格按照产品说明进行，以免烧伤植物娇嫩的根系。将植物放置在光照充足但能避开正午强光直射的地方。同时，要根据不同植物的具体需求，保持适宜的室内湿度。定期检查植物是否有病虫害，一旦发现应立即采取措施进行防治。
base_en: When starting out with indoor plant care, it's essential to choose suitable species for your home, while considering the natural light available. Look for resilient plants, among the many existing varieties, that don't require excessive attention, while you learn the basics. Make sure the substrate is correct for each type of plant and that you water them properly, avoiding excess water that can rot the roots; observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize in moderation, while following product instructions, so as not to burn delicate roots. Place plants in locations where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours of the day. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, while considering the specific needs of each plant. Regularly inspect your plants for pests or diseases, while acting quickly to control them.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for ensuring quality sleep and spinal health, while a wrong choice can lead to back problems. First, the firmness of the mattress is key, and it must be adjusted according to individual weight and sleeping posture; when trying it out, be sure to stay for at least 10 minutes to feel its comfort. Common materials on the market include latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its unique support and breathability. Furthermore, the size of the mattress should not be overlooked, especially for double beds, as ample space ensures both parties' sleep is undisturbed. Faced with a dazzling array of choices, do not make a hasty decision; comparing different models and referring to user reviews will be very helpful. It is recommended to visit a professional store, listen to personalized advice from sales staff, and personally experience the feelings different mattresses provide. Finally, budget is also a consideration, but remember, investing in a good mattress is a long-term investment in your health.
text_tgt_raw: 选择合适的床垫对保证优质睡眠和脊柱健康至关重要，而错误的选择可能导致背部问题。首先，床垫的软硬度是关键，它必须根据个人体重和睡姿进行调整；试躺时，务必至少停留10分钟以感受其舒适度。市面上常见的材质包括乳胶、记忆棉和弹簧，每种都有其独特的支撑性和透气性。此外，床垫的尺寸也不容忽视，特别是双人床，充足的空间能确保双方睡眠不受干扰。面对琳琅满目的选择，切勿草率决定，多对比不同型号并参考用户评价会非常有帮助。建议前往专业门店，听取销售人员的个性化建议，亲身体验不同床垫带来的感受。最后，预算也是考量因素之一，但请记住，投资一张好床垫是对健康的长期投入。
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for ensuring restful sleep and good postural health, while a poor choice can lead to back problems. It's essential to consider the type of firmness, as it must adapt to each person's weight and sleeping position; while trying out a mattress, it's important to lie on it for at least 10 minutes. Among the most common materials are latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its own characteristics of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, it's essential to think about the size of the mattress, especially if it's shared, to ensure enough space for both, while avoiding interruptions during the night. Don't rush amid so many options; comparing models and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. It's advisable to go to specialized stores where staff can offer personalized advice, while evaluating the different sensations. Finally, budget is another factor to consider, although investing in a good mattress is a long-term investment in health.

text_es: Choosing a mattress for our double bed was truly a long journey, taking almost two weeks. My partner and I both hoped to find a mattress that satisfied both of us, achieving a perfect balance between firmness and support. I clearly remember that in the showroom, we tried lying on at least fifteen different models, and the salesperson waited patiently by our side the entire time. We lay down, rolled over, and then, with laughter and debate, enthusiastically discussed the pros and cons of each one. Finally, after much deliberation, as fatigue gradually set in, we at last settled on a memory foam mattress, which promised to provide peaceful sleep. Now, every night when we sink into its soft surface, we always fondly recall that fun quest, finding the one that was most suitable for us among so many choices.
text_tgt_raw: 为了双人床挑选床垫真是一段漫长的旅程，足足花了近两周的时间。我和伴侣都希望能找到一个双方都满意的，在软硬度和支撑性之间达到完美平衡的床垫。我清楚地记得，在展厅里，我们至少试躺了十五款不同的型号，销售员一直以极大的耐心在旁等候。我们躺下、翻身，又带着笑声和争论，热烈讨论着每一款的优缺点。最终，经过一番深思熟虑，当疲惫感逐渐袭来时，我们终于选定了一款记忆棉床垫，它承诺能带来安稳的睡眠。现在，每晚当我们陷入那柔软的表面时，总会深情地回想起那次充满乐趣的寻觅之旅，在众多选择中找到最适合我们的那一张。
base_en: Choosing a mattress for the double bed was an odyssey that lasted almost 2 weeks. My partner and I wanted something that we both liked, while we searched for the perfect balance between firmness and adaptability. I remember that, in the middle of the showroom, we tried at least 15 different models, while the saleswoman watched us with admirable patience. We lay down, we moved around, and we debated with laughter and arguments about the benefits of each one. Finally, after much deliberation and while fatigue was starting to take its toll, we decided on a memory foam one that promised a restful sleep. Now, every night, while we sink into its soft surface, we fondly remember that fun search, among all the possible options.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider various factors to ensure quality sleep and prevent future back problems. Common mattress types on the market, such as spring, latex, and memory foam, each have their own characteristics. It's recommended to try them out in person and choose one that conforms well to your sleeping posture. While price is certainly important during the purchasing process, you should pay more attention to the quality of the materials, and also listen to reviews and experiences from other users. A mattress is a long-term investment, so don't make a hasty decision. When faced with a dazzling array of choices, taking the time to carefully research and compare is worthwhile. Ensure that the finally selected mattress provides sufficient support for your spine, is neither too soft nor too hard, and also takes comfort into account. Many retailers offer a trial period, which is a good opportunity; make full use of it to adapt to your new mattress.
text_tgt_raw: 选择床垫时，务必综合考虑多方面因素，以确保优质睡眠并预防未来出现背部问题。市面上常见的弹簧、乳胶和记忆棉床垫，各有特点，建议亲自试躺，选择一款能很好贴合自身睡姿的。在选购过程中，价格固然重要，但更应关注材质的品质，同时多方听取其他用户的评价和经验。床垫是长期的投资，切勿草率决定，面对琳琅满目的选择，花时间仔细研究和比较是值得的。确保最终选定的床垫能为脊柱提供足够的支撑，软硬适中，同时兼顾舒适性。许多商家提供试用期，这不失为一个好机会，充分利用它来适应新床垫。
base_en: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure good rest, while avoiding back problems in the future. Try different types, among those with springs, latex, and memory foam, while making sure it adapts to your sleeping posture. It's crucial not only to look at the price, but also at the quality of the materials, while seeking opinions from other users. Don't rush the decision, as it's a long-term investment; among the many options available, take time to research and compare. Make sure that, amid so much on offer, the mattress provides adequate support for your spine and is firm enough, while also being comfortable. Many stores offer a trial period; take advantage of it, while you get used to the new mattress.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a crucial part of achieving sustainable development, especially when addressing resource scarcity and global food security issues. It is estimated that about one-third of the food produced globally each year is lost or wasted during production, distribution, and final consumption, which stands in stark contrast to the harsh reality that millions of people still suffer from hunger, a truly heartbreaking situation. In daily life, each of us can make a significant contribution to the health of the planet through simple practices such as meticulous meal planning, scientific storage methods, and fully utilizing leftovers. Therefore, educating households and businesses and popularizing these practical methods are essential for promoting lasting change. Furthermore, even in the face of economic challenges, government policy guidance and technological innovation will play a fundamental role in reducing food waste on a large scale, thereby seeking more efficient solutions throughout the entire supply chain.
text_tgt_raw: 减少食物浪费是实现可持续发展的关键一环，尤其是在应对资源稀缺和全球粮食安全问题时。据估算，每年全球生产的食物约有三分之一在生产、分销和最终消费环节被损耗或浪费，这与数百万人口仍在遭受饥饿的严峻现实形成了鲜明对比，实在令人痛心。在日常生活中，通过精细的膳食规划、科学的储存方式以及充分利用剩饭剩菜等简单实践，我们每个人都能为地球健康做出显著贡献。因此，对家庭和企业进行相关教育，普及这些实用方法，对于促进持久的改变至关重要。此外，即使面对经济挑战，政府政策的引导和科技创新也将在大规模减少食物浪费方面发挥根本性作用，从而在整个供应链中寻求更高效的解决方案。
base_en: Reducing food waste is a crucial action for sustainability, while we address resource scarcity and global food security. Each year, it's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced is lost or wasted, among production, distribution, and final consumption. This occurs while millions of people suffer from hunger, a striking paradox amid abundance. Implementing practices such as meal planning, proper storage, and using leftovers can make a big difference, while we contribute to a healthier planet. It's vital to educate the population about these practices, among households and businesses, to foster lasting change. Furthermore, government policies and technological innovation play a fundamental role in reducing large-scale waste, while we seek more efficient solutions throughout the supply chain, even amid economic challenges.

text_es: I've always been very sensitive to food waste; in our family, it's even jokingly called "the shameful thing." About two years ago, when I was living alone, I noticed a lot of fruit in my fridge rotting due to my daily carelessness. Throwing away food that was perfectly fresh but I hadn't gotten around to eating made me feel very frustrated. From then on, I started planning meals for the next three days, only buying necessary ingredients, and preparing several frozen meals in advance on weekends. By making full use of leftovers and donating to local animal shelters, food waste improved by 40 percent in just one month. Now, even when cooking for more people, I pay special attention to the expiration dates and quantities of ingredients to ensure that no food goes to waste in our busy family life.
text_tgt_raw: 我一直对食物浪费非常敏感，在我们家，这甚至被戏称为“可耻的事”。大约两年前，独自生活时，我发现冰箱里很多水果都在我日常的漫不经心中腐烂了。扔掉那些明明很新鲜却没来得及吃掉的食物，让我感到非常沮丧。从那时起，我开始为未来三天规划膳食，只购买必需的食材，并在周末提前准备好几份冷冻餐。通过充分利用剩饭剩菜和捐赠给当地动物收容所，短短一个月内，食物浪费情况就改善了百分之四十。现在，即使要为更多人烹饪，我也会特别注意食材的保质期和用量，确保在家庭的忙碌生活中，没有任何食物被白白浪费。
base_en: I've always been very aware of food waste; among my family, we've called it "the shame." About 2 years ago, while living alone, I realized how much fruit was spoiling in my fridge, amid my daily absentmindedness. It was frustrating to throw away food that, while fresh, I could have used. I started planning meals for 3 days and buying only what was necessary, while on the weekend I prepared portions to freeze. Between the leftovers and what I donated to a local animal shelter, I saw a 40% improvement in just 1 month. Now, while cooking for more people, I make sure nothing goes to waste, always attentive to expiration dates and quantities, amid the family whirlwind.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a completely achievable goal for many people, and having no prior experience is certainly not an obstacle. Many adults choose to learn swimming to improve their physical fitness, enhance their health, or feel safer when participating in water activities with family, while some want to overcome long-standing fears. There are many swimming courses specifically designed for adults on the market, and these courses typically offer a supportive learning environment and a step-by-step teaching method, where students share common goals. Finding a qualified instructor is crucial; they should understand the characteristics of adult learning, and consistent practice is key to building confidence. The benefits of learning to swim include increased muscle strength, improved cardiovascular function, and enhanced personal safety, and more importantly, during the learning process, people may fall in love with water again.
text_tgt_raw: 成年后学习游泳对许多人来说是一个完全可以实现的目标，即使之前没有任何经验也绝非障碍。许多成年人选择学习游泳，是为了改善体质、增进健康，或是在与家人参与水上活动时感到更安全，也有一些人是想克服长久以来的恐惧。市面上有很多专门为成年人设计的游泳课程，这些课程通常提供一个互助的学习环境和循序渐进的教学方法，学员们彼此之间有着共同的目标。找到一位合格的教练至关重要，他应该理解成年人学习的特点，而持之以恒的练习则是建立信心的关键。学习游泳的好处包括增强肌肉力量、改善心血管功能，以及提高个人安全性，更重要的是，在学习过程中，人们可能会重新爱上水。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is an achievable goal for many people, while a lack of prior experience isn't an impediment. Many adults decide to learn to swim to improve their physical condition, among other health benefits, or to feel safer in aquatic activities with their families, while others seek to overcome an old fear. There are numerous courses designed specifically for adults, which offer a supportive environment and progressive learning, among peers who share similar goals. It's essential to find a qualified instructor who understands the particularities of teaching adults, while consistent practice is key to acquiring confidence. Among the benefits of learning to swim are muscle strengthening, cardiovascular improvement, and greater personal safety, while amid the process a renewed love for water can develop.

text_es: When I was thirty, I made up my mind to learn how to swim. Growing up, I watched my friends play in the water, but I was always intimidated by this skill. Every summer barbecue or poolside gathering, I always felt a bit out of place. So, I signed up for swimming lessons. Although I felt a little embarrassed being among a group of children, I went for it to overcome my inner fear. The first few lessons were indeed challenging; my limbs were uncoordinated, and the water felt like an enemy. Fortunately, the coach was very patient and didn't waver at all, so I slowly found my rhythm in the water and became more and more comfortable. Now, I can not only swim easily but also enjoy a sense of freedom I've never experienced before. Looking back, this was undoubtedly one of the best decisions I've made in my life, and now I'm looking forward to my next beach vacation.
text_tgt_raw: 我三十岁那年，下定决心要学会游泳。从小看着朋友们在水里嬉戏，自己却对这项技能望而却步，每逢夏季烧烤或水边聚会，总觉得有些格格不入。于是，我报名参加了游泳班，尽管夹在一群小孩子中间多少有些不好意思，但为了克服内心的恐惧，我豁出去了。最初几节课确实是挑战，手脚不协调，感觉水像个敌人。幸好教练很有耐心，没有丝毫动摇，我才慢慢地在水中找到了感觉，变得越来越自如。现在，我不仅能轻松地游泳，还能享受到那种前所未有的自由感。回顾起来，这无疑是我人生中做出的最好决定之一，现在我正期待着下一次海滨度假。
base_en: When I was 30 years old, I decided it was time to learn to swim, a skill that eluded me while my friends splashed in the pool. I had always felt a bit limited in the summer, among the barbecues and gatherings by the water, while others enjoyed themselves without a care. I signed up for some classes, a little embarrassed among small children, but willing to overcome my fear. The 1st sessions were a challenge, while I tried to coordinate my arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Little by little, and while the instructor's patience didn't waver, I began to feel more comfortable. Now I can swim with a certain ease, enjoying the feeling of freedom that I previously only observed among others. It has been one of the best decisions of my life, while I prepare for my next beach vacation.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a very meaningful goal, and patience will be your best companion throughout the process. Finding an excellent coach is crucial; they can understand your fears and gradually guide you to become familiar with the water. It's best to start practicing in the shallow end, and if you can be with other beginners, you will feel more comfortable and secure. Practice breathing and floating repeatedly, allowing your body to slowly adapt to this new environment. If progress is slow at first, please don't get discouraged; many adults feel some unease in unfamiliar environments. But as long as you persevere and have your coach's guidance, you will find your confidence gradually increasing, your swimming skills will improve accordingly, and eventually you will be able to fully enjoy the fun of being in the water.
text_tgt_raw: 成年人学习游泳是一个非常有意义的目标，而在这个过程中，耐心是您最好的伙伴。寻找一位优秀的教练至关重要，他们能理解您的恐惧，并循序渐进地引导您熟悉水性。最好从浅水区开始练习，如果能和其他初学者一起，您会感觉更自在、更有安全感。反复练习呼吸和漂浮，让身体慢慢适应这个新环境。如果一开始进步缓慢，请不要气馁；许多成年人在不熟悉的环境中都会感到一些不安。但只要坚持不懈，并且有教练的指导，您会发现自信心逐渐增强，泳技也会随之提高，最终就能尽情享受水中乐趣。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding goal, and while you embark on this journey, patience is your best ally. Look for a good instructor who understands your fears and guides you step by step, while you familiarize yourself with the water. It's crucial to start in a shallow pool, among other beginners if possible, to feel more comfortable and secure. Practice breathing and floating repeatedly, while your body adapts to a new environment. Don't get frustrated if progress is slow at 1st; many adults experience some apprehension amid an unfamiliar environment. With persistence and support, you'll see how, while you follow the instructions, confidence grows and technique improves, allowing you to fully enjoy the water.
